//Set variables each frame
var updateVars=function(){
    
    //Set deltaF
    var deltaT = millis() - game.lastFTime;
    
    game.lastFTime = millis();
    
    game.deltaF = constrain(game.baseF * (deltaT/1000),0,game.baseF); 
    
    //println(game.deltaF);
    
    //println(game.totalF/game.numF);
    
    //Show hud in hev suit
    if(player.hev){
        
        game.hud=true;
        
    }
    
    //Kill player
    if(player.health<=0){
        
        loadMap(false,false);
        
    }
    
    //Reset Suit
    if(player.suit<0){
        
        player.suit=0;
        
    }
    
    //Reset cooldown
    if(player.cooldown<0){
        
        player.cooldown=0;
        
    }
    
    //Reload
    if(player.reloading){
        
        if(player.reloadTime>=projectileConstants[player.projectile].reloadTime){
            
            //Full reload
            if(projectileConstants[player.projectile].reloadType==="full"){
                
                if(projectileConstants[player.projectile].clip-player.clip[player.projectile]<player.ammo[projectileConstants[player.projectile].ammo]){
                    
                    player.ammo[projectileConstants[player.projectile].ammo]-=projectileConstants[player.projectile].clip-player.clip[player.projectile];
                    
                    player.clip[player.projectile]=projectileConstants[player.projectile].clip;
                    
                    player.reloading=false;
                    
                }
                
                else{
                    
                    player.clip[player.projectile]+=player.ammo[projectileConstants[player.projectile].ammo];
                    
                    player.ammo[projectileConstants[player.projectile].ammo]=0;
                    
                    player.reloading=false;
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            //Individual/Charging Reload
            if(projectileConstants[player.projectile].reloadType==="individual"||projectileConstants[player.projectile].reloadType==="charging"){
                
                player.ammo[projectileConstants[player.projectile].ammo]--;
                
                player.clip[player.projectile]++;
                
                if(player.ammo[projectileConstants[player.projectile].ammo]<=0 || player.clip[player.projectile]>=projectileConstants[player.projectile].clip){
                    
                    player.reloading=false;
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            player.reloadTime=0;
            
            //Sound Effects
            switch(player.projectile){
                
                case 1:
                    
                    playSoundEffect(11);
                    
                    break;
                
                case 2:
                    
                    playSoundEffect(11);
                    
                    break;
                    
                case 3:
                    
                    playSoundEffect(12);
                    
                    break;
                
                case 4:
                    
                    playSoundEffect(13);
                    
                    break;
                    
                case 5:
                    
                    playSoundEffect(14);
                    
                    break;
                
                case 7:
                    
                    playSoundEffect(15);
                    
                    break;
                
                case 8:
                    
                    playSoundEffect(16);
                
            }
            
        }
        
        else{
            
            player.reloadTime+=game.deltaF;
            
        }
        
    }
    
    //Make nonreloadable weapons
    if(!projectileConstants[player.projectile].reloadable){
        
        player.clip[player.projectile]=player.ammo[projectileConstants[player.projectile].ammo];
        
    }
    
    //Move Transitioning Weapon
    if(weaponSway.switchY>0){
        
        weaponSway.switchY+=weaponSway.switchSpeed*weaponSway.switchFactor*game.deltaF;
        
    }
    
    if(weaponSway.switchY>weaponSway.maxSwitch){
        
        weaponSway.switchFactor=-1;
        
    }
    
    if(weaponSway.reloadY>0){
        
        weaponSway.reloadY+=weaponSway.reloadSpeed*weaponSway.reloadFactor*game.deltaF;
        
    }
    
    if(weaponSway.reloadY>weaponSway.maxReload){
        
        weaponSway.reloadFactor=0;
        
    }
    
    if(!player.reloading){
        
        weaponSway.reloadFactor=-1;
        
    }
    
    //Recoil
    if(weaponSway.recoilY<0){
        
        weaponSway.recoilY+=weaponSway.recoilSpeed*weaponSway.recoilFactor*game.deltaF;
        
    }
    
    if(weaponSway.recoilY<-weaponSway.maxRecoil){
        
        weaponSway.recoilFactor=1;
        
    }
    
    //Update Projectiles
    for(var i = 0; i <= projectiles.x.length-1; i++){
        
        if(!game.semiPause){
            
            switch(projectiles.type[i]){
                
                
                
            }
            
        }
        
    }
    //Update Particles
    for(var i = 0; i <= particles.x.length-1; i++){
        
        if(!game.semiPause){
            
            switch(particles.type[i]){
                
                case 12:
                case 13:
                    
                    var speed = sqrt(sq(particles.speedX[i]) + sq(particles.speedY[i]));
                    
                    if(speed>0){
                        
                        particles.animationFrame[i] += floor(random((speed*game.deltaF)/3,2));
                        
                        if(particles.animationFrame[i] >= 2){
                            
                            particles.animationFrame[i] = 0;
                            
                            //println(speed);
                            
                            //println(speed % 3);
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    break;
                
                case 15:
                case 32:
                case 34:
                case 38:
                    
                    var speed = sqrt(sq(particles.speedX[i]) + sq(particles.speedY[i]));
                    
                    if(speed>0){
                        
                        particles.animationFrame[i] += floor(random((speed*game.deltaF)/5,2));
                        
                        if(particles.animationFrame[i] >= objectConstants[particleConstants[particles.type[i]].object].texture[0].length){
                            
                            particles.animationFrame[i] = 0;
                            
                            //println(speed);
                            
                            //println(speed % 3);
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    break;
                    
                
            }
            
        }
        
    }
    //Calulate Distances and angles (Enemies)
    for(var i = 0; i <= enemies.x.length-1; i++){
        
        enemies.distance[i]=dist(player.x,player.y,enemies.x[i],enemies.y[i]);
        
        //Calculate angle between object and player.
        var objAngle = atan2(game.camera.x-enemies.x[i],game.camera.y-enemies.y[i]);
        
        //Shift perspective of player.angle.
        var playerAngle = abs(player.angle-360);
        
        //Convert object angle to 360°.
        if(objAngle<0){
            
            objAngle+=360;
            
        }
        
        var angle;
        
        //Calculate relative angle
        angle = objAngle - playerAngle;
        //Make sure the relative angle <= 180.
        if(angle > 180){
            
            angle -= 360;
            
        }
        
        if(angle < -180){
            
            angle += 360;
            
        }
        //Check if player is facing object.
        if(abs(angle)>60){
            
            enemies.inView[i]=false;
            
        }
        
        else{
            
            enemies.inView[i]=true;
            
        }
        
        //Animate enemy
        switch(enemies.type[i]){
            
            default:
                
                //enemies.animation[i]=0;
                
                //enemies.animationFrame[i]=0;
                
                //enemies.animationTime[i]=0;
            
        }
        
    }
    //globalTimer
    game.globalTimer+=game.deltaF;
    
    if(game.globalTimer>1000){
        
        game.globalTimer=0;
        
    }
    
    
    //Set the initial number of indexes for devTools
    if(controls.devTools.num.length-1<controls.maximums.type){
        
        controls.devTools.num = [];
        
        for(var i = 0; i <= controls.maximums.type; i++){
            
            switch(i){
                
                case 4:
                    
                    controls.devTools.num.push(1);
                    
                    break;
                
                case 14:
                case 20:
                    
                    controls.devTools.num.push(game.defaultCeilingHeight);
                    
                    break;
                
                
                default:
                    
                    controls.devTools.num.push(0);
                    
                    break;
            
            }
            
        }
        
    }
    
    //Set the initial number of step size for devTools
    if(controls.devTools.stepSize.length-1<controls.devTools.num.length-1){
        
        controls.devTools.stepSize = [];
        
        for(var i = 0; i <= controls.devTools.num.length-1; i++){
            
            switch(i){
                
                case 4:
                    
                    controls.devTools.stepSize.push(0.1);
                    
                    break;
                
                case 14:
                case 13:
                case 19:
                case 20:
                    
                    controls.devTools.stepSize.push(100);
                    
                    break;
                
                default:
                    
                    controls.devTools.stepSize.push(1);
                    
                    break;
            
            }
            
        }
        
    }
    
    //Set the max for the current devTool
    
    switch(controls.devTools.type){
        
        //Layout
        case 0:
            
            controls.maximums.num = loadedMap.assets.walls.textureType.length-1;
            
        break;
        
        //Boundaries
        case 1:
            
            controls.maximums.num = 10;
            
        break;
        
        //Floor
        case 2:
            
            controls.maximums.num = loadedMap.assets.floors.type.length-1;
            
        break;
        
        //Ceiling
        case 3:
            
            controls.maximums.num = loadedMap.assets.ceilings.type.length-1;
            
        break;
        
        //Lighting
        case 4:
            
            controls.maximums.num = 1;
            
        break;
        
        //Doors
        case 6:
            
            controls.maximums.num = loadedMap.doorDefs.length-1;
            
            
        break;
        
        //Triggers
        case 7:
            
            controls.maximums.num = loadedMap.triggerTypes.length-1;
            
        break;
        
        //Enemies
        case 8:
            
            controls.maximums.num = enemyConstants.length-1;
            
        break;
        
        //Pickups
        case 9:
            
            controls.maximums.num = pickupConstants.length-1;
            
        break;
        
        //Pickups
        case 23:
            
            controls.maximums.num = objectConstants.length-1;
            
        break;
        
        //Shape
        case 12:
            
            controls.maximums.num = 29;
            
        break;
        
        //FloorHeight
        case 13:
        case 19:
            
            controls.maximums.num = 10000;
            
        break;
        
        //CeilingHeight
        case 14:
        case 20:
            
            controls.maximums.num = 10000;
            
        break;
        
        //Floor Wall Layout
        case 15:
            
            controls.maximums.num = loadedMap.assets.walls.textureType.length-1;
            
        break;
        
        //Ceiling Wall Layout
        case 16:
            
            controls.maximums.num = loadedMap.assets.walls.textureType.length-1;
            
        break;
        
        //Floor Shape
        case 12:
            
            controls.maximums.num = 17;
            
        break;
        
        //Ceiling Shape
        case 12:
            
            controls.maximums.num = 18;
            
        break;
        
        //FloorHeight
        case 19:
            
            controls.maximums.num = 10000;
            
        break;
        
        //CeilingHeight
        case 20:
            
            controls.maximums.num = 10000;
            
        break;
        
        //Dynamic Lighting
        default:
            
            controls.maximums.num = 100;
            
        break;
        
    }
    
    //Reset the button toggel
    if(!mouseIsPressed){
        
        controls.toggles.button = false;
        
    }
    
    //Set the player's zone
    var y = floor(player.y/20);
    var x = floor(player.x/20);
    
    player.zones[0]=loadedMap.loadZone[y][x];
    player.zones[1]=loadedMap.loadOverlap[y][x];
    
    //Set Camera
    
    if(game.cam !== 0){
        
        game.camera.x=player.x;
        game.camera.y=player.y;
        
    }
    
    game.camera.dirX=player.dirX;
    game.camera.dirY=player.dirY;
    game.camera.planeX=player.planeX;
    game.camera.planeY=player.planeY;
    game.camera.height = player.height*(game.height/game.realHeight);
    
    game.camera.normX = player.dirX/dist(0,0,player.dirX,player.dirY);
    game.camera.normY = player.dirY/dist(0,0,player.dirX,player.dirY);
    
    if(player.vAngle>game.camera.maxAngle){
        
        player.vAngle=game.camera.maxAngle;
        
    }
    
    if(player.vAngle<-game.camera.maxAngle){
        
        player.vAngle=-game.camera.maxAngle;
        
    }
    
    game.camera.horizon = (game.realHeight/2)*tan(player.vAngle);
    
    //println(game.camera.horizon);
    

	if(game.camera.horizon > game.camera.maxHor){
        
        //game.camera.horizon = game.camera.maxHor-1;
        
	}
	
	if(game.camera.horizon < game.camera.minHor){
        
        //game.camera.horizon = game.camera.minHor+1;
        
	}
	
	//Correct for yshear
	//game.camera.shearCorrection=cos(player.vAngle);
    
    //enemies.x[0]=player.x;
    //enemies.y[0]=player.y;
    
};

//Update map variables
var updateMap=function(){
    
    //Refresh temp lighting
    tempMap.lighting=[];
    
    for(var y = 0; y <= loadedMap.lighting.length-1; y++){
        
        tempMap.lighting.push([]);
        
        for(var x = 0; x <= loadedMap.lighting[y].length-1; x++){
            
            tempMap.lighting[y].push(loadedMap.lighting[y][x]);
            
        }
        
    }
    
    
    /*
    //Dynamic Lighting
    for(var y = 0; y <= loadedMap.dynamicLighting.length-1; y++){
        
        for(var x = 0; x <= loadedMap.dynamicLighting[y].length-1; x++){
            
            switch(loadedMap.dynamicLighting[y][x]){
                
                case 1:
                    
                    if((game.globalTimer>0 && game.globalTimer<60) || (game.globalTimer>240 && game.globalTimer<300) || (game.globalTimer>560 && game.globalTimer<680) || (game.globalTimer>810 && game.globalTimer<840) || (game.globalTimer>860 && game.globalTimer<880)){
                        
                        tempMap.lighting[y][x]=loadedMap.defaultLighting[y][x];
                        
                    }
                    
                    else{
                        
                        tempMap.lighting[y][x]=loadedMap.defaultLighting[y][x]/2;
                        
                    }
                
                break;
                
                case 2:
                    
                    
                    
                    if((game.globalTimer>0 && game.globalTimer<60) || (game.globalTimer>240 && game.globalTimer<300) || (game.globalTimer>560 && game.globalTimer<680) || (game.globalTimer>810 && game.globalTimer<840) || (game.globalTimer>860 && game.globalTimer<880)){
                        
                        tempMap.lighting[y][x]=loadedMap.defaultLighting[y][x];
                        
                    }
                    
                    else{
                        
                        tempMap.lighting[y][x]=loadedMap.defaultLighting[y][x]/1.3;
                        
                    }
                    
                
                
            }
            
        }
        
    }
    */
    //Check triggers
    
    if(!game.noClip){
        //Floor tiles
        var tile = loadedMap.triggers[floor(player.y/20)][floor(player.x/20)];
        
        if(tile !== 0 && tile<=game.triggers.length-1){
            
            for(var i = 0; i <= loadedMap.triggerTypes[tile].length-1; i++){
                
                if(loadedMap.triggerTypes[tile][i] === 0){
                    
                    game.triggers[tile][i] = true;
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            
        }
        
    }
    
    //Check enemies
    for(var i = 0; i <= game.triggers.length-1; i++){
        
        var triggered = true;
        
        for(var c = 0; c <= enemies.trigger.length-1; c++){
            
            if(enemies.trigger[c] === i && !enemies.dud[c]){
                
                triggered = false;
                
            }
            
        }
        
        for(var c = 0; c <= loadedMap.enemies.condition.length-1; c++){
            
            if(loadedMap.enemies.condition[c] === i && !game.enemiesSpawned[c]){
                
                triggered = false;
                
            }
            
        }
        
        for(var b = 0; b <= loadedMap.triggerTypes[i].length-1; b++){
            
            if(loadedMap.triggerTypes[i][b] === 2){
                
                game.triggers[i][b] = triggered;
                
            }
            
        }
        
    }
    
    //Check pickups
    for(var i = 0; i <= game.triggers.length-1; i++){
        
        var triggered = true;
        
        for(var c = 0; c <= pickups.trigger.length-1; c++){
            
            if(pickups.trigger[c] === i && !pickups.dud[c]){
                
                triggered = false;
                
            }
            
        }
        
        for(var b = 0; b <= loadedMap.triggerTypes[i].length-1; b++){
            
            if(loadedMap.triggerTypes[i][b] === 3){
                
                game.triggers[i][b] = triggered;
                
            }
            
        }
        
    }
    
    //Check required triggers
    for(var i = 0; i <= game.triggers.length-1; i++){
        
        var triggered = true;
        
        for(var c = 0; c <= loadedMap.triggerCondition[i].length-1; c++){
            
            if(game.triggers[loadedMap.triggerCondition[i][c]].includes(false)){
                
                triggered = false;
                
            }
            
            
        }
        
        if(loadedMap.triggerTypes[i].includes(4)){
            
            game.triggers[i][loadedMap.triggerTypes[i].indexOf(4)] = triggered;
            
            if(!triggered){
                
                for(var s = 0; s <= loadedMap.triggerTypes[i].length-1; s++){
                    
                    game.triggers[i][s] = false;
                    
                }
                
            }
            
        }
        
    }
    
    //Activate things based on triggers
    for(var i = 0; i <= game.triggers.length-1; i++){
        
        //Check if its triggered
        var triggered = true;
        
        for(var s = 0; s <= game.triggers[i].length-1; s++){
            
            if(!game.triggers[i][s]){
                
                triggered=false;
                
            }
            
        }
        
        //If its been triggered do things
        if(triggered){
            
            //Door open
            for(var y = 0; y <= loadedMap.doors.length-1; y++){
                
                for(var x = 0; x <= loadedMap.doors[y].length-1; x++){
                    
                    var doorSpeed = loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[y][x]].speed*(loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[y][x]].direction);
                    
                    if(loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[y][x]].trigger===i){
                        
                        switch(loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[y][x]].type){
                            
                            //Floor Lift
                            case 7:
                                
                                if(loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[y][x]].lor.includes('p') && tempMap.floorHeight[y][x]>=loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[y][x]].min && tempMap.floorHeight[y][x]<=loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[y][x]].max){
                                    
                                    tempMap.floorHeight[y][x]+=doorSpeed*game.deltaF;
                                    
                                }
                                
                                if(loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[y][x]].lor.includes('s') && tempMap.floorSecondaryHeight[y][x]>=loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[y][x]].min && tempMap.floorSecondaryHeight[y][x]<=loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[y][x]].max){
                                    
                                    tempMap.floorSecondaryHeight[y][x]+=doorSpeed*game.deltaF;
                                    
                                }
                                
                                tempMap.floorHeight[y][x] = constrain(tempMap.floorHeight[y][x],loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[y][x]].min,loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[y][x]].max);
                                
                                
                                break;
                            
                            //Ceiling Lift
                            case 8:
                                
                                if(loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[y][x]].lor.includes('p') && tempMap.ceilingHeight[y][x]>=loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[y][x]].min && tempMap.ceilingHeight[y][x]<=loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[y][x]].max){
                                    
                                    tempMap.ceilingHeight[y][x]+=doorSpeed*game.deltaF;
                                    
                                }
                                
                                if(loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[y][x]].lor.includes('s') && tempMap.ceilingSecondaryHeight[y][x]>=loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[y][x]].min && tempMap.ceilingSecondaryHeight[y][x]<=loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[y][x]].max){
                                    
                                    tempMap.ceilingSecondaryHeight[y][x]+=doorSpeed*game.deltaF;
                                    
                                }
                                
                                tempMap.ceilingHeight[y][x] = constrain(tempMap.ceilingHeight[y][x],loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[y][x]].min,loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[y][x]].max);
                                
                                break;
                            
                            //Regular door
                            default:
                                
                                if(loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[y][x]].player){
                                    
                                    //Open when activated
                                    if(tempMap.doorOpen[y][x]>=loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[y][x]].min && tempMap.doorOpen[y][x]<=loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[y][x]].max && tempMap.doorActivated[y][x]){
                                        
                                        tempMap.doorOpen[y][x]+=doorSpeed*game.deltaF;
                                        
                                    }
                                    
                                    //Close when not
                                    if(!tempMap.doorActivated[y][x] && tempMap.doorOpen[y][x]>=loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[y][x]].min && tempMap.doorOpen[y][x]<=loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[y][x]].max){
                                        
                                        tempMap.doorOpen[y][x]-=doorSpeed*game.deltaF;
                                        
                                    }
                                    
                                    //Set the timer to close the door
                                    if(tempMap.doorActivated[y][x] && ((doorSpeed > 0 && tempMap.doorOpen[y][x] >= loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[y][x]].max) || (doorSpeed < 0 && tempMap.doorOpen[y][x] <= loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[y][x]].min)) && tempMap.doorTimeOpen[y][x]<= 0){
                                        
                                        tempMap.doorTimeOpen[y][x] = 300;
                                        
                                    }
                                    
                                    //Run down the timer and tell the door to close when its over.
                                    if(tempMap.doorTimeOpen[y][x]>0){
                                        
                                        tempMap.doorTimeOpen[y][x] -= game.deltaF;
                                        
                                        if(tempMap.doorTimeOpen[y][x] <= 0){
                                            
                                            tempMap.doorActivated[y][x] = false;
                                            
                                        }
                                        
                                    }
                                    
                                }
                                
                                else{
                                    
                                    if(tempMap.doorOpen[y][x]>=loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[y][x]].min && tempMap.doorOpen[y][x]<=loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[y][x]].max){
                                        
                                        tempMap.doorOpen[y][x]+=doorSpeed*game.deltaF;
                                        
                                    }
                                    
                                }
                                
                                if(tempMap.doorOpen[y][x]<0){
                                    
                                    tempMap.doorOpen[y][x]=0;
                                    
                                }
                                
                                if(tempMap.doorOpen[y][x]>1){
                                    
                                    tempMap.doorOpen[y][x]=1;
                                    
                                }
                                
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            var states = ['alert','ambush','idle','hunting','attacking'];
            
            //Enemy spawn
            for(var c = 0; c <= loadedMap.enemies.start.length-1; c++){
                
                if(!loadedMap.enemies.start[c] && !game.enemiesSpawned[c] && loadedMap.enemies.spawnTrigger[c] === i){
                    
                    enemies.x.push(loadedMap.enemies.x[c]);
                    enemies.y.push(loadedMap.enemies.y[c]);
                    enemies.speedX.push(0);
                    enemies.speedY.push(0);
                    enemies.vertSpeed.push(0);
                    enemies.moving.push(false);
                    enemies.faceAngle.push(0);
                    enemies.angle.push(loadedMap.enemies.angle[c]);
                    enemies.state.push(states[loadedMap.enemies.state[c]]);
                    enemies.moveTime.push(0);
                    enemies.cooldown.push(0);
                    enemies.health.push(enemyConstants[loadedMap.enemies.type[c]].health);
                    enemies.verticalPos.push(loadedMap.enemies.z[i]);
                    enemies.animation.push(0);
                    enemies.animationFrame.push(0);
                    enemies.animationTime.push(0);
                    enemies.type.push(loadedMap.enemies.type[c]);
                    enemies.trigger.push(loadedMap.enemies.condition[c]);
                    enemies.dud.push(false);
                    enemies.levelID.push(c);
                    
                    enemies.lastSeen.push([]);
                    enemies.target.push([]);
                    enemies.path.push([]);
                    enemies.next.push([]);
                    
                    game.enemiesSpawned[c]=true;
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            //Pickup spawn
            for(var c = 0; c <= loadedMap.pickups.start.length-1; c++){
                
                if(!loadedMap.pickups.start[c] && !game.pickupsSpawned[c] && loadedMap.pickups.spawnTrigger[c] === i){
                    
                    
                    pickups.x.push(loadedMap.pickups.x[c]);
                    pickups.y.push(loadedMap.pickups.y[c]);
                    pickups.type.push(loadedMap.pickups.type[c]);
                    pickups.trigger.push(loadedMap.pickups.condition[c]);
                    
                    pickups.dud.push(false);
                    
                    pickups.levelID.push(c);
                    
                    game.pickupsSpawned[c]=true;
                    
                }
                
            }
            
        }
        
    }
    
};

//Place objects in the map
var updateObjects=function(){
    
    //Reset variables
    objects.x=[];
    objects.y=[];
    
    objects.speedX=[];
    objects.speedY=[];
    
    objects.angle=[];
    
    objects.transparency=[];
    
    objects.verticalPos=[];
    
    objects.animation=[];
    
    objects.animationFrame=[];
    
    objects.type=[];
    
    objects.playerDistances=[];
    
    objects.cameraAngles=[];
    
    objects.cameraDistances=[];
    
    objects.realDistances=[];
    
    objects.inView=[];
    
    objects.drawn=[];
    
    //Projectiles
    for(var i = 0; i <= projectiles.x.length-1; i++){
        
        var inZone = false;
        
        var y = floor(projectiles.y[i]/20);
        var x = floor(projectiles.x[i]/20);
        
        //println(loadedMap.loadZone);
        var zone = loadedMap.loadZone[y][x];
        var overlap = loadedMap.loadOverlap[y][x];
        
        inZone = (player.zones[0] === zone || player.zones[0] === overlap) || (player.zones[1] === zone || player.zones[1] === overlap);
        
        if(!projectiles.dud[i] && (game.cam<2 || inZone)){
            
            objects.x.push(projectiles.x[i]);
            objects.y.push(projectiles.y[i]);
            
            objects.angle.push(projectiles.angle[i]);
            
            objects.animation.push(projectiles.animation[i]);
            
            objects.animationFrame.push(projectiles.animationFrame[i]);
            
            objects.transparency.push(objectConstants[projectileConstants[projectiles.type[i]].object].transparency);
            
            objects.verticalPos.push(projectiles.verticalPos[i]);
            
            objects.type.push(projectileConstants[projectiles.type[i]].object);
            
            objects.inView.push(false);
            
            objects.drawn.push(false);
            
        }
        
    }
    
    //Enemies
    for(var i = 0; i <= enemies.x.length-1; i++){
        
        var inZone = false;
        
        var y = floor(enemies.y[i]/20);
        var x = floor(enemies.x[i]/20);
        
        var zone = loadedMap.loadZone[y][x];
        var overlap = loadedMap.loadOverlap[y][x];
        
        inZone = (player.zones[0] === zone || player.zones[0] === overlap) || (player.zones[1] === zone || player.zones[1] === overlap);
        
        if(!enemies.dud[i] && (game.cam<2 || (inZone && enemies.inView[i]))){
            
            objects.x.push(enemies.x[i]);
            objects.y.push(enemies.y[i]);
            
            objects.angle.push(enemies.angle[i]);
            
            objects.animation.push(enemies.animation[i]);
            
            objects.animationFrame.push(enemies.animationFrame[i]);
            
            objects.transparency.push(objectConstants[enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].object].transparency);
            
            objects.verticalPos.push(enemies.verticalPos[i]-300 + enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].height/2);
            
            objects.type.push(enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].object);
            
            objects.inView.push(false);
            
            objects.drawn.push(false);
            
        }
        
    }
    
    //Pickups
    for(var i = 0; i <= pickups.x.length-1; i++){
        
        var inZone = false;
        
        var y = floor(pickups.y[i]/20);
        var x = floor(pickups.x[i]/20);
        
        var zone = loadedMap.loadZone[y][x];
        var overlap = loadedMap.loadOverlap[y][x];
        
        inZone = (player.zones[0] === zone || player.zones[0] === overlap) || (player.zones[1] === zone || player.zones[1] === overlap);
        
        if(!pickups.dud[i] && (game.cam<2 || inZone)){
            
            objects.x.push(pickups.x[i]);
            objects.y.push(pickups.y[i]);
            
            objects.angle.push(0);
            
            objects.animation.push(0);
            
            objects.animationFrame.push(0);
            
            objects.transparency.push(objectConstants[pickupConstants[pickups.type[i]].object].transparency);
            
            objects.verticalPos.push(-300+objectConstants[pickupConstants[pickups.type[i]].object].height/2 + primaryOrSecondary(pickups.x[i],pickups.y[i],'floor'));
            
            objects.type.push(pickupConstants[pickups.type[i]].object);
            
            objects.inView.push(false);
            
            objects.drawn.push(false);
            
        }
        
    }
    
    //Decor
    for(var i = 0; i <= loadedMap.decor.x.length-1; i++){
        
        var inZone = false;
        
        var y = floor(loadedMap.decor.y[i]/20);
        var x = floor(loadedMap.decor.x[i]/20);
        
        var zone = loadedMap.loadZone[y][x];
        var overlap = loadedMap.loadOverlap[y][x];
        
        inZone = (player.zones[0] === zone || player.zones[0] === overlap) || (player.zones[1] === zone || player.zones[1] === overlap);
        
        if(game.cam<2 || inZone){
            
            objects.x.push(loadedMap.decor.x[i]);
            objects.y.push(loadedMap.decor.y[i]);
            
            objects.angle.push(0);
            
            objects.animation.push(0);
            
            objects.animationFrame.push(0);
            objects.transparency.push(objectConstants[loadedMap.decor.object[i]].transparency);
            
            //objects.verticalPos.push(objectConstants[pickupConstants[pickups.type[i]].object].verticalPos + primaryOrSecondary(pickups.x[i],pickups.y[i],'floor'));
            
            objects.verticalPos.push(loadedMap.decor.z[i]);
            
            objects.type.push(loadedMap.decor.object[i]);
            
            objects.inView.push(false);
            
            objects.drawn.push(false);
            
        }
        
    }
    
    //Particles
    for(var i = 0; i <= particles.x.length-1; i++){
        
        var inZone = false;
        
        var y = floor(particles.y[i]/20);
        var x = floor(particles.x[i]/20);
        
        var zone = loadedMap.loadZone[y][x];
        var overlap = loadedMap.loadOverlap[y][x];
        
        inZone = (player.zones[0] === zone || player.zones[0] === overlap) || (player.zones[1] === zone || player.zones[1] === overlap);
        
        if(!particles.dud[i] && (game.cam<2 || inZone)){
            
            objects.x.push(particles.x[i]);
            objects.y.push(particles.y[i]);
            
            if(objectConstants[particleConstants[particles.type[i]].object].multiAngle){
                
                objects.angle.push(atan2(particles.speedX[i],particles.speedY[i])+180);
                
            }
            
            else{
                
                objects.angle.push(0);
                
            }
            
            objects.animation.push(particles.animation[i]);
            
            objects.animationFrame.push(particles.animationFrame[i]);
            
            objects.transparency.push(particles.transparency[i]);
            
            objects.verticalPos.push(particles.verticalPos[i]);
            
            objects.type.push(particleConstants[particles.type[i]].object);
            
            objects.inView.push(false);
            
            objects.drawn.push(false);
            
        }
        
    }
    
    //Do one last pass through for variables if in first person
    if(game.cam===2){
        
        //Calulate Distances and angles (Objects)
        for(var i = 0; i <= objects.x.length-1; i++){
            
            objects.playerDistances[i]=dist(player.x,player.y,objects.x[i],objects.y[i]);
            
            //objects.cameraDistances[i]=dist(game.camera.x,game.camera.y,objects.x[i],objects.y[i]);
             
            objects.cameraDistances[i]=(objects.x[i] - game.camera.x)*game.camera.normX + (objects.y[i]-game.camera.y)*game.camera.normY;
            
            objects.realDistances[i] = sqrt(sq(objects.cameraDistances[i])+sq((game.camera.height-(objects.verticalPos[i]/2))/20));
            
            objects.cameraAngles[i]=-1*(atan2(game.camera.x-objects.x[i],game.camera.y-objects.y[i])-180);
            
            //Calculate angle between object and player.
            var objAngle = atan2(game.camera.x-objects.x[i],game.camera.y-objects.y[i]);
            
            //Shift perspective of player.angle.
            var playerAngle = abs(player.angle-360);
            
            //Convert object angle to 360°.
            if(objAngle<0){
                
                objAngle+=360;
                
            }
            
            var angle;
            
            //Calculate relative angle
            angle = objAngle - playerAngle;
            //Make sure the relative angle <= 180.
            if(angle > 180){
                
                angle -= 360;
                
            }
            
            if(angle < -180){
                
                angle += 360;
                
            }
            
            //text(playerAngle,20,40);
            //text(objAngle,20,50);
            //text(angle,20,60);
            
            //Check if player is facing object.
            if(abs(angle)>60){
                
                objects.inView[i]=false;
                
            }
            
            else{
                
                objects.inView[i]=true;
                
            }
            
            //Check which side you're looking at
            {
                
                //Find true angle
                var trueAngle=objects.cameraAngles[i]-objects.angle[i];
                
                if(trueAngle>360){
                    
                    trueAngle-=360;
                    
                }
                
                if(trueAngle<0){
                    
                    trueAngle+=360;
                    
                }
                
                //Set side
                if(objectConstants[objects.type[i]].multiAngle){
                    
                    if(trueAngle>337.5 || trueAngle<=22.5){
                        
                        objects.side[i]=0;
                        
                    }
                    
                    else if(trueAngle>22.5 && trueAngle<=67.5){
                        
                        objects.side[i]=1;
                        
                    }
                    
                    else if(trueAngle>67.5 && trueAngle<=112.5){
                        
                        objects.side[i]=2;
                        
                    }
                    
                    else if(trueAngle>112.5 && trueAngle<=157.5){
                        
                        objects.side[i]=3;
                        
                    }
                    
                    else if(trueAngle>157.5 && trueAngle<=202.5){
                        
                        objects.side[i]=4;
                        
                    }
                    
                    else if(trueAngle>202.5 && trueAngle<=247.5){
                        
                        objects.side[i]=5;
                        
                    }
                    
                    else if(trueAngle>247.5 && trueAngle<=292.5){
                        
                        objects.side[i]=6;
                        
                    }
                    
                    else if(trueAngle>292.5 && trueAngle<=337.5){
                        
                        objects.side[i]=7;
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
                else{
                    
                    objects.side[i] = 0;
                    
                }
                
            }
            
        }
        
        //Create a new temp list
        var tempObjects={
            
            x:[],
            y:[],
            
            angle:[],
            
            transparency:[],
            
            verticalPos:[],
            
            animation:[],
            
            animationFrame:[],
            
            type:[],
            
            realDistances:[],
            
            playerDistances:[],
            
            cameraDistances:[],
            
            cameraAngles:[],
            
            side:[],
            
            inView:[],
            
            drawn:[],
            
        };
        
        //Now remove the ones not in view by adding only them to a temp array
        for(var i = 0; i <= objects.x.length-1; i++){
            
            if(objects.inView[i] && objects.cameraDistances[i]<=game.renderDistance && objects.verticalPos[i] + game.realHeight/2 >= primaryOrSecondary(objects.x[i],objects.y[i],'floor') && objects.verticalPos[i] + game.realHeight/2 <= primaryOrSecondary(objects.x[i],objects.y[i],'ceiling')){
                
                tempObjects.x.push(objects.x[i]);
                tempObjects.y.push(objects.y[i]);
                tempObjects.angle.push(objects.angle[i]);
                tempObjects.transparency.push(objects.transparency[i]);
                tempObjects.verticalPos.push(objects.verticalPos[i]);
                tempObjects.animation.push(objects.animation[i]);
                tempObjects.animationFrame.push(objects.animationFrame[i]);
                tempObjects.type.push(objects.type[i]);
                tempObjects.realDistances.push(objects.realDistances[i]);
                tempObjects.playerDistances.push(objects.playerDistances[i]);
                tempObjects.cameraDistances.push(objects.cameraDistances[i]);
                tempObjects.cameraAngles.push(objects.cameraAngles[i]);
                tempObjects.side.push(objects.side[i]);
                tempObjects.inView.push(objects.inView[i]);
                tempObjects.drawn.push(objects.drawn[i]);
                
            }
            
        }
        
        //Reset the object array
        objects.x=[];
        objects.y=[];
        
        objects.speedX=[];
        objects.speedY=[];
        
        objects.angle=[];
        
        objects.transparency=[];
        
        objects.verticalPos=[];
        
        objects.animation=[];
        
        objects.animationFrame=[];
        
        objects.type=[];
        
        objects.realDistances=[];
        
        objects.playerDistances=[];
        
        objects.cameraAngles=[];
        
        objects.cameraDistances=[];
        
        objects.inView=[];
        
        objects.drawn=[];
        
        objects.side = [];
        
        //Now recreate the object array with the objects in order
        for(var s = 0; s <= tempObjects.x.length-1; s++){
            
            //Reset variables for loop
            var farthestDistance=0;
            
            var i = 0;
            
            for(var o = 0; o <= tempObjects.x.length-1; o++){
                
                //Find which object is closest
                if(tempObjects.cameraDistances[o]>farthestDistance && !tempObjects.drawn[o]){
                    
                    farthestDistance=tempObjects.cameraDistances[o];
                    
                    i=o;
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            
            //Set variable to make sure the object isnt drawn again.
            tempObjects.drawn[i]=true;
            
            //Now we add info back to the object array
            objects.x.push(tempObjects.x[i]);
            objects.y.push(tempObjects.y[i]);
            objects.angle.push(tempObjects.angle[i]);
            objects.transparency.push(tempObjects.transparency[i]);
            objects.verticalPos.push(tempObjects.verticalPos[i]);
            objects.animation.push(tempObjects.animation[i]);
            objects.animationFrame.push(tempObjects.animationFrame[i]);
            objects.type.push(tempObjects.type[i]);
            objects.realDistances.push(tempObjects.realDistances[i]);
            objects.playerDistances.push(tempObjects.playerDistances[i]);
            objects.cameraDistances.push(tempObjects.cameraDistances[i]);
            objects.cameraAngles.push(tempObjects.cameraAngles[i]);
            objects.side.push(tempObjects.side[i]);
            objects.inView.push(true);
            objects.drawn.push(false);
            
        }
        
    }
    
};

//Check if a circle is being intersected
var hitCircle = function(centerX,centerY,originX,originY,directionX,directionY,radius,startX,startY){
    
    //Center of circle
    var center = [centerX,centerY];
    
    //Origin of ray
    var origin = [originX,originY];
    
    //Direction of ray
    var direction = [directionX,directionY];
    
    var d = sqrt(sq(directionX)+sq(directionY));
    
    direction[0] /= d;
    direction[1] /= d;
    
    //Relative origin
    var oc = [(center[0]-origin[0]),(center[1]-origin[1])];
    
    //componenets of the quadratic equation
    var a = sq(d);
    
    var h = direction[0]*oc[0] + direction[1]*oc[1];
    
    var c = sq(oc[0])+sq(oc[1]) - sq(radius);
    
    //Discriminant
    var discriminant = sq(h) - (a*c);
    
    //Distance the ray travels to intersect the circle
    var t = (h - sqrt(discriminant)) / a;
    
    direction[0] *= t;
    direction[1] *= t;
    
    //var int = PVector.add(origin,direction);
    var int = {x:origin[0]+direction[0],y:origin[1]+direction[1]};
    
    if(t < 0 || int.x !== int.x || int.y !== int.y){
        
        
        t = -1;
        
    }
    
    var tVec = [directionX,directionY];
    
    var start = [startX,startY];
    
    //var newTVal = start.dist(int);
    var newTVal = dist(start[0],start[1],int[0],int[1]);
    
    tVec[0]*=newTVal;
    tVec[1]*=newTVal;
    
    var cVec = [game.camera.dirX,game.camera.dirY];
    
    var newT = (tVec[0]*cVec[0] + tVec[1]*cVec[1]) / sqrt(sq(cVec[0])+sq(cVec[1]));
    
    return [t,int,newT];
    
    
};

//What position and speed you are given if you touch a line
var lineBoundaryReturn = function(x1,x2,y1,y2,n1,n2,px,py,vx,vy){
    
    //Total speed
    var s = dist(0,0,vx,vy);
    
    //The two slopes we'll use to check for intersection
    var a = (y2-y1)/(x2-x1);
    var b = vy/vx;

    //Find the x intercept
    var Ix = (py - y1 + (a*x1) - (b*px))/(a-b);
    
    var Iy = b * (Ix-px) + py;
    
    var t = (Ix-px)/(vx/s);
    
    if(abs(b) === Infinity){
        
        Ix = px;
        
        Iy = a * (px - x1) + y1;
        
        if(Iy === py){
            
            t = px-Ix;
            
        }
        
        else{
            
            t = (Iy-py)/(vy/s);
            
        }
        
    }
    
    if(abs(a) === Infinity){
        
        Ix = x1;
        
        Iy = b * (x1-px) + py;
        
        if(Iy === py){
            
            t = px-Ix;
            
        }
        
        else{
            
            t = (Iy-py)/(vy/s);
            
        }
        
    }
    
    
    //How much it will have to move to reach it
    
    //Set the normal (unit vector)
    var N = [n1,n2];
    
    var nd=dist(0,0,n1,n2);
    
    N[0]/=nd;
    N[1]/=nd;
    
    //Set the velocity vector
    var v = [vx,vy];
    
    //dot product
    var k = v[0]*N[0]+v[1]*N[1];
    
    //New vector to be applied 
    var c = [N[0]*k*1.0000001,N[1]*k*1.0000001];
    
    //New suggested velocity
    var vf = {x:v[0],y:v[1]};
    
    vf.x-=c[0];
    vf.y-=c[1];
    //stroke(255, 0, 0);
    
    //Figure out the range for the intersection
    var xl;
    var xr;
    
    if(x1<x2){
        
        xl = x1;
        xr = x2;
        
    }
    
    else{
        
        xl = x2;
        xr = x1;
        
    }
    
    var yl;
    var yr;
    
    if(y1<y2){
        
        yl = y1;
        yr = y2;
        
    }
    
    else{
        
        yl = y2;
        yr = y1;
        
    }
    
    var collision = ((t >= 0 || (t<0 && t>-0.5)) && t<s && ((xl<Ix && xr>Ix) || xl === xr) && ((yl<Iy && yr>Iy) || yl === yr) && k<0);
    
    return [collision,Ix,Iy,vf,t,s];
    
};

//What position and speed you are given if you touch a circle
var circleBoundaryReturn = function(x,y,r,a1,a2,px,py,vx,vy){
    
    //Find the intersection 
    var ans = hitCircle(x,y,px,py,vx,vy,r);
    
    //Find the player's total speed and make a vector out of it
    var s = dist(0,0,vx,vy);
    var v = [vx,vy];
    
    //Parse out the intersection
    var Ix = ans[1].x;
    var Iy = ans[1].y;
    var t = ans[0];
    
    //Normal Vector
    var N = [Ix - x,Iy - y];
    
    var nd = dist(0,0,N[0],N[1]);
    
    N[0]/=nd;
    N[1]/=nd;
    
    //dot product
    var k = v[0]*N[0] + v[1]*N[1];
    
    //New vector to be applied 
    var c = [N[0],N[1]];
    
    c[0]*= k*1.0000001;
    c[1]*= k*1.0000001;
    
    //New suggested velocity
    var vf = {x:v[0],y:v[1]};
    
    vf.x-=c[0];
    vf.y-=c[1];
    
    //figure out the limits for angles
    var aMin;
    var aMax;
    
    if(a1<a2){
        
        aMin = a1;
        aMax = a2;
        
    }
    
    else{
        
        aMin = a2;
        aMax = a1;
        
    }
    
    //Find the actual angles
    var ca = abs(atan2((Ix-x),(Iy-y))-180);
    
    var collision = ((t >= 0 || (t<0 && t>-0.1)) && t<s && ca >= aMin && ca <= aMax && k<=0);
    
    Ix += N[0]*0.1;
    Iy += N[1]*0.1;
    
    return [collision,Ix,Iy,vf,t,s];
    
};

//Turning a thin line into one that stops the player (returns info for line boundaries)
var constructLineBoundary = function(x1,x2,y1,y2,width){
    
    //Start and end
    var startR = new PVector(x1,y1);
    
    var endR = new PVector(x2,y2);
    
    //Direction vectors
    var normal = new PVector(-(y2-y1),x2-x1);
    
    var antiNormal = new PVector(y2-y1,-(x2-x1));
    
    var parallel = new PVector(x2-x1,y2-y1);
    
    var antiParallel = new PVector(-(x2-x1),-(y2-y1));
    
    //Make them as long as the boundary around the line
    normal.normalize();
    normal.mult(width);
    
    antiNormal.normalize();
    antiNormal.mult(width);
    
    parallel.normalize();
    parallel.mult(width);
    
    antiParallel.normalize();
    antiParallel.mult(width);
    
    //Create the start and end of each boundary
    var normL={
        
        s:PVector.add(PVector.add(startR,antiParallel),normal),
        e:PVector.add(PVector.add(endR,parallel),normal),
        n:normal,
        
    };
    
    var aNormL={
        
        s:PVector.add(PVector.add(startR,antiParallel),antiNormal),
        e:PVector.add(PVector.add(endR,parallel),antiNormal),
        n:antiNormal,
        
    };
    
    var parL={
        
        s:PVector.add(PVector.add(endR,parallel),normal),
        e:PVector.add(PVector.add(endR,parallel),antiNormal),
        n:parallel,
        
    };
    
    var aParL={
        
        s:PVector.add(PVector.add(startR,antiParallel),normal),
        e:PVector.add(PVector.add(startR,antiParallel),antiNormal),
        n:antiParallel,
        
    };
    
    return [[normL.s,normL.e,normL.n],[aNormL.s,aNormL.e,aNormL.n],[parL.s,parL.e,parL.n],[aParL.s,aParL.e,aParL.n],];
    
};

//Add a new boundary to the list
var addBoundary = function(x1,y1,x2,y2,normal,radius,ang1,ang2,type,tile,check,oWidth){
    
    var dupe = false;
    
    if(check){
        
        for(var s = boundaries.x1.length-1; s >= 0; s--){
            
            if(boundaries.x1.length-1>0){
                
                s = constrain(s,-1,boundaries.x1.length-1);
                
            }
            
            else{
                
                break;
                
            }
            
            //Make sure we aren't checking something against itself
            if(!(tile[0] === boundaries.tile[s][0] && tile[1] === boundaries.tile[s][1])){
                
                //If we find a set of lines
                if(type === 'line' && boundaries.type[s] === 'line' && (normal[0] === 0 || normal[1]===0) && (boundaries.normal[s][0] === 0 || boundaries.normal[s][1]===0) && (abs(normal[0]) === 1 || abs(normal[1])===1) && (abs(boundaries.normal[s][0]) === 1 || abs(boundaries.normal[s][1]) === 1) && !(boundaries.normal[s][0]===normal[0] && boundaries.normal[s][1]===normal[1])){
                    
                    //var normalILength = dist(0,0,boundaries.normal[i][0],boundaries.normal[i][1]);
                    //var normalSLength = dist(0,0,boundaries.normal[s][0],boundaries.normal[s][1]);
                    
                    var x1I = x1 - (normal[0])*(oWidth/2);
                    var x2I = x2 - (normal[0])*(oWidth/2);
                    var x1S = boundaries.x1[s] - (boundaries.normal[s][0])*(oWidth/2);
                    var x2S = boundaries.x2[s] - (boundaries.normal[s][0])*(oWidth/2);
                    var y1I = y1 - (normal[1])*(oWidth/2);
                    var y2I = y2 - (normal[1])*(oWidth/2);
                    var y1S = boundaries.y1[s] - (boundaries.normal[s][1])*(oWidth/2);
                    var y2S = boundaries.y2[s] - (boundaries.normal[s][1])*(oWidth/2);
                    
                    var minIX = min(x1I,x2I);
                    var maxIX = max(x1I,x2I);
                    var minSX = min(x1S,x2S);
                    var maxSX = max(x1S,x2S);
                    var minIY = min(y1I,y2I); 
                    var maxIY = max(y1I,y2I);
                    var minSY = min(y1S,y2S);
                    var maxSY = max(y1S,y2S);
                    
                    //println((minIX === minSX) +', ' + (maxIX === maxSX) +', ' + (minIY === minSY) +', ' + (maxIY === maxSY));
                    
                    if(minIX === minSX && maxIX === maxSX && minIY === minSY && maxIY === maxSY){
                        
                        boundaries.x1.splice(s,1);
                        boundaries.y1.splice(s,1);
                        boundaries.x2.splice(s,1);
                        boundaries.y2.splice(s,1);
                        boundaries.normal.splice(s,1);
                        boundaries.radius.splice(s,1);
                        boundaries.ang1.splice(s,1);
                        boundaries.ang2.splice(s,1);
                        boundaries.type.splice(s,1);
                        boundaries.tile.splice(s,1);
                        
                        dupe = true;
                        break;
                        
                    }
                    
                    else{
                        
                        //println((minIX === minSX) +', ' + (maxIX === maxSX) +', ' + (minIY === minSY) +', ' + (maxIY === maxSY));
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
            }
            
        }
        
    }
    
    if(!dupe){
        
        boundaries.x1.push(x1);
        boundaries.y1.push(y1);
        boundaries.x2.push(x2);
        boundaries.y2.push(y2);
        boundaries.normal.push(normal);
        boundaries.radius.push(radius);
        boundaries.ang1.push(ang1);
        boundaries.ang2.push(ang2);
        boundaries.type.push(type);
        boundaries.tile.push(tile);
        
    }
    
};

//Combine boundaries and stop things from moving through them
var checkBoundaries = function(ix,iy,vx,vy,top,bottom,oWidth,stairs,restrictEnemies,restrictPlayer){
    
    var collision = true;
    var loops = 0;
    var lastTagged = -1;
    
    var lastX = ix;
    var lastY = iy;
    
    var rloops = 0;
    
    //Check if there are solid surfaces adjacent to the hitbox
    
    //Set values to check
    var minX = 0;
    var maxX = 0;
    
    var minY = 0;
    var maxY = 0;
    
    var ox = floor(ix/20);
    var oy = floor(iy/20);
    
    var nx = floor((ix + vx*game.deltaF)/20);
    var ny = floor((iy + vy*game.deltaF)/20);
    
    if(ox<=nx){
        
        minX = ox-1;
        maxX = nx+1;
        
    }
    
    else{
        
        minX = nx-1;
        maxX = ox+1;
        
    }
    
    if(oy<=ny){
        
        minY = oy-1;
        maxY = ny+1;
        
    }
    
    else{
        
        minY = ny-1;
        maxY = oy+1;
        
    }
    
    minX = constrain(minX,0,loadedMap.boundaries[0].length-1);
    maxX = constrain(maxX,0,loadedMap.boundaries[0].length-1);
    minY = constrain(minY,0,loadedMap.boundaries.length-1);
    maxY = constrain(maxY,0,loadedMap.boundaries.length-1);
    
    //Clear boundaries
    boundaries.x1 = [];
    boundaries.y1 = [];
    boundaries.x2 = [];
    boundaries.y2 = [];
    boundaries.normal = [];
    boundaries.radius = [];
    boundaries.ang1 = [];
    boundaries.ang2 = [];
    boundaries.type = [];
    boundaries.tile = [];
    
    var index = [];
    
    //Add the boundaries based on the grid
    for(var y = minY; y <= maxY; y++){
        
        for(var x = minX; x <= maxX; x++){
            
            //println('x: ' + x);
            
            if(loadedMap.boundaries[y][x] === 1){
                
                if(loadedMap.doors[y][x] === 0){
                    
                    switch(loadedMap.shape[y][x]){
                        
                        case 0:
                            
                            {
                                
                                
                                //Left
                                addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20 -oWidth/2,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[-1,0],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                                
                                //Right
                                addBoundary(x*20+20 +oWidth/2,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[1,0],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                                
                                //Up
                                addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2,y*20 -oWidth/2,[0,-1],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                                
                                //Down
                                addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[0,1],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                                
                            }
                            
                            break;
                        
                        case 1:
                            
                            {
                                
                                //Left
                                addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20 -oWidth/2,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[-1,0],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                                
                                //Right
                                addBoundary(x*20+20 +oWidth/2,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2,y*20 +oWidth/2,[1,0],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                                
                                //Up
                                addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2,y*20 -oWidth/2,[0,-1],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                                
                                //Down
                                addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,x*20 +oWidth/2,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[0,1],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                                
                                //Diagonal
                                addBoundary(x*20 +oWidth/2,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2,y*20 +oWidth/2,[0.7071067811865475,0.7071067811865475],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],false,oWidth);
                                
                            }
                            
                            break;
                        
                        case 2:
                            
                            {
                                
                                //Left
                                addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20 -oWidth/2,y*20 +oWidth/2,[-1,0],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                                
                                //Right
                                addBoundary(x*20+20 +oWidth/2,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[1,0],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                                
                                //Up
                                addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2,y*20 -oWidth/2,[0,-1],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                                
                                //Down
                                addBoundary(x*20+20 -oWidth/2,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[0,1],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                                
                                //Diagonal
                                addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2,y*20 +oWidth/2,x*20+20 -oWidth/2,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[-0.7071067811865475,0.7071067811865475],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],false);
                                
                            }
                            
                            break;
                        
                        case 3:
                            
                            {
                                
                                //Left

                        case 27:

                        case 28:
                            
                            {

                    }
                    
                }
                
                else{
                    
                    var doorOpen = tempMap.doorOpen[y][x];
                    
                    switch(loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[y][x]].type){
                        
                        //Slide Left and Right
                        case 0:

                    if(tempMap.floorHeight[y][x] > bottom){
                        
                        //Left
                        addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+10 +oWidth/2,[-1,0],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                        //Right
                        addBoundary(x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+10 +oWidth/2,[1,0],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                        //Up
                        addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 -oWidth/2,[0,-1],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                        //Down
                        addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+10 +oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+10 +oWidth/2,[0,1],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                            
                        }
                    
                    if(tempMap.floorSecondaryHeight[y][x] > bottom){
                        
                        //Left
                        addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+10 -oWidth/2,x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[-1,0],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                        //Right
                        addBoundary(x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+10 -oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[1,0],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                        //Up
                        addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+10 -oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+10 -oWidth/2,[0,-1],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                        //Down
                        addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[0,1],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                    }
                    
                    break;
                    
            }
            
            //Ceiling
            switch(loadedMap.ceilingShape[y][x]){
                
                default:
                    
                    if(tempMap.ceilingHeight[y][x] < top){
                        
                        addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[-1,0],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                        addBoundary(x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[1,0],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                        addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 -oWidth/2,[0,-1],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                        addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[0,1],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                    }
                    
                    break;
                
                case 1:
                    
                    if(tempMap.ceilingHeight[y][x] < top){
                        
                        //Left
                        addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[-1,0],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                        //Right
                        addBoundary(x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 +oWidth/2,[1,0],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                        //Up
                        addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 -oWidth/2,[0,-1],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                        //Down
                        addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,x*20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[0,1],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                        //Diagonal
                        addBoundary(x*20 +oWidth/2,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2,y*20 +oWidth/2,[1,1],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                    }
                    
                    if(tempMap.ceilingSecondaryHeight[y][x] < top){
                        
                        //Left
                        addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 -oWidth/2,x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[-1,0],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                        //Right
                        addBoundary(x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[1,0],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                        //Up
                        addBoundary(x*20+20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 -oWidth/2,[0,-1],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                        //Down
                        addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[0,1],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                        //Diagonal
                        addBoundary(x*20 +20 -oWidth/2,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20 -oWidth/2,y*20+20 -oWidth/2,[-1,-1],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                    }

                case 2:

                        addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 +oWidth/2,[-1,0],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                        //Right
                        addBoundary(x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[1,0],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);

                        addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 -oWidth/2,[0,-1],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);

                        addBoundary(x*20+20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[0,1],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                        //Diagonal
                        addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2,y*20 +oWidth/2,x*20+20 -oWidth/2,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[-1,1],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);

                    if(tempMap.ceilingSecondaryHeight[y][x] < top){

                            addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[-1,0],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                            
                            //Right
                            addBoundary(x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 -oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[1,0],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                            
                            //Up
                            addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 -oWidth/2,[0,-1],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                            
                            //Down
                            addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[0,1],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                            
                            //Diagonal
                            addBoundary(x*20 +oWidth/2,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2,y*20+20 -oWidth/2,[1,-1],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                            
                        }

                case 3:

                        addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20 -oWidth/2,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[-1,0],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                        //Right
                        addBoundary(x*20+10 +oWidth/2,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20+10 +oWidth/2,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[1,0],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);

                        addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20+10 +oWidth/2,y*20 -oWidth/2,[0,-1],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);

                    }

                        addBoundary(x*20+10 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20+10 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[-1,0],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                        //Right
                        addBoundary(x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[1,0],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                        //Up
                        addBoundary(x*20+10 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 -oWidth/2,[0,-1],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                        //Down
                        addBoundary(x*20+10 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[0,1],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);

                case 4:

                        addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+10 +oWidth/2,[-1,0],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                        //Right
                        addBoundary(x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+10 +oWidth/2,[1,0],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                        //Up
                        addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 -oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20 -oWidth/2,[0,-1],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                        //Down
                        addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+10 +oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+10 +oWidth/2,[0,1],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                            
                        }
                    
                    if(tempMap.ceilingSecondaryHeight[y][x] < top){
                        
                        //Left
                        addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+10 -oWidth/2,x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[-1,0],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                        //Right
                        addBoundary(x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+10 -oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[1,0],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                        //Up
                        addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+10 -oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+10 -oWidth/2,[0,-1],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                        //Down
                        addBoundary(x*20 -oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,x*20+20 +oWidth/2+0.001,y*20+20 +oWidth/2,[0,1],0,0,0,'line',[x,y],true,oWidth);
                        
                    }
                    
                    break;
                    
            }
            
        }
        
    }
    
    if(restrictEnemies){
        
        for(var e = 0; e <= enemies.x.length-1; e++){
            
            if(!enemies.dud[e] && top >= enemies.verticalPos[e] && bottom <= enemies.verticalPos[e] + enemyConstants[enemies.type[e]].height){
                
                //circle
                addBoundary(enemies.x[e],enemies.y[e],0,0,[1,1],enemyConstants[enemies.type[e]].width/2+oWidth/2,-1,360,'circle',[floor(enemies.x[e]/20),floor(enemies.y[e]/20)],false);
                
            }
        }
        
    }
    
    if(restrictPlayer){
        
        //circle
        addBoundary(player.x,player.y,0,0,[1,1],player.width/2+oWidth/2,-1,360,'circle',[floor(player.x/20),floor(player.x/20)],false);
        
    }
    
    var impact = false;
    
    while(collision){
        
        collision = false;
        
        var l = dist(0,0,vx,vy);
        
        var tList = [];
        var tID = [];
        
        //Player collision
        
        for(var i = 0; i <= boundaries.x1.length-1; i++){
            
            if(boundaries.type[i] === 'line'){
                
                var answer = lineBoundaryReturn(boundaries.x1[i],boundaries.x2[i],boundaries.y1[i],boundaries.y2[i],boundaries.normal[i][0],boundaries.normal[i][1],ix,iy,vx*game.deltaF,vy*game.deltaF);
                
                if(answer[0]){
                    
                    tList.push(answer);
                    tID.push(i);
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            if(boundaries.type[i] === 'circle'){
                
                var answer = circleBoundaryReturn(boundaries.x1[i],boundaries.y1[i],boundaries.radius[i],boundaries.ang1[i],boundaries.ang2[i],ix,iy,vx*game.deltaF,vy*game.deltaF);
                
                if(answer[0]){
                    
                    tList.push(answer);
                    tID.push(i);
                    
                }
                
            }
            
        }
        
        var bestT = Infinity;
        var bestI = -1;
        
        for (var i = 0; i <= tList.length-1; i++){
            
            if(tList[i][4]<bestT && tID[i] !== lastTagged){
                
                bestT = tList[i][4];
                
                bestI = i;
                
            }
            
        }
        
        if(tList.length > 0 && bestI > -1){
            
            //if(dist(ix,iy,lastX,lastY)>=1){
            
            ix = tList[bestI][1];
            iy = tList[bestI][2];
            
            lastX = ix;
            lastY = iy;
            
            vx = tList[bestI][3].x/game.deltaF;
            vy = tList[bestI][3].y/game.deltaF;
            
            lastTagged = tID[bestI];
            
            collision = true;
            
            impact = true;
            
            
        }
        
        //lastTagged = tID[bestI];
        
        loops ++;
        
        if(stairs && loops>2 && dist(0,0,vx,vy)<player.maxSpeed/2){
            
            collision = false;
            
            vx = 0;
            vy = 0;
            
        }
        
        if(loops>10){
            
            collision = false;
            
            vx = 0;
            vy = 0;
            
        }
        
    }
    
    
    //println('end');
    
    //println(game.globalTimer);
    
    //if(restrictEnemies){println(rloops);println(boundaries.x1.length);println(enemies.x.length);}
    
    return [ix,iy,vx,vy,impact];
    
};
