//How do you draw a wall
var drawWall = function(x,ty,by,minY,maxY,d,t,l,lerp,wallX){
    
    
    noStroke();
    rectMode(CORNER);
    
    var texture = loadedMap.assets.walls.textures[t];
    var colors = loadedMap.assets.walls.color;
    
    wallX = constrain(wallX,0,0.999);
    
    var texX = floor((texture.length)*wallX);
    
    //if(x===game.width/2){println(texX);}
    
    switch(loadedMap.assets.walls.scaling[t]){
        
        case 'stretch':
            
            //Find height and middle point
            var v = ty-by;
            
            var m = by + v/2;
            
            //Find max and min of texture
            var highest = -Infinity;
            var lowest = Infinity;
            
            for(var y = 0; y <= texture[texX].length-1; y++){
                
                var higher = max(texture[texX][y][0],texture[texX][y][1]);
                var lower = min(texture[texX][y][0],texture[texX][y][1]);
                
                highest=max(higher,highest);
                lowest=min(lower,lowest);
                
            }
            
            //dif between highest and lowest part of texture
            var texHeight = highest-lowest;
            
            //Ratio of texture height and drawn height
            var ratio = abs(v/texHeight);
            
            //Draw texture
            for(var y = 0; y <= texture[texX].length-1; y++){
                
                //Set color
                var rayColor = color(255, 0, 255);
                
                //Has transparency value
                if(colors[texture[texX][y][2]].length>3){
                    
                    rayColor = color(colors[texture[texX][y][2]][0]*l,colors[texture[texX][y][2]][1]*l,colors[texture[texX][y][2]][2]*l,colors[texture[texX][y][2]][3]*255);
                    
                }
                
                //No transparency value
                else{
                    
                    rayColor = color(colors[texture[texX][y][2]][0]*l,colors[texture[texX][y][2]][1]*l,colors[texture[texX][y][2]][2]*l);
                    
                }
                
                rayColor=lerpColor(rayColor,color(0,0,0),1-lerp);
                
                fill(rayColor);
                
                
                var low = min(-texture[texX][y][1],-texture[texX][y][0]);
                var high = max(-texture[texX][y][1],-texture[texX][y][0]);
                
                var yl = (high-low)*ratio;
                
                var c = m + low*ratio;
                
                if(c<maxY && c+yl>minY){
                    
                    if(c<minY){
                        
                        yl -= minY-c;
                        
                    }
                    
                    c = max(c,minY);
                    
                    yl = min(yl,abs(maxY-c));
                    
                    if(maxY>c){
                        
                        rect(x,c-0.1,1,yl+0.2);
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            break;
            
        case 'top':
            
            
            //Find height and middle point
            
            //Find max and min of texture
            var highest = -Infinity;
            var lowest = Infinity;
            
            for(var y = 0; y <= texture[texX].length-1; y++){
                
                var higher = max(texture[texX][y][0],texture[texX][y][1]);
                var lower = min(texture[texX][y][0],texture[texX][y][1]);
                
                highest=max(higher,highest);
                lowest=min(lower,lowest);
                
            }
            
            //dif between highest and lowest part of texture
            var texHeight = highest-lowest;
            
            var m = by + texHeight/(2*d);
            
            //Draw texture
            for(var y = 0; y <= texture[texX].length-1; y++){
                
                //Set color
                var rayColor = color(255, 0, 255);
                
                //Has transparency value
                if(colors[texture[texX][y][2]].length>3){
                    
                    rayColor = color(colors[texture[texX][y][2]][0]*l,colors[texture[texX][y][2]][1]*l,colors[texture[texX][y][2]][2]*l,colors[texture[texX][y][2]][3]*255);
                    
                }
                
                //No transparency value
                else{
                    
                    rayColor = color(colors[texture[texX][y][2]][0]*l,colors[texture[texX][y][2]][1]*l,colors[texture[texX][y][2]][2]*l);
                    
                }
                
                rayColor=lerpColor(rayColor,color(0,0,0),1-lerp);
                
                fill(rayColor);
                
                
                var low = min(-texture[texX][y][1],-texture[texX][y][0]);
                var high = max(-texture[texX][y][1],-texture[texX][y][0]);
                
                var yl = (high-low)/d;
                
                var c = m + low/d;
                
                if(c<ty && c+yl>by && c<maxY && c+yl>minY){
                    
                    if(c<by && c<minY){
                        
                        yl -= by-c;
                        
                    }
                    
                    c = max(c,by);
                    
                    c = max(c,minY);
                    
                    yl = min(yl,abs(ty-c));
                    yl = min(yl,abs(maxY-c));
                    
                    if(ty>c){
                        
                        rect(x,c-0.1,1,yl+0.2);
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            break;
        
        case 'bottom':
            
            /*
            tbd
            //Find height and middle point

            var m = by + v/2;

            break;
        
    }
    
};

//Iterable Raycast Function
var drawRayCast=function(x,ox,oy,dx,dy,mapX,mapY,minY,maxY,floorHeight,ceilingHeight,priorDist,depth,hs,dz,ih){
    
    /**Set Initial Vars**/
    
    //Quick variable to use for the center line for testing
    var cs = game.width/2 === x;
    
    //Stop recursion if we do it too many times
    if(depth>20){
        
        return;
        
    }
    
    depth++;
    
    var hitScanReturn = {
        
        //Distance the ray traveled
        t:0,
        
        //Where it stopped on the gorund or ceiling or wall
        x:0,
        y:0,
        z:0,
        
        //normals
        nx:0,
        ny:0,
        nz:0,
        
        //Which objects have been hit
        hits:[],
        
        //What map tile it hit
        mapX:0,
        mapY:0,
        
    };  
    
    //if(cs){println('recursion ' + ceilingHeight + ', ' + depth);}
    
    //Information about the current ray
    var ray={
        
        //Position
        posX:ox/20,
        posY:oy/20,
        
        //Direction Vector
        dirX:dx,
        dirY:dy,
        
        //Map position taken up by ray
        mapX:mapX,
        mapY:mapY,
        
        //Length of the ray from the current position to the next side
        sideDistX:0,
        sideDistY:0,
        
        //Length of ray from one x-side to the next y-side
        deltaDistX:0,
        delatDistY:0,
        
        //Perpendicular Wall Distance
        perpWallDist:0,
        
        //What direction to step in
        stepX:0,
        stepY:0,
        
        //Has a wall been hit?
        hit:false,
        
        //Was a verticle or horizontal wall hit?
        side:0,
        
        //How tall the line will be
        lineHeight:0,
        
        //Last floor/ceiling line dist from player
        lastDist:0,
        
        //last floor
        lastFloor:0,
        lastBrightness:0,
        
        //Drawing pixels
        drawStart:0,
        drawEnd:200,
        
        //Wall X position
        wallX:0,
        
        //What color the wall will be
        color:0,
        
        //What the default lerp is
        lerp:0,
        
    };
    
    ray.hit=false;
    
    //Check for three things, a wall, a change in floor height, and a change in ceiling height
    var wallVars={
        
        hit:false,
        
    };
    
    var floorVars={
        
        hit:false,
        
    };
    
    var ceilingVars={
        
        hit:false,
        
    };
    
    var farthest={
        
        hit:false,
        
    };
    
    ray.deltaDistX=sqrt(1+(ray.dirY*ray.dirY)/(ray.dirX*ray.dirX));
    ray.deltaDistY=sqrt(1+(ray.dirX*ray.dirX)/(ray.dirY*ray.dirY));
    
    ray.lastDist=0;
    
    //if(cs){println('initial calc: ' + ray.dirX + ', ' + ray.dirY + ', ' +  ray.deltaDistX + ',' + ray.deltaDistY);}
    
    //hitscan vars
    var fht = -1;
    var fhfx = 0;
    var fhfy = 0;
    
    var cht = -1;
    var chfx = 0;
    var chfy = 0;
    
    var ht = -1;
    var hfx = 0;
    var hfy = 0;
    var hfz = 0;
    var hfc = 'neither';
    
    var normXHS = 0;
    var normYHS = 0;
    
    //Calculate the intial step and side step
    if(ray.dirX < 0){
        
        ray.stepX=-1;
        
        ray.sideDistX=(ray.posX - ray.mapX) * ray.deltaDistX;
        
    }
    
    else{
        
        ray.stepX=1;
        
        ray.sideDistX=(ray.mapX + 1.0 - ray.posX) * ray.deltaDistX;
        
    }
    
    if(ray.dirY < 0){
        
        ray.stepY=-1;
        
        ray.sideDistY=(ray.posY - ray.mapY) * ray.deltaDistY;
        
    }
    
    else{
        
        ray.stepY=1;
        
        ray.sideDistY=(ray.mapY + 1.0 - ray.posY) * ray.deltaDistY;
        
    }
    
    var limit = false;
    
    //Set up our initial look up table for objects
    if(objectList.setup){
        
        objectList.drawn = [];
        objectList.closestPoint = [];
        objectList.index = [];
        
        for(var i = 0; i <= objects.x.length-1; i++){
            
            //Ray Next Position
            var rayNextX=game.camera.x+ray.dirX;
            var rayNextY=game.camera.y+ray.dirY;
            
            //Check if the line intersects
            var closestPointToLine = (rayNextX-game.camera.x) * objects.y[i] + (game.camera.y-rayNextY)*objects.x[i] + (game.camera.x-rayNextX) * game.camera.y + (rayNextY-game.camera.y) * game.camera.x;
            
            if(abs(closestPointToLine)<objectConstants[objects.type[i]].widths[objects.animation[i]][objects.animationFrame[i]][objects.side[i]]/2){
                
                objectList.drawn.push(false);
                objectList.closestPoint.push(closestPointToLine);
                objectList.index.push(i);
                
            }
            
        }
        
        objectList.setup = false;
        
    }

        if(h > -game.height/2 && horizon<game.height+4 && start<end && game.camera.height*(game.realHeight/game.height)+300 > currentHeight){

                    drawnEnd = y;

                    var scale=(currentDist) / (distance);
                    
                    scale = constrain(scale,0,0.9999);
                    
                    var currentFloorX=ox+(difX*scale);
                    var currentFloorY=oy+(difY*scale);
                    
                    //var currentFloorX=game.camera.x+ray.dirX*currentDist*20;

                    //Draw floor
                    {

                        if(loadedMap.assets.floors.type[loadedMap.floorLayout[floor(currentFloorY/20)][floor(currentFloorX/20)]]==="texture"){

                        if(y === start ){

                            if(loadedMap.assets.floors.type[lastLayoutFloor]==="texture"){

                            }

                        }
                        
                        //Define Current Varibles
                        {

    //Set variables based on shape of wall
    var checkHitWall = function(type){
        
        var lineIntersect = function(x1,y1,x2,y2,sx,sy,dx,dy){
            
            //Return Variables
            var rx;
            var ry;
            var d;
            var wallX;
            var hit = true;
            
            if(abs(dx) < 0.0001){
                
                dx = 0;
                
            }
            
            if(abs(dy) < 0.0001){
                
                dy = 0;
                
            }
            
            //Calc equations of line seg
            
            //Find slope of target
            var b;
            
            if(x1 === x2){
                
                //Vertical line
                b = false;
                
            }
            
            else{
                
                //Regular line
                b = (y2-y1)/(x2-x1);
                
            }
            
            //Find rx
            
            //Check special conditions
            if(dx === 0){
                
                rx = sx;
                
            }
            //If we have a slope on the camera view
            else{
                
                var a = dy/dx;
                
                if(b !== false){
                    
                    rx = (-b*x1 + y1 + a*sx -sy)/(a-b);
                    
                }
                
                else{
                    
                    rx = x1;
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            //Find ry
            
            //Based on b
            if(b !== false){
                
                ry = b*(rx-x1)+y1;
                
            }
            //If b is vertical
            else if(dx !== 0){
                
                var a = dy/dx;
                
                ry = a * (x1 - sx) + sy;
                
            }
            
            //If both are vertical (maybe add one if they're lined up?)
            else{
                
                hit = false;
                
            }
            
            //check if the player is facing it
            var k = 0;
            
            if(hit){
                
                k = dx*(rx-sx) + dy*(ry-sy);
                
            }
            
            //Check if it is in the range
            var maxX = max(x1,x2);
            var minX = min(x1,x2);
            
            var maxY = max(y1,y2);
            var minY = min(y1,y2);
            
            if(rx > maxX || rx < minX || ry > maxY || ry < minY || k<0){
                
                hit = false;
                
            }
            
            //Find dist and wallX
            if(hit){
                
                //d
                if(dx !== 0){
                    
                    d = (rx - sx) / ray.dirX;
                    
                }
                else{
                    
                    d = (ry - sy) / ray.dirY;
                    
                }
                
                //wallX
                if(x1!==x2){
                    
                    wallX = (rx - minX) / (maxX-minX);
                    
                }
                
                else{
                    
                    wallX = (ry - minY) / (maxY-minY);
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            return [hit,rx,ry,d,wallX];
            
        };
        
        var circleIntersect = function(cx,cy,sx,sy,dx,dy,radius,x1,y1,x2,y2){
            
            var hit = false;
            var hit2 = false;
            
            //Center of circle
            var center = [cx,cy];
            
            //Origin of ray
            var origin = [sx,sy];
            
            //Direction of ray
            var direction = [dx,dy];
            
            var d = sqrt(sq(dx)+sq(dy));
            
            direction[0] /= d;
            direction[1] /= d;
            
            //Relative origin
            var oc = [(center[0]-origin[0]),(center[1]-origin[1])];
            
            //componenets of the quadratic equation
            var a = 1;
            
            var h = direction[0]*oc[0] + direction[1]*oc[1];
            
            var c = sq(oc[0])+sq(oc[1]) - sq(radius);
            
            //Discriminant
            var discriminant = sq(h) - (a*c);
            
            //Distance the ray travels to intersect the circle
            var t = (h - sqrt(discriminant)) / a;
            var t2 = (h + sqrt(discriminant)) / a;
            
            var direction2 = [direction[0]*t2,direction[1]*t2];
            
            direction[0] *= t;
            direction[1] *= t;
            
            //var int = PVector.add(origin,direction);
            var int = {x:origin[0]+direction[0],y:origin[1]+direction[1]};
            
            //var int = PVector.add(origin,direction);
            var int2 = {x:origin[0]+direction2[0],y:origin[1]+direction2[1]};
            
            if(t < 0 || int.x-ray.mapX < x1 || int.y-ray.mapY < y1 || int.x-ray.mapX > x2 || int.y-ray.mapY > y2 || discriminant < 0){
                
                
                t = -1;
                
            }
            
            else{
                
                hit = true;
                
            }
            
            if(t2< 0 || int2.x-ray.mapX < x1 || int2.y-ray.mapY < y1 || int2.x-ray.mapX > x2 || int2.y-ray.mapY > y2 || discriminant <= 0){
                
                
                t2 = -1;
                
            }
            
            else{
                
                hit2 = true;
                
            }
            
            var tVec = [dx,dy];
            
            var wallX = acos(constrain(int.x-cx,-1,1))/90;
            var wallX2 = acos(constrain(int2.x-cx,-1,1))/90;
            
            //var newTVal = start.dist(int);
            var newTVal = (int.x-sx)*game.camera.normX + (int.y-sy)*game.camera.normY;
            var newTVal2 = (int2.x-sx)*game.camera.normX + (int2.y-sy)*game.camera.normY;
            
            return [hit,int.x,int.y,newTVal*1.25,wallX,hit2,int2.x,int2.y,newTVal2*1.25,wallX2]; 
            
            
        };
        
        //Wall
        if(type === 'wall'){
            
            var returnWalls = {
                
                x:[],
                y:[],
                d:[],
                t:[],
                l:[],
                lerp:[],
                wallX:[],
                hit:false,
                
            };
            
            var doorType;
            
            //Check info about door
            if(loadedMap.doors[ray.mapY][ray.mapX] !== 0){
                
                doorType = loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[ray.mapY][ray.mapX]].type;
                
            }
            
            //If there is no door
            if(loadedMap.doors[ray.mapY][ray.mapX] === 0 || (loadedMap.doors[ray.mapY][ray.mapX] !== 0 && (doorType === 7 || doorType === 8))){
                
                var shape = constrain(loadedMap.shape[ray.mapY][ray.mapX],0,wallShapes.length-1);
                
                var layout = loadedMap.layout[ray.mapY][ray.mapX];
                
                var trans = loadedMap.assets.walls.transparent[layout];
                //var trans=true;
                
                var rx=[];
                var ry=[];
                var d=[];
                var wallX=[];
                var l=[];
                var lerp=[];
                
                for(var i = 0; i <= wallShapes[shape].length-1; i++){
                    
                    if(wallShapes[shape][i].type === 'line'){
                        
                        var currentLine = wallShapes[shape][i];
                        
                        var r = lineIntersect(ray.mapX + currentLine.x1,ray.mapY + currentLine.y1,ray.mapX + currentLine.x2,ray.mapY + currentLine.y2,ox/20,oy/20,ray.dirX,ray.dirY);
                        
                        //If we hit a wall
                        if(r[0]){
                            
                            rx.push(r[1]);
                            ry.push(r[2]);
                            d.push(r[3]);
                            wallX.push(r[4]);
                            lerp.push(currentLine.lerp);
                            
                            var ly = constrain(ray.mapY + currentLine.ly,0,tempMap.lighting.length-1);
                            var lx = constrain(ray.mapX + currentLine.lx,0,tempMap.lighting[ly].length-1);
                            
                            l.push(tempMap.lighting[ly][lx]);
                            
                            //stroke(255,0,0);
                            //line(x,200/r[3] + game.height/2,x,-200/r[3] + game.height/2);
                            
                            returnWalls.hit = true;
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    if(wallShapes[shape][i].type === 'circle'){
                        
                        var currentCircle = wallShapes[shape][i];
                        //cx,cy,sx,sy,dx,dy,radius,x1,y1,x2,y2
                        var r = circleIntersect(ray.mapX+currentCircle.cx,ray.mapY+currentCircle.cy,ox/20,oy/20,ray.dirX,ray.dirY,currentCircle.r,currentCircle.x1,currentCircle.y1,currentCircle.x2,currentCircle.y2);
                        
                        //if(cs){println(r);}
                        
                        //If we hit a wall
                        if(r[0]){
                            
                            rx.push(r[1]);
                            ry.push(r[2]);
                            d.push(r[3]);
                            wallX.push(r[4]);
                            lerp.push(currentCircle.lerp);
                            
                            var ly = constrain(ray.mapY + currentCircle.ly,0,tempMap.lighting.length-1);
                            var lx = constrain(ray.mapX + currentCircle.lx,0,tempMap.lighting[ly].length-1);
                            
                            l.push(tempMap.lighting[ly][lx]);
                            
                            returnWalls.hit = true;
                            
                        }
                        
                        //If we hit a wall
                        if(r[5]){
                            
                            rx.push(r[6]);
                            ry.push(r[7]);
                            d.push(r[8]);
                            wallX.push(r[9]);
                            lerp.push(currentCircle.lerp);
                            
                            var ly = constrain(ray.mapY + currentCircle.ly,0,tempMap.lighting.length-1);
                            var lx = constrain(ray.mapX + currentCircle.lx,0,tempMap.lighting[ly].length-1);
                            
                            l.push(tempMap.lighting[ly][lx]);
                            
                            returnWalls.hit = true;
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
                //Only add the nearest wall if they aren't transparent
                if(!trans){
                    
                    //Find Closest
                    var closestVal = Infinity;
                    var closestI = -1;
                    
                    for(var e = 0; e <= d.length-1; e++){
                        
                        if(d[e] < closestVal){
                            
                            closestVal = d[e];
                            closestI = e;
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    if(closestI>-1){
                        
                        returnWalls.x.push(rx[closestI]);
                        returnWalls.y.push(ry[closestI]);
                        returnWalls.d.push(d[closestI]);
                        returnWalls.t.push(loadedMap.layout[ray.mapY][ray.mapX]);
                        returnWalls.l.push(l[closestI]);
                        returnWalls.lerp.push(lerp[closestI]);
                        returnWalls.wallX.push(wallX[closestI]);
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
                //If they are, add them all
                else{
                    
                    returnWalls.x=rx.slice();
                    returnWalls.y=ry.slice();
                    returnWalls.d=d.slice();
                    returnWalls.wallX=wallX.slice();
                    returnWalls.lerp = lerp.slice();
                    returnWalls.l= l.slice();
                    
                    for(var e = 0; e <= rx.length-1; e++){
                        
                        returnWalls.t.push(loadedMap.layout[ray.mapY][ray.mapX]);
                        
                        
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            //Ignore the shape if there is a door

                            var r = lineIntersect(ray.mapX+1,ray.mapY,ray.mapX+1-cos(90*doorOpen),ray.mapY+ sin(90*doorOpen),ox/20,oy/20,ray.dirX,ray.dirY);

                                }

                                rlerp.push(0.8);

                                rlerp.push(0.9);
                                
                                rlighting.push([0,0]);
                                
                            }
                            
                        }

                            var r = lineIntersect(ray.mapX,ray.mapY,ray.mapX+cos(90*doorOpen),ray.mapY+ sin(90*doorOpen),ox/20,oy/20,ray.dirX,ray.dirY);

                            //Set lighting and lerp

                                if(oy/20 < ray.mapY){

                                }

                        }
                        
                        break;
                    
                    
                    //Swing Door left
                    case 5:
                        
                        if(loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[ray.mapY][ray.mapX]].lor === 'left'){
                            
                            var doorOpen = 1-tempMap.doorOpen[ray.mapY][ray.mapX];
                            
                            var r = lineIntersect(ray.mapX,ray.mapY,ray.mapX+sin(90*doorOpen),ray.mapY+ cos(90*doorOpen),ox/20,oy/20,ray.dirX,ray.dirY);
                            rt.push(r.slice());
                            
                            //Set lighting and lerp
                            if(doorOpen >= 1){
                                
                                rlerp.push(0.8);
                                
                                if(oy/20 < ray.mapY){
                                    
                                    rlighting.push([0,-1]);
                                    
                                }
                                
                                else{
                                    
                                    rlighting.push([0,0]);
                                    
                                }
                            }
                            
                            else if(doorOpen <= 0){
                                
                                rlerp.push(1);
                                
                                if(ox/20 < ray.mapX){
                                    
                                    rlighting.push([-1,0]);
                                    
                                }
                                
                                else{
                                    
                                    rlighting.push([0,0]);
                                    
                                }
                                
                            }
                            
                            else{
                                
                                rlerp.push(0.9);
                                
                                rlighting.push([0,0]);
                                
                            }
                            
                        }
                        
                        if(loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[ray.mapY][ray.mapX]].lor === 'right'){
                            
                            var doorOpen = 1-tempMap.doorOpen[ray.mapY][ray.mapX];
                            
                            var r = lineIntersect(ray.mapX,ray.mapY+1,ray.mapX+sin(90*doorOpen),ray.mapY+ 1- cos(90*doorOpen),ox/20,oy/20,ray.dirX,ray.dirY);
                            rt.push(r.slice());
                            
                            //Set lighting and lerp
                            if(doorOpen >= 1){
                                
                                rlerp.push(0.8);
                                
                                if(oy/20 > ray.mapY+1){
                                    
                                    rlighting.push([0,1]);
                                    
                                }
                                
                                else{
                                    
                                    rlighting.push([0,0]);
                                    
                                }
                            }
                            
                            else if(doorOpen <= 0){
                                
                                rlerp.push(1);
                                
                                if(ox/20 < ray.mapX){
                                    
                                    rlighting.push([-1,0]);
                                    
                                }
                                
                                else{
                                    
                                    rlighting.push([0,0]);
                                    
                                }
                                
                            }
                            
                            else{
                                
                                rlerp.push(0.9);
                                
                                rlighting.push([0,0]);
                                
                            }
                            
                        }
                        
                        break;
                    
                    //Swing Door right
                    case 6:
                        
                        if(loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[ray.mapY][ray.mapX]].lor === 'left'){
                            
                            var doorOpen = 1-tempMap.doorOpen[ray.mapY][ray.mapX];
                            
                            var r = lineIntersect(ray.mapX+1,ray.mapY+1,ray.mapX+1-sin(90*doorOpen),ray.mapY+1- cos(90*doorOpen),ox/20,oy/20,ray.dirX,ray.dirY);
                            rt.push(r.slice());
                            
                            //Set lighting and lerp
                            if(doorOpen >= 1){
                                
                                rlerp.push(0.8);
                                
                                if(oy/20 > ray.mapY+1){
                                    
                                    rlighting.push([0,1]);
                                    
                                }
                                
                                else{
                                    
                                    rlighting.push([0,0]);
                                    
                                }
                            }
                            
                            else if(doorOpen <= 0){
                                
                                rlerp.push(1);
                                
                                if(ox/20 > ray.mapX+1){
                                    
                                    rlighting.push([1,0]);
                                    
                                }
                                
                                else{
                                    
                                    rlighting.push([0,0]);
                                    
                                }
                                
                            }
                            
                            else{
                                
                                rlerp.push(0.9);
                                
                                rlighting.push([0,0]);
                                
                            }
                            
                        }
                        
                        if(loadedMap.doorDefs[loadedMap.doors[ray.mapY][ray.mapX]].lor === 'right'){
                            
                            var doorOpen = 1-tempMap.doorOpen[ray.mapY][ray.mapX];
                            
                            var r = lineIntersect(ray.mapX+1,ray.mapY,ray.mapX+1-sin(90*doorOpen),ray.mapY+ cos(90*doorOpen),ox/20,oy/20,ray.dirX,ray.dirY);
                            rt.push(r.slice());
                            
                            //Set lighting and lerp
                            if(doorOpen >= 1){
                                
                                rlerp.push(0.8);
                                
                                if(oy/20 < ray.mapY){
                                    
                                    rlighting.push([0,-1]);
                                    
                                }
                                
                                else{
                                    
                                    rlighting.push([0,0]);
                                    
                                }
                            }
                            
                            else if(doorOpen <= 0){
                                
                                rlerp.push(1);
                                
                                if(ox/20 > ray.mapX+1){
                                    
                                    rlighting.push([1,0]);
                                    
                                }
                                
                                else{
                                    
                                    rlighting.push([0,0]);
                                    
                                }
                                
                            }
                            
                            else{
                                
                                rlerp.push(0.9);
                                
                                rlighting.push([0,0]);
                                
                            }
                            
                        }
                        
                        break;
                    
                }
                
                for(var i = 0; i <= rt.length-1; i++){
                    
                    //If we hit a wall
                    if(rt[i][0]){
                        
                        rx.push(rt[i][1]);
                        ry.push(rt[i][2]);
                        d.push(rt[i][3]);
                        wallX.push(rt[i][4]);
                        lerp.push(rlerp[i]);
                        
                        var ly = constrain(ray.mapY+rlighting[i][1],0,tempMap.lighting.length-1);
                        var lx = constrain(ray.mapX+rlighting[i][0],0,tempMap.lighting[ly].length-1);
                        
                        l.push(tempMap.lighting[ly][lx]);
                        
                        //stroke(255,0,0);
                        //line(x,200/r[3] + game.height/2,x,-200/r[3] + game.height/2);
                        
                        returnWalls.hit = true;
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
                //Only add the nearest wall if they aren't transparent
                if(!trans){
                    
                    //Find Closest
                    var closestVal = Infinity;
                    var closestI = -1;
                    
                    for(var e = 0; e <= d.length-1; e++){
                        
                        if(d[e] < closestVal){
                            
                            closestVal = d[e];
                            closestI = e;
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    if(closestI>-1){
                        
                        returnWalls.x.push(rx[closestI]);
                        returnWalls.y.push(ry[closestI]);
                        returnWalls.d.push(d[closestI]);
                        returnWalls.t.push(loadedMap.layout[ray.mapY][ray.mapX]);
                        returnWalls.l.push(l[closestI]);
                        returnWalls.lerp.push(lerp[closestI]);
                        returnWalls.wallX.push(wallX[closestI]);
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
                //If they are, add them all
                else{
                    
                    returnWalls.x=rx.slice();
                    returnWalls.y=ry.slice();
                    returnWalls.d=d.slice();
                    returnWalls.wallX=wallX.slice();
                    returnWalls.lerp = lerp.slice();
                    returnWalls.l= l.slice();
                    
                    for(var e = 0; e <= rx.length-1; e++){
                        
                        returnWalls.t.push(loadedMap.layout[ray.mapY][ray.mapX]);
                        
                        
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            return returnWalls;
            
        }
        
        //Floor and ceiling
        if(type === 'ceiling' || type === 'floor'){
            
            var shape = 0;
            var layout = 0;
            
            var currentHeight = 0;
            var newPrimaryHeight = 0;
            var newSecondaryHeight = 0;
            
            var returnWalls = {
                
                x:[],
                y:[],
                d:[],
                h:[],
                t:[],
                l:[],
                lerp:[],
                wallX:[],
                hit:false,
                
            };
            
            
            if(type === 'ceiling'){
                
                shape = loadedMap.ceilingShape[ray.mapY][ray.mapX];
                layout = loadedMap.ceilingWallLayout[ray.mapY][ray.mapX];
                
                currentHeight = ceilingHeight;
                newPrimaryHeight = tempMap.ceilingHeight[ray.mapY][ray.mapX];
                newSecondaryHeight = tempMap.ceilingSecondaryHeight[ray.mapY][ray.mapX];
                
            }
            
            else{
                
                shape = loadedMap.floorShape[ray.mapY][ray.mapX];
                layout = loadedMap.floorWallLayout[ray.mapY][ray.mapX];
                
                currentHeight = floorHeight;
                newPrimaryHeight = tempMap.floorHeight[ray.mapY][ray.mapX];
                newSecondaryHeight = tempMap.floorSecondaryHeight[ray.mapY][ray.mapX];
                
            }
            
            var rx=[];
            var ry=[];
            var d=[];
            var h = [];
            var wallX=[];
            var li = [];
            var lerp=[];
            
            var sorted=[];
            
            for(var i = 0; i <= heightShapes[shape].length-1; i++){
                
                if(heightShapes[shape][i].type === 'line'){
                    
                    var currentLine = heightShapes[shape][i];
                    
                    
                    var r = lineIntersect(ray.mapX + currentLine.x1,ray.mapY + currentLine.y1,ray.mapX + currentLine.x2,ray.mapY + currentLine.y2,ox/20,oy/20,ray.dirX,ray.dirY);
                    
                    //If we hit a wall
                    if(r[0]){
                        
                        rx.push(r[1]);
                        ry.push(r[2]);
                        d.push(r[3]);
                        wallX.push(r[4]);
                        lerp.push(currentLine.lerp);
                    
                        var ly = constrain(ray.mapY + currentLine.ly,0,tempMap.lighting.length-1);
                        var lx = constrain(ray.mapX + currentLine.lx,0,tempMap.lighting[ly].length-1);
                        
                        li.push(tempMap.lighting[ly][lx]);
                        
                        
                        //Check if this line can cause a height change
                        switch(currentLine.h){
                            
                            case 'p':
                                
                                h.push(newPrimaryHeight);
                                
                            break;
                            
                            case 's':
                                
                                h.push(newSecondaryHeight);
                                
                            break;
                            
                            case 'b':
                                
                                h.push('two_sided');
                                
                            break;
                            
                        }
                        
                        sorted.push(false);
                        
                        returnWalls.hit = true;
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            //Add all walls for now (later maybe delete ones on equal ints)
            //Find Closest
            
            var checkHeight = currentHeight;
            
            for(var l = 0; l <= d.length-1; l++){
                
                var closestVal = Infinity;
                var closestI = -1;
                
                for(var e = 0; e <= d.length-1; e++){
                    
                    if(d[e] < closestVal && !sorted[e]){
                        
                        closestVal = d[e];
                        closestI = e;
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                 
                if(closestI>-1){
                    
                    sorted[closestI] = true;
                    
                    //Check if we change height before we add it
                    if(checkHeight !== h[closestI]){
                        
                        //Set the height for doubles
                        if(h[closestI] === 'two_sided'){
                            
                            if(checkHeight === newPrimaryHeight){
                                
                                h[closestI] = newSecondaryHeight;
                                
                            }
                            
                            else{
                                
                                h[closestI] = newPrimaryHeight;
                                
                            }
                            
                        }
                        
                        returnWalls.x.push(rx[closestI]);
                        returnWalls.y.push(ry[closestI]);
                        returnWalls.d.push(d[closestI]);
                        returnWalls.h.push(h[closestI]);
                        returnWalls.t.push(layout);
                        returnWalls.l.push(li[closestI]);
                        returnWalls.lerp.push(lerp[closestI]);
                        returnWalls.wallX.push(wallX[closestI]);
                        
                        checkHeight = h[closestI];
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            return returnWalls;
            
        }
        
        //wallX-=floor(wallX);
        
        return;
    };
    
    //Draw Objects
    var drawObjects =function(d,pd,mi,ma){
        
        noStroke();
        
        var h = game.camera.height;
        
        var horizon = game.camera.horizon*(game.height/game.realHeight);
        
        var hD = horizon;
        
        //var trueWallDistance = dist(ox,oy,floorXWall*20,floorYWall*20);
        
        if(!objectList.setup){
            
            //Draw Objects
            for(var s = 0; s <= objectList.index.length-1; s++){
                
                if(!objectList.drawn[s]){
                    
                    var i = objectList.index[s];
                    
                    var closestPointToLine = objectList.closestPoint[s];
                    
                    var drawn = objectList.drawn[s];
                    //sqrt(sq(objects.cameraDistances[i])+sq(game.camera.height/20)
                    //sqrt(sq(objects.cameraDistances[i])+sq((game.camera.height-(objects.verticalPos[i]/2))/20))
                    var realDistance = objects.cameraDistances[i];
                    var distance = realDistance*1.25;
                    var objectHeight = objectConstants[objects.type[i]].height;  
                    
                    //var distance = objects.cameraDistances[i];
                    
                    if(distance < d+1 && distance >= pd-1 && objects.verticalPos[i]+objectHeight+300>floorHeight && objects.verticalPos[i]+300<ceilingHeight){
                        
                        //There used to be code here to order the objects from farthest to closest, that's now in the updateObjects function for performance
                        
                        //There used to be code here for the detection of intersects, its in a different part of the rayCast function now
                        
                        //dist(player.x,player.y,ray.mapX*20,ray.mapY*20)
                        
                        var objX=-closestPointToLine+objectConstants[objects.type[i]].widths[objects.animation[i]][objects.animationFrame[i]][objects.side[i]]/2;
                        
                        var texPercent=objX/objectConstants[objects.type[i]].widths[objects.animation[i]][objects.animationFrame[i]][objects.side[i]];
                        
                        var texX=floor((objectConstants[objects.type[i]].texture[objects.animation[i]][objects.animationFrame[i]][objects.side[i]].length)*texPercent);
                        
                        for(var l = 0; l <= objectConstants[objects.type[i]].texture[objects.animation[i]][objects.animationFrame[i]][objects.side[i]][texX].length-1; l++){
                            
                            if(objectConstants[objects.type[i]].lit){
                                
                                //Set Color
                                fill(objectConstants[objects.type[i]].colors[objectConstants[objects.type[i]].texture[objects.animation[i]][objects.animationFrame[i]][[objects.side[i]]][texX][l][0]][0],objectConstants[objects.type[i]].colors[objectConstants[objects.type[i]].texture[objects.animation[i]][objects.animationFrame[i]][[objects.side[i]]][texX][l][0]][1],objectConstants[objects.type[i]].colors[objectConstants[objects.type[i]].texture[objects.animation[i]][objects.animationFrame[i]][[objects.side[i]]][texX][l][0]][2],objects.transparency[i]);
                                
                            }
                            
                            else{
                                
                                //Set Color
                                fill(objectConstants[objects.type[i]].colors[objectConstants[objects.type[i]].texture[objects.animation[i]][objects.animationFrame[i]][[objects.side[i]]][texX][l][0]][0]*tempMap.lighting[floor(objects.y[i]/20)][floor(objects.x[i]/20)],objectConstants[objects.type[i]].colors[objectConstants[objects.type[i]].texture[objects.animation[i]][objects.animationFrame[i]][[objects.side[i]]][texX][l][0]][1]*tempMap.lighting[floor(objects.y[i]/20)][floor(objects.x[i]/20)],objectConstants[objects.type[i]].colors[objectConstants[objects.type[i]].texture[objects.animation[i]][objects.animationFrame[i]][[objects.side[i]]][texX][l][0]][2]*tempMap.lighting[floor(objects.y[i]/20)][floor(objects.x[i]/20)],objects.transparency[i]);
                                
                            }
                            
                            var vD = h / (distance/20);
                            
                            var texture = objectConstants[objects.type[i]].texture[objects.animation[i]][objects.animationFrame[i]][[objects.side[i]]][texX][l];
                            
                            var topLit = objects.verticalPos[i] + texture[1] + 300;
                            
                            var bottomLit = objects.verticalPos[i] - texture[2] + 300;
                            
                            var top = (-((topLit*(game.height/game.realHeight))-game.height/2)/(distance/20))+game.height/2+hD+vD;
                            
                            var bottom = (-((bottomLit*(game.height/game.realHeight))-game.height/2)/(distance/20))+game.height/2+hD+vD;
                            
                            if(top<ma && bottom>mi){
                                
                                top = constrain(top,mi,ma);
                                bottom = constrain(bottom,mi,ma);
                                
                                //line(x,top,x,bottom);
                                
                                var lo = top-bottom;
                                var mo = bottom + lo/2;
                                
                                rectMode(CORNER);
                                
                                rect(x,bottom-0.002,1,lo+0.004);
                                
                            }
                        }
                        
                        //Mark the drawn ones
                        objectList.drawn[s] = true;
                        
                    }
                    
                    /*
                    else if(objects.cameraDistances[i] >= d+1){
                        
                        //Break out of the loop if we reach the wall
                        break;
                        
                    }
                    */
                    
                }
                
            }
            
        }
        
    };
    
    //Check height collisions for hitscan
    var checkHitScanHeight = function(floorHeight,ceilingHeight,x,y){
        
        //Check the distance the ray travels before it hits the floor, then find the coord of the floor pixel same for the ceiling
        if(dz === 0){dz = 0.0001;}
        
        var hdx = dx/dist(0,0,dx,dy);
        var hdy = dy/dist(0,0,dx,dy);
        
        fht = (floorHeight-ih)/(20*dz);
        fhfx = ox + hdx*fht;
        fhfy = oy + hdy*fht;
        
        cht = (ceilingHeight - ih)/(20*dz);
        chfx = ox + hdx*cht;
        chfy = oy + hdy*cht;
        
        //Now see if the floor is hit or the ceiling
        if(fht>0){
            
            ht = fht;
            hfx = fhfx;
            hfy = fhfy;
            hfz = floorHeight-game.realHeight/2;
            
            hfc = 'floor';
            
        }
        
        
        if(cht>0){
            
            ht = cht;
            hfx = chfx;
            hfy = chfy;
            hfz = ceilingHeight-game.realHeight/2;
            
            hfc = 'ceiling';
            
        }
        
        var trueWallDist = dist(ox,oy,x,y);
        
        //We've hit the ground instead of a wall
        if(ht<trueWallDist){
            
            //Distance the ray traveled
            hitScanReturn.t=ht;
            
            //Where it stopped on the gorund or ceiling or wall
            hitScanReturn.x=hfx;
            hitScanReturn.y=hfy;
            hitScanReturn.z=hfz;
            
            //Set the normals
            hitScanReturn.nx=0;
            hitScanReturn.ny=0;
            hitScanReturn.nz=fht/abs(fht);
            
            //Whether it hit a ceiling or wall
            hitScanReturn.fc=hfc;
            
            hitScanReturn.mapX = floor(hfx/20);
            hitScanReturn.mapY = floor(hfy/20);
                
            //return hitScanReturn;
            
        }
        
        else{
            
            hfc = 'neither';
            
        }
        
        
        return ht<trueWallDist;
        
    };
    
    /**DDA Algorithm**/
    
    //Set the first side
    if(ray.sideDistX < ray.sideDistY){
        
        ray.side = 0;
        
    }
    
    else{
        
        ray.side = 1;
        
    } 
    
    //Before the Algorithm, on the first iteration, check if youre in a block
    //Check if ray has hit a wall
    if((!hs && loadedMap.layout[ray.mapY][ray.mapX]>0) || (hs && loadedMap.boundaries[ray.mapY][ray.mapX]>0)){
        
        var w = checkHitWall('wall');
        
        wallVars.hit=w.hit;
        wallVars.x=w.x.slice();
        wallVars.y=w.y.slice();
        wallVars.d=w.d.slice();
        wallVars.t=w.t.slice();
        wallVars.l=w.l.slice();
        wallVars.lerp=w.lerp.slice();
        wallVars.wallX=w.wallX.slice();
        
    }
    
    //Check if the floor changed height
    if((loadedMap.floorShape[ray.mapY][ray.mapX] === 0 && tempMap.floorHeight[ray.mapY][ray.mapX] !== floorHeight) || (loadedMap.floorShape[ray.mapY][ray.mapX] !== 0 && (tempMap.floorHeight[ray.mapY][ray.mapX] !== floorHeight||tempMap.floorSecondaryHeight[ray.mapY][ray.mapX] !== floorHeight))){
        
        var f = checkHitWall('floor');
        
        floorVars.hit=f.hit;
        floorVars.x=f.x.slice();
        floorVars.y=f.y.slice();
        floorVars.d=f.d.slice();
        floorVars.h=f.h.slice();
        floorVars.t=f.t.slice();
        floorVars.l=f.l.slice();
        floorVars.lerp=f.lerp.slice();
        floorVars.wallX=f.wallX.slice();
        
    }
    
    
    //Check if the ceiling changed height
    if((loadedMap.ceilingShape[ray.mapY][ray.mapX] === 0 && tempMap.ceilingHeight[ray.mapY][ray.mapX] !== ceilingHeight) || (loadedMap.ceilingShape[ray.mapY][ray.mapX] !== 0 && (tempMap.ceilingHeight[ray.mapY][ray.mapX] !== ceilingHeight||tempMap.ceilingSecondaryHeight[ray.mapY][ray.mapX] !== ceilingHeight))){
        
        var c = checkHitWall('ceiling');
        
        ceilingVars.hit=c.hit;
        ceilingVars.x=c.x.slice();
        ceilingVars.y=c.y.slice();
        ceilingVars.d=c.d.slice();
        ceilingVars.h=c.h.slice();
        ceilingVars.t=c.t.slice();
        ceilingVars.l=c.l.slice();
        ceilingVars.lerp=c.lerp.slice();
        ceilingVars.wallX=c.wallX.slice();
        
    }
    
    //Set some variables for the floor
    
    //Use DDA Algoritm
    while(!wallVars.hit && !floorVars.hit && !ceilingVars.hit){
        
        //jump to next map square
        if(ray.sideDistX < ray.sideDistY){
            
            ray.sideDistX += ray.deltaDistX;
            
            ray.mapX += ray.stepX;
            
            ray.side = 0;
            
        }
        
        else{
            
            ray.sideDistY += ray.deltaDistY;
            
            ray.mapY += ray.stepY;
            
            ray.side = 1;
            
            ray.lastDist+=ray.deltaDistY;
            
        }
        
        //Calculate distance projected on camera (not the oblique distance!)
        if(ray.side === 0){
            
            ray.perpWallDist = (ray.mapX - ox/20 + (1 - ray.stepX) / 2) / ray.dirX;
            
            ray.wallX = ray.posY + ray.perpWallDist * ray.dirY;
            
        }
        
        else{
            
            ray.perpWallDist = (ray.mapY - oy/20 + (1 - ray.stepY) / 2) / ray.dirY;
            
            ray.wallX = ray.posX + ray.perpWallDist * ray.dirX;
            
        }
        
        //Stop it if the thing leaves the bounds
        if(ray.mapY < 0 || ray.mapX < 0 || ray.mapY > loadedMap.layout.length - 1 || ray.mapX > loadedMap.layout[constrain(ray.mapY,0,loadedMap.layout.length - 1)].length - 1){
            
            return;
            
        }
        
        //Check if the floor changed height
        if((loadedMap.floorShape[ray.mapY][ray.mapX] === 0 && tempMap.floorHeight[ray.mapY][ray.mapX] !== floorHeight) || (loadedMap.floorShape[ray.mapY][ray.mapX] !== 0 && (tempMap.floorHeight[ray.mapY][ray.mapX] !== floorHeight||tempMap.floorSecondaryHeight[ray.mapY][ray.mapX] !== floorHeight))){
            
            var f = checkHitWall('floor');
            
            floorVars.hit=f.hit;
            floorVars.x=f.x.slice();
            floorVars.y=f.y.slice();
            floorVars.d=f.d.slice();
            floorVars.h=f.h.slice();
            floorVars.t=f.t.slice();
            floorVars.l=f.l.slice();
            floorVars.lerp=f.lerp.slice();
            floorVars.wallX=f.wallX.slice();
            
        }
        
        //Check if the ceiling changed height
        if((loadedMap.ceilingShape[ray.mapY][ray.mapX] === 0 && tempMap.ceilingHeight[ray.mapY][ray.mapX] !== ceilingHeight) || (loadedMap.ceilingShape[ray.mapY][ray.mapX] !== 0 && (tempMap.ceilingHeight[ray.mapY][ray.mapX] !== ceilingHeight||tempMap.ceilingSecondaryHeight[ray.mapY][ray.mapX] !== ceilingHeight))){
            
            var c = checkHitWall('ceiling');
            
            ceilingVars.hit=c.hit;
            ceilingVars.x=c.x.slice();
            ceilingVars.y=c.y.slice();
            ceilingVars.d=c.d.slice();
            ceilingVars.h=c.h.slice();
            ceilingVars.t=c.t.slice();
            ceilingVars.l=c.l.slice();
            ceilingVars.lerp=c.lerp.slice();
            ceilingVars.wallX=c.wallX.slice();
            
        }
        
        //if(cs){println(ray.mapX + ', ' + ray.mapY);}
        
        //Check if ray has hit a wall
        if((!hs && loadedMap.layout[ray.mapY][ray.mapX]>0) || (hs && loadedMap.boundaries[ray.mapY][ray.mapX]>0)){
            
            var w = checkHitWall('wall');
            
            wallVars.hit=w.hit;
            wallVars.x=w.x.slice();
            wallVars.y=w.y.slice();
            wallVars.d=w.d.slice();
            wallVars.t=w.t.slice();
            wallVars.l=w.l.slice();
            wallVars.lerp=w.lerp.slice();
            wallVars.wallX=w.wallX.slice();
            
        }
        
    }
    
    /**Organize the Draw Order**/
    
    if(wallVars.hit || floorVars.hit || ceilingVars.hit){
        
        //All of our unsorted walls that need to be sorted and drawn
        var allUnsorted = {x:[],y:[],d:[],t:[],l:[],lerp:[],wallX:[],type:[],f:[],c:[],s:[]};
        
        //Whether that index has been sorted
        var sorted = [];
        
        //Add walls to unsorted
        var layout = loadedMap.layout[ray.mapY][ray.mapX];
        
        var trans = loadedMap.assets.walls.transparent[layout];
        
        if(wallVars.hit){
            
            for(var i = 0; i<= wallVars.d.length-1; i++){
                
                allUnsorted.x.push(wallVars.x[i]);
                allUnsorted.y.push(wallVars.y[i]);
                allUnsorted.d.push(wallVars.d[i]);
                allUnsorted.t.push(wallVars.t[i]);
                allUnsorted.l.push(wallVars.l[i]);
                allUnsorted.lerp.push(wallVars.lerp[i]);
                allUnsorted.wallX.push(wallVars.wallX[i]);
                
                allUnsorted.type.push('wall');
                allUnsorted.f.push(0);
                allUnsorted.c.push(0);
                allUnsorted.s.push(trans);
                
                sorted.push(false);
                
            }
            
        }
        
        //Add floors to unsorted
        if(floorVars.hit){
            
            
            for(var i = 0; i<= floorVars.d.length-1; i++){
                
                allUnsorted.x.push(floorVars.x[i]);
                allUnsorted.y.push(floorVars.y[i]);
                allUnsorted.d.push(floorVars.d[i]);
                allUnsorted.f.push(floorVars.h[i]);
                allUnsorted.t.push(floorVars.t[i]);
                allUnsorted.l.push(floorVars.l[i]);
                allUnsorted.lerp.push(floorVars.lerp[i]);
                allUnsorted.wallX.push(floorVars.wallX[i]);
                
                allUnsorted.type.push('floor');
                allUnsorted.c.push(0);
                allUnsorted.s.push(true);
                
                sorted.push(false);
                
            }
            
        }
        
        //Add ceilings to unsorted
        
        if(ceilingVars.hit){
            
            for(var i = 0; i<= ceilingVars.d.length-1; i++){
                
                allUnsorted.x.push(ceilingVars.x[i]);
                allUnsorted.y.push(ceilingVars.y[i]);
                allUnsorted.d.push(ceilingVars.d[i]);
                allUnsorted.c.push(ceilingVars.h[i]);
                allUnsorted.t.push(ceilingVars.t[i]);
                allUnsorted.l.push(ceilingVars.l[i]);
                allUnsorted.lerp.push(ceilingVars.lerp[i]);
                allUnsorted.wallX.push(ceilingVars.wallX[i]);
                
                allUnsorted.type.push('ceiling');
                allUnsorted.f.push(0);
                //allUnsorted.c.push(0);
                allUnsorted.s.push(true);
                
                sorted.push(false);
                
            }
            
        }
        
        //Reset old objects
        var wallHit = wallVars.hit; 
        var floorHit = floorVars.hit; 
        var ceilingHit = ceilingVars.hit; 
        
        wallVars = {};
        floorVars = {};
        ceilingVars = {};
        
        //Floor height and ceiling height ot be passed to recursion
        var fh = floorHeight;
        var ch = ceilingHeight;
        
        var lMinY = minY;
        var lMaxY = maxY;
        
        //Fine tune definitions
        var h = game.camera.height;
        var horizon = game.camera.horizon*(game.height/game.realHeight);
        
        //Sort walls based on their distance
        var allSorted = {x:[],y:[],d:[],t:[],l:[],lerp:[],wallX:[],type:[],f:[],c:[],s:[],ty:[],by:[],minY:[],maxY:[],fp:[],cp:[]};
        
        for(var l = 0; l <= allUnsorted.d.length-1; l++){
            
            var closestVal = Infinity;
            var closestI = -1;
            
            for(var e = 0; e <= allUnsorted.d.length-1; e++){
                
                if(allUnsorted.d[e] < closestVal && !sorted[e]){
                    
                    closestVal = allUnsorted.d[e];
                    closestI = e;
                    
                }
                
                //Figure out the priority of equal distances
                else if(allUnsorted.d[e] === closestVal && !sorted[e]){
                    
                    switch(allUnsorted.type[e]){
                        
                        case 'wall':
                            
                            if(allUnsorted.type[closestI] === 'floor' && allUnsorted.f[closestI]<fh){
                                
                                closestVal = allUnsorted.d[e];
                                closestI = e;
                                
                            }
                            
                            if(allUnsorted.type[closestI] === 'ceiling' && allUnsorted.c[closestI]>ch){
                                
                                closestVal = allUnsorted.d[e];
                                closestI = e;
                                
                            }
                            
                            break;
                        
                        case 'floor':
                            
                            if(allUnsorted.type[closestI] === 'wall' && allUnsorted.f[e]>fh){
                                
                                closestVal = allUnsorted.d[e];
                                closestI = e;
                                
                            }
                            
                            if(allUnsorted.type[closestI] === 'ceiling' && allUnsorted.f[e]<fh){
                                
                                closestVal = allUnsorted.d[e];
                                closestI = e;
                                
                            }
                            
                            break;
                        
                        case 'ceiling':
                            
                            if(allUnsorted.type[closestI] === 'wall' && allUnsorted.c[e]<ch){
                                
                                closestVal = allUnsorted.d[e];
                                closestI = e;
                                
                            }
                            
                            if(allUnsorted.type[closestI] === 'floor' && allUnsorted.c[e]>ch){
                                
                                closestVal = allUnsorted.d[e];
                                closestI = e;
                                
                            }
                            
                            break;
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            if(closestI > -1){
                
                allSorted.x.push(allUnsorted.x[closestI]);
                allSorted.y.push(allUnsorted.y[closestI]);
                allSorted.d.push(allUnsorted.d[closestI]);
                allSorted.t.push(allUnsorted.t[closestI]);
                allSorted.l.push(allUnsorted.l[closestI]);
                allSorted.lerp.push(allUnsorted.lerp[closestI]);
                allSorted.wallX.push(allUnsorted.wallX[closestI]);
                allSorted.type.push(allUnsorted.type[closestI]);
                allSorted.f.push(allUnsorted.f[closestI]);
                allSorted.c.push(allUnsorted.c[closestI]);
                allSorted.s.push(allUnsorted.s[closestI]);
                allSorted.fp.push(fh);
                allSorted.cp.push(ch);
                
                sorted[closestI] = true;
                
                var vD = h / allUnsorted.d[closestI];
                
                switch(allUnsorted.type[closestI]){
                    
                    case 'wall':
                        
                        var tty = (-((fh*(game.height/game.realHeight))-game.height/2)/allUnsorted.d[closestI])+game.height/2+horizon+vD;
                        var tby = (-((ch*(game.height/game.realHeight))-game.height/2)/allUnsorted.d[closestI])+game.height/2+horizon+vD;
                        
                        var ty = max(tty,tby);
                        var by = min(tty,tby);
                        
                        allSorted.ty.push(ty);
                        allSorted.by.push(by);
                        
                        allSorted.maxY.push(min(lMaxY,ty));
                        allSorted.minY.push(max(lMinY,by));
                        
                        allSorted.c[allSorted.c.length-1] = ch;
                        allSorted.f[allSorted.f.length-1] = fh;
                        
                        lMaxY = min(lMaxY,ty);
                        lMinY = max(lMinY,by);
                        
                        if(!trans){
                            
                            break;
                            
                        }
                        
                        break;
                    
                    case 'floor':
                        
                        var tty = (-((fh*(game.height/game.realHeight))-game.height/2)/allUnsorted.d[closestI])+game.height/2+horizon+vD;
                        var tby = (-((allUnsorted.f[closestI]*(game.height/game.realHeight))-game.height/2)/allUnsorted.d[closestI])+game.height/2+horizon+vD;
                        
                        var ty = max(tty,tby);
                        var by = min(tty,tby);
                        
                        var cy = (-((ch*(game.height/game.realHeight))-game.height/2)/allUnsorted.d[closestI])+game.height/2+horizon+vD;
                        
                        allSorted.ty.push(ty);
                        allSorted.by.push(by);
                        
                        allSorted.maxY.push(min(lMaxY,by));
                        allSorted.minY.push(max(lMinY,cy));
                        
                        allSorted.c[allSorted.c.length-1] = ch;
                        
                        lMaxY = min(lMaxY,by);
                        lMinY = max(lMinY,cy);
                        
                        fh = allUnsorted.f[closestI];
                        
                        break;
                    
                    case 'ceiling':
                        
                        var tty = (-((allUnsorted.c[closestI]*(game.height/game.realHeight))-game.height/2)/allUnsorted.d[closestI])+game.height/2+horizon+vD;
                        var tby = (-((ch*(game.height/game.realHeight))-game.height/2)/allUnsorted.d[closestI])+game.height/2+horizon+vD;
                        
                        var ty = max(tty,tby);
                        var by = min(tty,tby);
                        
                        var fy = (-((fh*(game.height/game.realHeight))-game.height/2)/allUnsorted.d[closestI])+game.height/2+horizon+vD;
                        
                        allSorted.ty.push(ty);
                        allSorted.by.push(by);
                        
                        allSorted.maxY.push(min(lMaxY,fy));
                        //allSorted.maxY.push(lMaxY);
                        allSorted.minY.push(max(lMinY,ty));
                        
                        allSorted.f[allSorted.c.length-1] = fh;
                        
                        lMinY = max(lMinY,ty);
                        lMaxY = min(lMaxY,fy);
                        
                        ch = allUnsorted.c[closestI];
                        
                        break;
                    
                }
                
            }
            
        }
        
        //Reset old object
        allUnsorted = {};
        
        var cmx = ray.mapX;
        var cmy = ray.mapY;
        
        //Recurse if needed
        //jump to next map square
        if(ray.sideDistX < ray.sideDistY){
            
            ray.sideDistX += ray.deltaDistX;
            
            ray.mapX += ray.stepX;
            
            ray.side = 0;
            
        }
        
        else{
            
            ray.sideDistY += ray.deltaDistY;
            
            ray.mapY += ray.stepY;
            
            ray.side = 1;
            
            ray.lastDist+=ray.deltaDistY;
            
        }
        
        //Recurse
        if(ray.mapX > -1 && ray.mapY > -1 && ray.mapX < loadedMap.layout[constrain(ray.mapY,0,loadedMap.layout.length-1)].length && ray.mapY < loadedMap.layout.length && ((hs && !wallHit) || (!hs && (trans || (!wallHit && lMinY<lMaxY))))){
            
            var ld = allSorted.d[allSorted.d.length-1];
            
            if(allSorted.d.length === 0){
                
                ld = priorDist;
                
            }
            
            hitScanReturn = drawRayCast(x,ox,oy,dx,dy,ray.mapX,ray.mapY,lMinY,lMaxY,fh,ch,ld,depth,hs,dz,ih);
            
        }
        
        //Current floor and ceiling height through the loop
        var fh = floorHeight;
        var ch = ceilingHeight;
        
        var fy = -Infinity;
        var cy = Infinity;
        
        //Draw the walls
        for(var i = allSorted.d.length-1; i >= 0; i--){
            
            var m = constrain(i-1,0,allSorted.d.length-1);
            
            var mi;
            var ma;
            var pd;
            
            if(i === 0){
                
                var mi = minY;
                var ma = maxY;
                pd = priorDist;
                
            }
            
            else{
                
                var mi = allSorted.minY[m];
                var ma = allSorted.maxY[m];
                pd = allSorted.d[m];
                
            }
            
            var vD = h / allSorted.d[i];
            
            switch(allSorted.type[i]){
                
                //Wall
                case 'wall':
                    
                    var tty = allSorted.ty[i];
                    var tby = allSorted.by[i];
                    
                    var ty = max(tty,tby);
                    var by = min(tty,tby);
                    
                    if(!hs){
                        
                        //ty,by,minY,maxY,d,t,l,lerp,wallX
                        drawWall(x,ty,by,mi,ma,allSorted.d[i],allSorted.t[i],allSorted.l[i],allSorted.lerp[i],allSorted.wallX[i]);
                        
                        //start,end,currentHeight,distance,difX,difY
                        if(minY<maxY && allSorted.d[i] !== pd){
                            
                            drawFloor(constrain(ty,minY,maxY),constrain(ma,minY,maxY),allSorted.fp[i],allSorted.d[i],(allSorted.x[i]*20-ox),(allSorted.y[i]*20-oy));
                            
                            drawCeiling(constrain(by,minY,maxY),constrain(mi,minY,maxY),allSorted.cp[i],allSorted.d[i],(allSorted.x[i]*20-ox),(allSorted.y[i]*20-oy));
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    else{
                        
                        var heightHit = checkHitScanHeight(allSorted.f[i],allSorted.c[i],allSorted.x[i]*20,allSorted.y[i]*20);
                        
                        //We hit a floor or ceiling
                        if(heightHit && ((hitScanReturn.fc === 'floor' && dz<0)||(hitScanReturn.fc === 'ceiling' && dz>0))){
                            
                            var dVal = allSorted.d[i];
                            
                            if(allSorted.d.indexOf(dVal) === allSorted.d.lastIndexOf(dVal)){
                                
                                return hitScanReturn;
                                
                            }
                            
                        }
                        
                        //We hit the wall
                        else{
                            
                            //Distance the ray traveled
                            hitScanReturn.t=dist(ox,oy,allSorted.x[i]*20,allSorted.y[i]*20);
                            
                            //Where it stopped on the gorund or ceiling or wall
                            hitScanReturn.x=allSorted.x[i]*20;
                            hitScanReturn.y=allSorted.y[i]*20;
                            hitScanReturn.z=ih + hitScanReturn.t * dz*20 - 300;
                            
                            //Set the normals
                            hitScanReturn.nx=0;
                            hitScanReturn.ny=0;
                            hitScanReturn.nz=0;
                            
                            if(ray.side === 0){
                                
                                hitScanReturn.nx = -dx/abs(dx);
                                
                            }
                            
                            else{
                                
                                hitScanReturn.ny = -dy/abs(dy);
                                
                            }
                            
                            //Whether it hit a ceiling or wall
                            hitScanReturn.fc=hfc;
                            
                            hitScanReturn.mapX = cmx;
                            hitScanReturn.mapY = cmy;
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    break;
                
                case 'floor':
                    
                    var tty = allSorted.ty[i];
                    var tby = allSorted.by[i];
                    
                    var ty = max(tty,tby);
                    var by = min(tty,tby);
                    
                    if(!hs){
                        
                        if(allSorted.fp[i]<allSorted.f[i]){
                            
                            //ty,by,minY,maxY,d,t,l,lerp,wallX
                            drawWall(x,ty,by,mi,ma,allSorted.d[i],allSorted.t[i],allSorted.l[i],allSorted.lerp[i],allSorted.wallX[i]);
                            
                        }
                        
                        var startY = by;
                        
                        if(allSorted.f[i]>allSorted.fp[i]){
                            
                            startY = ty;
                            
                        }
                        
                        if(minY<maxY){
                            
                            drawFloor(constrain(startY,minY,maxY),constrain(ma,minY,maxY),allSorted.fp[i],allSorted.d[i],(allSorted.x[i]*20-ox),(allSorted.y[i]*20-oy));
                            
                            drawCeiling(constrain(allSorted.minY[i],minY,maxY),constrain(mi,minY,maxY),ch,allSorted.d[i],(allSorted.x[i]*20-ox),(allSorted.y[i]*20-oy));
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    else{
                        
                        var heightHit = checkHitScanHeight(allSorted.fp[i],ch,allSorted.x[i]*20,allSorted.y[i]*20);
