                        //We hit a floor or ceiling
                        if(heightHit && dz<0){
                            
                            return hitScanReturn;
                            
                        }
                        
                        //We hit the wall
                        else{
                            
                            var t = dist(ox,oy,allSorted.x[i]*20,allSorted.y[i]*20);
                            
                            var fz = ih + dz*t*20;
                            
                            if(fz<allSorted.f[i]){
                                
                                //Distance the ray traveled
                                hitScanReturn.t=dist(ox,oy,allSorted.x[i]*20,allSorted.y[i]*20);
                                
                                //Where it stopped on the gorund or ceiling or wall
                                hitScanReturn.x=allSorted.x[i]*20;
                                hitScanReturn.y=allSorted.y[i]*20;
                                hitScanReturn.z=ih + hitScanReturn.t * dz*20 - 300;
                                
                                //Set the normals
                                hitScanReturn.nx=0;
                                hitScanReturn.ny=0;
                                hitScanReturn.nz=0;
                                
                                if(ray.side === 0){
                                    
                                    hitScanReturn.nx = -dx/abs(dx);
                                    
                                }
                                
                                else{
                                    
                                    hitScanReturn.ny = -dy/abs(dy);
                                    
                                }
                                
                                //Whether it hit a ceiling or wall
                                hitScanReturn.fc=hfc;
                                
                                hitScanReturn.mapX = cmx;
                                hitScanReturn.mapY = cmy;
                                
                            }
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    break;
                
                case 'ceiling':
                    
                    var tty = allSorted.ty[i];
                    var tby = allSorted.by[i];
                    
                    var ty = max(tty,tby);
                    var by = min(tty,tby);
                    
                    if(!hs){
                        
                        if(allSorted.cp[i]>allSorted.c[i]){
                            
                            //ty,by,minY,maxY,d,t,l,lerp,wallX
                            drawWall(x,ty,by,mi,ma,allSorted.d[i],allSorted.t[i],allSorted.l[i],allSorted.lerp[i],allSorted.wallX[i]);
                            
                        }
                        
                        var startY = ty;
                        
                        if(allSorted.c[i]<allSorted.cp[i]){
                            
                            startY = by;
                            
                        }
                        
                        if(minY<maxY){
                            
                            drawFloor(constrain(allSorted.maxY[i],minY,maxY),constrain(ma,minY,maxY),fh,allSorted.d[i],(allSorted.x[i]*20-ox),(allSorted.y[i]*20-oy));
                            
                            drawCeiling(constrain(startY,minY,maxY),constrain(mi,minY,maxY),allSorted.cp[i],allSorted.d[i],(allSorted.x[i]*20-ox),(allSorted.y[i]*20-oy));
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    else{
                        
                        var heightHit = checkHitScanHeight(fh,allSorted.cp[i],allSorted.x[i]*20,allSorted.y[i]*20);
                        
                        //We hit a floor or ceiling
                        if(heightHit&&dz>0){
                            
                            return hitScanReturn;
                            
                        }
                        
                        //We hit the wall
                        else{
                            
                            var t = dist(ox,oy,allSorted.x[i]*20,allSorted.y[i]*20);
                            
                            var fz = ih + dz*t*20;
                            
                            if(fz>allSorted.c[i]){
                                
                                //Distance the ray traveled
                                hitScanReturn.t=dist(ox,oy,allSorted.x[i]*20,allSorted.y[i]*20);
                                
                                //Where it stopped on the gorund or ceiling or wall
                                hitScanReturn.x=allSorted.x[i]*20;
                                hitScanReturn.y=allSorted.y[i]*20;
                                hitScanReturn.z=ih + hitScanReturn.t * dz*20 - 300;
                                
                                //Set the normals
                                hitScanReturn.nx=0;
                                hitScanReturn.ny=0;
                                hitScanReturn.nz=0;
                                
                                if(ray.side === 0){
                                    
                                    hitScanReturn.nx = -dx/abs(dx);
                                    
                                }
                                
                                else{
                                    
                                    hitScanReturn.ny = -dy/abs(dy);
                                    
                                }
                                
                                //Whether it hit a ceiling or wall
                                hitScanReturn.fc=hfc;
                                
                                hitScanReturn.mapX = cmx;
                                hitScanReturn.mapY = cmy;
                                
                            }
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    break;
                    
                
            }
            
            drawObjects(allSorted.d[i]*20,pd*20,mi,ma);
            
            ch = allSorted.cp[i];
            fh = allSorted.fp[i];
            
        }
        
    }
    
    /**Return the variables we need for hitscan**/
    
    if(hs){
        
        return hitScanReturn;
        
    }
    
};

//Check Collision for hit-scan weapons and functions
var hitScan=function(angle,positionX,positionY,dz,detecting,positionZ,range){
    
    var dx = sin(angle);
    var dy = -cos(angle);
    
    var targetTemp = {
        
        x:[],
        y:[],
        z:[],
        
        type:[],
        
        height:[],
        width:[],
        
        dist:[],
        
        drawn:[],
        
        real:[],
        
    };
    
    if(detecting === 'enemies'){
        
        for(var i = 0; i <= enemies.x.length-1; i++){
            
            targetTemp.drawn.push(false);
            
        }
        
        for(var i = 0; i <= enemies.x.length-1; i++){
            
            if(!enemies.dud[i] && enemies.inView[i]){
                
                var lastSmallest = Infinity;
                var lastI = 0;
                
                for(var s = 0; s <= enemies.x.length-1; s++){
                    
                    if(enemies.distance[s]<lastSmallest && !targetTemp.drawn[s] && !enemies.dud[s] && enemies.inView[s]){
                        
                        lastSmallest = enemies.distance[s];
                        lastI = s;
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
                targetTemp.drawn[lastI] = true;
                
                targetTemp.x.push(enemies.x[lastI]);
                targetTemp.y.push(enemies.y[lastI]);
                targetTemp.z.push(enemies.verticalPos[lastI]);
                targetTemp.type.push(enemies.type[lastI]);
                targetTemp.height.push(enemyConstants[enemies.type[lastI]].height);
                targetTemp.width.push(enemyConstants[enemies.type[lastI]].width);
                targetTemp.dist.push(enemies.distance[lastI]);
                targetTemp.real.push(lastI);
                
            }
            
        }
        
        objectList.drawn = [];
        objectList.closestPoint = [];
        objectList.index = [];
        
        
        objectList.setup = true;
        
    }
    
    if(detecting === 'player'){
        
        targetTemp.x.push(player.x);
        targetTemp.y.push(player.y);
        targetTemp.z.push((player.height+player.floorHeight+300));
        targetTemp.type.push(0);
        targetTemp.height.push(-player.floorHeight);
        targetTemp.width.push(player.width);
        targetTemp.dist.push(dist(positionX,positionY,player.x,player.y));
        targetTemp.real.push(0);
        
    }
    
    //var hit = drawRayCast(0,positionX,positionY,sin(angle),-cos(angle),0,0,positionX,positionY,false,1,false,0,primaryOrSecondary(positionX,positionY,'floor'),primaryOrSecondary(positionX,positionY,'ceiling'),-4,game.height+4,floor(positionX/20),floor(positionY/20),true,dz,positionZ+game.realHeight/2);
    
    //x,ox,oy,dx,dy,mapX,mapY,minY,maxY,floorHeight,ceilingHeight,priorDist,depth,hs,dz,ih
    
    var hit = drawRayCast(0,positionX,positionY,sin(angle),-cos(angle),floor(positionX/20),floor(positionY/20),-4,game.height+4,primaryOrSecondary(positionX,positionY,'floor'),primaryOrSecondary(positionX,positionY,'ceiling'),0,0,true,dz,positionZ+game.realHeight/2);
    
    //What we will return
    var returnValues = {
        
        t:dist(positionX,positionY,hit.x,hit.y),
        
        x:hit.x,
        y:hit.y,
        z:hit.z,
        
        nx:hit.nx,
        ny:hit.ny,
        nz:hit.nz,
        
        fc:hit.fc,
        
        hits:[],
        
        mapX:hit.mapX,
        mapY:hit.mapY
        
    };
    
    //Now check what we hit
    for(var i = 0; i <= targetTemp.x.length-1; i++){
        
        //Ray Next Position
        var rayNextX=positionX+dx;
        var rayNextY=positionY+dy;
        
        //Check if the line intersects
        var closestPointToLine = (rayNextX-positionX) * targetTemp.y[i] + (positionY-rayNextY)*targetTemp.x[i] + (positionX-rayNextX) * positionY + (rayNextY-positionY) * positionX;
        
        var t = dist(positionX,positionY,hit.x,hit.y);
        
        var endShot = (positionZ + dz*targetTemp.dist[i]*20);
        var targetZ = targetTemp.z[i]-300;
        
        if(abs(closestPointToLine)<targetTemp.width[i]/2 && targetTemp.dist[i] < t && endShot >= targetZ && endShot <= targetZ + targetTemp.height[i] && targetTemp.dist[i] <= range){
            
            returnValues.hits.push(targetTemp.real[i]);
            
            //Set the impact point to the first enemy
            if(returnValues.hits.length-1 === 0){
                
                returnValues.x = positionX + dx*targetTemp.dist[i];
                returnValues.y = positionY + dy*targetTemp.dist[i];
                returnValues.z = (positionZ + dz*targetTemp.dist[i]*20);
                returnValues.fc = 'enemy';
                
                returnValues.nx = 0;
                returnValues.ny = 0;
                returnValues.nz = 0;
                
                returnValues.t = targetTemp.dist[i];
                
            }
            
        }
        
    }
    
    return returnValues;
    
};

//Pathfinding

var n = 0;

var removeTarget = false;

var feeler = {
    
    //Squares that can be reached from reached tiles
    open:{
        
        //Square position
        x:[],
        y:[],
        
        //Current F position
        f:[],
        
        //Direction it came from to get here
        d:[],
        
        //How many steps it's taken to get here
        g:[],
        
        //Whether this has been removed from the list
        dud:[],
        
    },
    
    //Squares that have been reached
    closed:{
        
        //Square position
        x:[],
        y:[],
        
        //Current F position
        f:[],
        
        //Direction it came from to get here
        d:[],
        
        //How many steps it's taken to get here
        g:[],
        
        //Whether this has been removed from the list
        dud:[],
        
    },
    
    //Current square the feeler is on
    s:0,
    
    //Final shortest route from target to start
    pathX:[],
    pathY:[],
    
    //How many loops the two while loops are allowed to do
    maxLoops:500,
    
};

var addToList = function(x,y,f,d,g,type){
    
    if(type === 0){
        
        var dud = false;
        var t = 0;
        
        for(var i = 0; i <= feeler.open.dud.length-1; i++){
            
            if(feeler.open.dud[i] && !dud){
                
                dud = true;
                t = i;
                
            }
            
        }
        
        if(dud){
            
            feeler.open.x[t]=x;
            feeler.open.y[t]=y;
            feeler.open.f[t]=f;
            feeler.open.d[t]=d;
            feeler.open.g[t]=g;
            feeler.open.dud[t]=false;
            
        }
        
        else{
            
            feeler.open.x.push(x);
            feeler.open.y.push(y);
            feeler.open.d.push(d);
            feeler.open.f.push(f);
            feeler.open.g.push(g);
            feeler.open.dud.push(false);
            
        }
        
    }
    
    else{
        
        var dud = false;
        var t = 0;
        
        for(var i = 0; i <= feeler.closed.dud.length-1; i++){
            
            if(feeler.closed.dud[i] && !dud){
                
                dud = true;
                t = i;
                
            }
            
        }
        
        if(dud){
            
            feeler.closed.x[t]=x;
            feeler.closed.y[t]=y;
            feeler.closed.f[t]=f;
            feeler.closed.d[t]=d;
            feeler.closed.g[t]=g;
            feeler.closed.dud[t]=false;
            
        }
        
        else{
            
            feeler.closed.x.push(x);
            feeler.closed.y.push(y);
            feeler.closed.d.push(d);
            feeler.closed.f.push(f);
            feeler.closed.g.push(g);
            feeler.closed.dud.push(false);
            
        }
        
    }
    
};

var pathFinding = function(startX,startY,goalX,goalY){
    
    //Reset All Variables
    {
        
        feeler.open.x = [];
        feeler.open.y = [];
        feeler.open.f = [];
        feeler.open.d = [];
        feeler.open.g = [];
        feeler.open.dud = [];
        
        feeler.closed.x = [];
        feeler.closed.y = [];
        feeler.closed.f = [];
        feeler.closed.d = [];
        feeler.closed.g = [];
        feeler.closed.dud = [];
        
        feeler.s = 0;
        
        feeler.pathX = [];
        feeler.pathY = [];
        
    }
    
    //Set start
    feeler.open.x.push(startX);
    feeler.open.y.push(startY);
    feeler.open.d.push(0);
    feeler.open.f.push(0);
    feeler.open.g.push(0);
    feeler.open.dud.push(false);
    
    //Local number of calls
    var local = 0;
    
    //Current number of steps to get there
    feeler.g = 0;
    
    var room = loadedMap.boundaries;
    
    //While loop
    var found = false;
    
    var noSolution = false;
    
    removeTarget = false;
    
    while(!found){
        
        //Set s to lowest value
        {
            
            var lowestValue = "none";
            
            var allDuds = true;
            
            for(var i = 0; i <= feeler.open.f.length-1; i++){
                
                if((feeler.open.f[i] < lowestValue || lowestValue === "none") && !feeler.open.dud[i]){
                    
                    lowestValue = feeler.open.f[i];
                    
                    feeler.s = i;
                    
                    allDuds = false;
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            if(allDuds){
                
                found = true;
                
                noSolution = true;
                
                removeTarget = true;
                
            }
            
            if(feeler.open.x[feeler.s] === goalX && feeler.open.y[feeler.s] === goalY){
                
                found = true;
                
            }
            
        }
        
        //Remove s from open list and add to closed
        {
            
            feeler.open.dud[feeler.s]=true;
            
            addToList(feeler.open.x[feeler.s],feeler.open.y[feeler.s],feeler.open.f[feeler.s],feeler.open.d[feeler.s],feeler.open.g[feeler.s],1);
            
        }
        
        //Check squares adjacent to s
        {
            
            var tempX = feeler.open.x[feeler.s];
            var tempY = feeler.open.y[feeler.s];
            var tempG = feeler.open.g[feeler.s];
            
            //Up
            if(room[tempY-1][tempX] === 0 && abs(tempMap.floorHeight[tempY-1][tempX]-tempMap.floorHeight[tempY][tempX]) <= 100){
                
                //Set h variable
                var h = abs(goalX-tempX) + abs(goalY-(tempY-1));
                
                //Find if the tile is in the closed list
                var closed = false;
                
                for(var i = 0; i <= feeler.closed.x.length-1; i++){
                    
                    if(feeler.closed.x[i] === tempX && feeler.closed.y[i] === tempY-1){
                        
                        closed = true;
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
                //Do stuff with it if it's not
                if(!closed){
                    
                    //Find if it's in the open list
                    var open = false;
                    
                    for(var i = 0; i <= feeler.open.x.length-1; i++){
                        
                        if(feeler.open.x[i] === tempX && feeler.open.y[i] === tempY-1){
                            
                            open = true;
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    if(open){
                        
                        if(tempG + 1 + h < feeler.open.f[i]){
                            
                            feeler.open.d[i] = 1;
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    else{
                        
                        addToList(tempX,tempY-1,tempG + 1 + h,1,tempG + 1,0);
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            //Down
            if(room[tempY+1][tempX] === 0 && abs(tempMap.floorHeight[tempY+1][tempX]-tempMap.floorHeight[tempY][tempX]) <= 100){
                
                //Set h variable
                var h = abs(goalX-tempX) + abs(goalY-(tempY+1));
                
                //Find if the tile is in the closed list
                var closed = false;
                
                for(var i = 0; i <= feeler.closed.x.length-1; i++){
                    
                    if(feeler.closed.x[i] === tempX && feeler.closed.y[i] === tempY+1){
                        
                        closed = true;
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
                //Do stuff with it if it's not
                if(!closed){
                    
                    //Find if it's in the open list
                    var open = false;
                    
                    for(var i = 0; i <= feeler.open.x.length-1; i++){
                        
                        if(feeler.open.x[i] === tempX && feeler.open.y[i] === tempY+1){
                            
                            open = true;
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    if(open){
                        
                        if(tempG + 1 + h < feeler.open.f[i]){
                            
                            feeler.open.d[i] = 3;
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    else{
                        
                        addToList(tempX,tempY+1,tempG + 1 + h,3,tempG + 1,0);
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            //Left
            if(room[tempY][tempX-1] === 0 && abs(tempMap.floorHeight[tempY][tempX-1]-tempMap.floorHeight[tempY][tempX]) <= 100){
                
                //Set h variable
                var h = abs(goalX-(tempX-1)) + abs(goalY-tempY);
                
                //Find if the tile is in the closed list
                var closed = false;
                
                for(var i = 0; i <= feeler.closed.x.length-1; i++){
                    
                    if(feeler.closed.x[i] === tempX-1 && feeler.closed.y[i] === tempY){
                        
                        closed = true;
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
                //Do stuff with it if it's not
                if(!closed){
                    
                    //Find if it's in the open list
                    var open = false;
                    
                    for(var i = 0; i <= feeler.open.x.length-1; i++){
                        
                        if(feeler.open.x[i] === tempX-1 && feeler.open.y[i] === tempY){
                            
                            open = true;
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    if(open){
                        
                        if(tempG + 1 + h < feeler.open.f[i]){
                            
                            feeler.open.d[i] = 4;
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    else{
                        
                        addToList(tempX-1,tempY,tempG + 1 + h,4,tempG + 1,0);
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            //Right
            if(room[tempY][tempX+1] === 0 && abs(tempMap.floorHeight[tempY][tempX+1]-tempMap.floorHeight[tempY][tempX]) <= 100){
                
                //Set h variable
                var h = abs(goalX-tempX+1) + abs(goalY-(tempY));
                
                //Find if the tile is in the closed list
                var closed = false;
                
                for(var i = 0; i <= feeler.closed.x.length-1; i++){
                    
                    if(feeler.closed.x[i] === tempX+1 && feeler.closed.y[i] === tempY){
                        
                        closed = true;
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
                //Do stuff with it if it's not
                if(!closed){
                    
                    //Find if it's in the open list
                    var open = false;
                    
                    for(var i = 0; i <= feeler.open.x.length-1; i++){
                        
                        if(feeler.open.x[i] === tempX+1 && feeler.open.y[i] === tempY){
                            
                            open = true;
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    if(open){
                        
                        if(tempG + 1 + h < feeler.open.f[i]){
                            
                            feeler.open.d[i] = 2;
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    else{
                        
                        addToList(tempX+1,tempY,tempG + 1 + h,2,tempG + 1,0);
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
            }
            
        }
        
        //Check if the goal is found
        for(var i = 0; i <= feeler.open.f.length-1; i++){
            
            if(feeler.open.x[i] === goalX && feeler.open.y[i] === goalY){
                
                found = true;
                
                feeler.s = i;
                
            }
            
        }
        
        if(n>feeler.maxLoops){
            
            found = true;
            
            noSolution = true;
            
            if(local === n){
                
                removeTarget = true;
                
            }
            
        }
        
        n++;
        
        local++;
        
        /*
        println("n: " + n);
        println("x: " + feeler.open.x);
        println("y: " + feeler.open.y);
        println("f: " + feeler.open.f);
        println("s: " + feeler.s);
        
        println("---");
        */
        
    }
    
    //Path Map
    var pathMap = [];
    
    for(var y = 0; y <= room.length-1; y++){
        
        pathMap.push([]);
        
        for(var x = 0; x <= room[y].length-1; x++){
            
            pathMap[y].push(0);
            
        }
        
    }
    
    for(var i =0; i <= feeler.open.d.length-1; i++){
        
        pathMap[feeler.open.y[i]][feeler.open.x[i]] = feeler.open.d[i];
        
    }
    
    for(var i =0; i <= feeler.closed.d.length-1; i++){
        
        pathMap[feeler.closed.y[i]][feeler.closed.x[i]] = feeler.closed.d[i];
        
    }
    
    //Path
    feeler.pathX = [];
    feeler.pathY = [];
    
    var returned = false;
    
    var x = feeler.open.x[feeler.s];
    var y = feeler.open.y[feeler.s];
    
    var n = 0;
    
    while(!returned){
        
        if(!returned){
            
            feeler.pathX.push(x);
            feeler.pathY.push(y);
            
        }
        
        switch(pathMap[y][x]){
            
            case 0:
                
                returned = true;
                
                break;
                
            case 1:
                
                y+=1;
                
                break;
                
            case 2:
                
                x-=1;
                
                break;
                
            case 3:
                
                y-=1;
                
                break;
                
            case 4:
                
                x+=1;
                
                break;           
            
        }
        
        //Just in case
        if(n>feeler.maxLoops){
            
            returned = true;
            
        }
        
        n++;
        
    }
    
    //Too lazy to change how this works from my old implementation so I'm just plugging the version I prefer into the return 
    var path = [];
    
    if(n<=feeler.maxLoops){
        
        for(var i = 0; i <= feeler.pathX.length-1; i++){
            
            path.push([feeler.pathX[i],feeler.pathY[i]]);
            
        }
        
    }
    
    if(noSolution){
        
        path = [];
        
    }
    
    return path;
    
};

//Draw and give functionality to buttons
var button = function(x,y,width,height,id,selected){
    
    ////Draw the button
    
    //Set button to be more visible when selected and when the mouse is hovering over it
    var highlightOffset = 0;
    
    var mouseInRange = mouseX > x && mouseX < x+width && mouseY > y && mouseY < y+height;
    
    if(mouseInRange){
        
        highlightOffset = 100;
        
    }
    
    var selectOffset = 0;
    
    if(selected){
        
        selectOffset = 50;
        
    }
    
    //Rectangle of the button
    fill(186-selectOffset, 180-selectOffset, 180-selectOffset,175 + highlightOffset + selectOffset);
    
    stroke(5,5,5);
    
    rect(x,y,width,height);
    
    //Specific symbols or text in button
    switch(id){
        
        case 0:
        case 41:
            
            //Rectangle representing wall
            noFill();
            
            stroke(55,55,55);
            
            strokeWeight(2);
            
            rect(x+ 1/5 *width,y+1/4*height,1+width - 2/5*width,height-1/2*height);
            
            break;
        
        case 1:
            
            //Quad representing floor
            noFill();
            
            stroke(55,55,55);
            
            strokeWeight(2);
            
            quad(x+ 1/5 *width,y+1/2*height,1+x+width - 1/5 *width,y+1/2*height,1+x+width - 1/7 *width,y+3/4*height,x+ 1/7 *width,y+3/4*height);

                    loadedMap.triggerTypes[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].push(type);
                    
                }
                
                else{
                    
                    var index = loadedMap.triggerTypes[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].indexOf(type);
                    
                    game.triggers[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].splice(index,1);
                    
                    loadedMap.triggerTypes[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].splice(index,1);
                    
                }
                
                break;
            
            case 46:
                
                controls.devTools.deleting = !controls.devTools.deleting;
                
                break;
            
            case 47:
                
                //Remove a trigger
                if(game.triggers.length>0){
                    
                    if(controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type] >= game.triggers.length-1){
                        
                        controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type] = game.triggers.length-2;
                        
                    }
                    
                    if(controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type] < 0){
                        
                        controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type] = 0;
                        
                    }
                    
                    game.triggers.splice(game.triggers.length-1,1); 
                    
                    loadedMap.triggerTypes.splice(loadedMap.triggerTypes.length-1,1); 
                    
                    loadedMap.triggerCondition.splice(loadedMap.triggerCondition.length-1,1);
                    
                }
                
                
                break;
                
            case 48:
                
                //Up trigger con
                if(controls.devTools.preTrigger>0){
                    
                    controls.devTools.preTrigger--;
                    
                }
                
                else{
                    
                    controls.devTools.preTrigger = game.triggers.length-1;
                    
                }
                
                break;
            
            case 50:
                
                //down trigger con
                if(controls.devTools.preTrigger<game.triggers.length-1){
                    
                    controls.devTools.preTrigger++;
                    
                }
                
                else{
                    
                    controls.devTools.preTrigger = 0;
                    
                }
                
                break;
                
            case 51:
                
                //add trigger con
                loadedMap.triggerCondition[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].push(controls.devTools.preTrigger);
                
                break;
            
            case 52:
                
                //Door type down
                if(loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].type>0){
                    
                    loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].type--;
                    
                    if(loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].type === 6){
                        
                        loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].lor = 'left';
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
                else{
                    
                    loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].type=8;
                    
                    loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].lor = 'p';
                    
                }
                
                break;
            
            case 53:
                //Door type up
                if(loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].type<8){
                    
                    loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].type++;
                    
                    if(loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].type === 7){
                        
                        loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].lor = 'p';
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
                else{
                    
                    loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].type=0;
                    
                    loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].lor = 'left';
                    
                }
                
                break;
            
            case 54:
                
                //Left or right toggle (PS toggle as well)
                switch(loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].lor){
                    
                    case 'left': loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].lor = 'right'; break;
                    
                    case 'right': loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].lor = 'left'; break;
                    
                    case 'p': loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].lor = 's'; break;
                    
                    case 's': loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].lor = 'ps'; break;
                    
                    case 'ps': loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].lor = 'p'; break;
                    
                }
                
                break;
            
            case 55:
                //player activated toggle
                loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].player = !loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].player;
                
                break;
            
            case 56:
                //max down
                var decimals = 1000;
                
                loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].max = (floor(loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].max*decimals) - floor(controls.devTools.stepSize[controls.devTools.type]*decimals))/decimals;
                
                break;
            
            case 57:
                //max up
                var decimals = 1000;
                
                loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].max = (floor(loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].max*decimals) + floor(controls.devTools.stepSize[controls.devTools.type]*decimals))/decimals;
                
                break;
                
            case 58:
                //min down
                var decimals = 1000;
                
                loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].min = (floor(loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].min*decimals) - floor(controls.devTools.stepSize[controls.devTools.type]*decimals))/decimals;
                
                break;
            
            case 59:
                //min up
                var decimals = 1000;
                
                loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].min = (floor(loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].min*decimals) + floor(controls.devTools.stepSize[controls.devTools.type]*decimals))/decimals;
                
                break;
            case 60:
                //speed down
                loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].speed -= controls.devTools.stepSize[controls.devTools.type];
                
                break;
            
            case 61:
                //speed up
                loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].speed += controls.devTools.stepSize[controls.devTools.type];
                
                break;
            
            case 62:
                //change direction
                loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].direction *= -1;
                
                break;
            
            case 63:
                //trigger down
                if(loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].trigger>0){
                    
                    loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].trigger--;
                    
                }
                
                else{
                    
                    loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].trigger=game.triggers.length-1;
                    
                }
                
                break;
            
            case 64:
                //trigger down
                if(loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].trigger<game.triggers.length-1){
                    
                    loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].trigger++;
                    
                }
                
                else{
                    
                    loadedMap.doorDefs[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].trigger=0;
                    
                }
                
                break;
                
            case 65:
                
                //Add door
                var newDoorDef = {
                    
                    type:0,
                    
                    lor:'left',
                    
                    player:false,
                    
                    max:1,
                    
                    min:0,
                    
                    speed:0.1,
                    
                    direction:-1,
                    
                    trigger:0
                    
                };
                
                loadedMap.doorDefs.push(newDoorDef);
                
                break;
            
            case 66:
                
                //doorOpen down
                var decimals = 1000;
                
                controls.devTools.doorOpen = (floor(controls.devTools.doorOpen*decimals) - floor(controls.devTools.stepSize[controls.devTools.type]*decimals))/decimals;
                
                break;
            
            case 67:
                
                //doorOpen up
                var decimals = 1000;
                
                controls.devTools.doorOpen = (floor(controls.devTools.doorOpen*decimals) + floor(controls.devTools.stepSize[controls.devTools.type]*decimals))/decimals;
                
                break;
            
            case 68:
                
                //teleporter tool
                controls.devTools.type = 21;
                
                break;
            
            case 69:
                
                //level end tool
                controls.devTools.type = 22;
                
                break;
            
            case 70:
                
                //start or end
                controls.devTools.startOrEnd = !controls.devTools.startOrEnd;
                
                break;
            
            case 71:
                
                //add teleport
                var teleporter = {
                    
                    x1:0,
                    y1:0,
                    w1:0,
                    h1:0,
                    
                    x2:0,
                    y2:0,
                    w2:0,
                    h2:0,
                    
                };
                
                loadedMap.teleporters.push(teleporter);
                
                break;
            
            case 72:
                
                loadedMap.teleporters.splice(loadedMap.teleporters.length-1,1);
                
                break;
            
            case 73:
                
                //add level exit
                var exit = {
                    
                    x:0,
                    y:0,
                    w:0,
                    h:0,
                    
                    level:0,
                    sx:false,
                    sy:false,
                    
                };
                
                loadedMap.levelExits.push(exit);
                
                break;
            
            case 74:
            case 77:
            case 80:
                
                //loadedMap.levelExits[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].level
                //Level
                if(id === 74){loadedMap.levelExits[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].level--;}
                if(id === 77 && loadedMap.levelExits[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].sx !== false){loadedMap.levelExits[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].sx-=controls.devTools.stepSize[controls.devTools.type];}
                if(id === 80 && loadedMap.levelExits[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].sy !== false){loadedMap.levelExits[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].sy-=controls.devTools.stepSize[controls.devTools.type];}
                
                break;
            
            case 76:
            case 79:
            case 82:
                
                //loadedMap.levelExits[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].level
                //Level
                if(id === 76){loadedMap.levelExits[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].level++;}
                if(id === 79 && loadedMap.levelExits[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].sx !== false){loadedMap.levelExits[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].sx+=controls.devTools.stepSize[controls.devTools.type];}
                if(id === 82 && loadedMap.levelExits[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].sy !== false){loadedMap.levelExits[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].sy+=controls.devTools.stepSize[controls.devTools.type];}
                
                break;
            
            case 78:
                
                if(loadedMap.levelExits[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].sx === false){
                    
                    loadedMap.levelExits[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].sx = 0;
                    
                }
                
                else{
                    
                    loadedMap.levelExits[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].sx = false;
                    
                }
                
                break;
            
            
            case 81:
                
                if(loadedMap.levelExits[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].sy === false){
                    
                    loadedMap.levelExits[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].sy = 0;
                    
                }
                
                else{
                    
                    loadedMap.levelExits[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].sy = false;
                    
                }
                
                break;
            
            //Lighting
            case 83:
                
                
                controls.devTools.type = 23;
                
                break;
            
            case 85:
                
                switch(controls.devTools.spawnLevel){
                    
                    case 'floor': controls.devTools.spawnLevel = 'ceiling'; break;
                    case 'ceiling': controls.devTools.spawnLevel = 'none'; break;
                    case 'none': controls.devTools.spawnLevel = 'floor'; break;
                    
                }
                
                break;
                
            case 84:
                
                //speed up
                controls.devTools.z -= controls.devTools.stepSize[controls.devTools.type];
                
                break;
            
            case 86:
                
                //speed up
                controls.devTools.z += controls.devTools.stepSize[controls.devTools.type];
                
                break;
                
            case 87:
                
                //select angle
                
                var a = atan2(-(mouseX-(x+0.5*width)),mouseY-(y+0.5*height))+180;
                
                a = round(a/10)*10;
                
                controls.devTools.angle = a;
                
                break;
                
            
            case 88:
                
                for(var y = 0; y <= loadedMap.loadZone.length-1; y++){
                    
                    for(var x = 0; x <= loadedMap.loadZone[y].length-1; x++){
                        
                        loadedMap.loadOverlap[y][x] = loadedMap.loadZone[y][x];
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
                break;
            
            case 89:
                
                controls.devTools.state++;
                
                if(controls.devTools.state > 4){
                    
                    controls.devTools.state=0;
                    
                }
                
                break;
            
            case 90:
                
                fillLight(0.1);
                
                break;
            
        }
        
        controls.toggles.button = true;
        
    }
    
    fill(30, 30, 30);
    
    //return whether a button is being hovered over
    return mouseInRange;
    
};

//How the world is drawn
var drawWorld=function(){
    
    if(game.cam<2){
        
        stroke(5,5,5);
        
        pushMatrix();
        
        translate(game.realWidth/2,game.realHeight/2);
        
        //Draw Gridlines
        if(game.grid){
            
            if(game.cam===1){
                
                rotate(-player.angle);
                
            }
            
            stroke(115, 114, 114);
            
            fill(30,30,30);
            
            for(var x = constrain(floor(game.camera.x/20)-15,0,loadedMap.layout[0].length); x <= constrain(floor(game.camera.x/20)+15,0,loadedMap.layout[0].length); x++){
                
                line((x*20)-game.camera.x,-game.camera.y,(x*20)-game.camera.x,(loadedMap.layout.length*20)-game.camera.y);
                
                text(x,x*20-game.camera.x,-5-game.camera.y);
                
            }
            
            for(var y = constrain(floor(game.camera.y/20)-15,0,loadedMap.layout.length); y <= constrain(floor(game.camera.y/20)+15,0,loadedMap.layout.length); y++){
                
                line(-game.camera.x,(y*20)-game.camera.y,(loadedMap.layout[0].length*20)-game.camera.x,(y*20)-game.camera.y);
                
                text(y,-15-game.camera.x,y*20+15-game.camera.y);
                
            }
            
            if(game.cam===1){
                
                rotate(player.angle);
                
            }
            
        }
        
        stroke(28, 26, 26);
        
        pushMatrix();
        
        if(game.cam===0){
            
            //rotate(player.angle);
            
        }
        
        if(game.cam===1){
            
            rotate(-player.angle);
            
        }
        
        //Draw Player
        {
            
            pushMatrix();
            
            translate(player.x-game.camera.x,player.y-game.camera.y);
            
            rotate(player.angle);
            
            //triangle(0,-10,5,10,-5,10);
            
            fill(255, 0, 0);
            
            ellipse(0,0,player.width,player.width);
            
            line(0,-5,0,-15);
            
            popMatrix();
            
            //point(0,0);
            
        }
        //Draw Objects
        for(var i = 0; i <= objects.x.length-1; i++){
            
            fill(objectConstants[objects.type[i]].colors[0][0],objectConstants[objects.type[i]].colors[0][1],objectConstants[objects.type[i]].colors[0][2]);
            
            ellipse(objects.x[i]-game.camera.x,objects.y[i]-game.camera.y,objectConstants[objects.type[i]].widths[0][0][0],objectConstants[objects.type[i]].widths[0][0][0]);
            
        }
        
        //Draw paths
        
        //Draw level
        for(var y = constrain(floor(game.camera.y/20)-15,0,loadedMap.layout.length-1); y <= constrain(floor(game.camera.y/20)+15,0,loadedMap.layout.length-1); y++){
            
            for(var x = constrain(floor(game.camera.x/20)-15,0,loadedMap.layout[y].length-1); x <= constrain(floor(game.camera.x/20)+15,0,loadedMap.layout[y].length-1); x++){
                
                if(loadedMap.layout[y][x]>0){
                    
                    if(loadedMap.assets.walls.textureType[loadedMap.layout[y][x]]==="mono"){
                        
                        //Draw walls
                        fill(loadedMap.assets.walls.color[loadedMap.layout[y][x]][0],wallConstants.color[loadedMap.layout[y][x]][1],wallConstants.color[loadedMap.layout[y][x]][2]);
                        
                    }
                    
                    else{
                        
                        fill(219, 211, 197);
                        
                    }
                    
                    switch(loadedMap.shape[y][x]){
                        
                        case 1:
                            
                            triangle(x*20-game.camera.x,y*20-game.camera.y,x*20-game.camera.x,y*20+20-game.camera.y,x*20+20-game.camera.x,y*20-game.camera.y);
                            
                            break;
                        
                        case 2:
                            
                            triangle(x*20-game.camera.x,y*20-game.camera.y,x*20+20-game.camera.x,y*20+20-game.camera.y,x*20+20-game.camera.x,y*20-game.camera.y);
                            
                            break;
                        
                        case 3:
                            
                            triangle(x*20+20-game.camera.x,y*20-game.camera.y,x*20+20-game.camera.x,y*20+20-game.camera.y,x*20-game.camera.x,y*20+20-game.camera.y);
                            
                            break;
                        
                        case 4:
                            
                            triangle(x*20-game.camera.x,y*20-game.camera.y,x*20+20-game.camera.x,y*20+20-game.camera.y,x*20-game.camera.x,y*20+20-game.camera.y);
                            
                            break;
                        
                        case 5:
                            
                            arc(x*20-game.camera.x,y*20-game.camera.y,40,40,0,90);
                            line(x*20-game.camera.x,y*20-game.camera.y,x*20-game.camera.x,y*20+20-game.camera.y);
                            line(x*20-game.camera.x,y*20-game.camera.y,x*20+20-game.camera.x,y*20-game.camera.y);
                            
                            break;
                        
                        case 6:
                            
                            arc(x*20-game.camera.x+20,y*20-game.camera.y,40,40,90,180);
                            line(x*20+20-game.camera.x,y*20-game.camera.y,x*20+20-game.camera.x,y*20+20-game.camera.y);
                            line(x*20-game.camera.x,y*20-game.camera.y,x*20+20-game.camera.x,y*20-game.camera.y);
                            
                            break;
                        
                        case 7:
                            
                            arc(x*20+20-game.camera.x,y*20+20-game.camera.y,40,40,180,270);
                            line(x*20+20-game.camera.x,y*20-game.camera.y,x*20+20-game.camera.x,y*20+20-game.camera.y);
                            line(x*20-game.camera.x,y*20+20-game.camera.y,x*20+20-game.camera.x,y*20+20-game.camera.y);
                            
                            break;
                        
                        case 8:
                            
                            arc(x*20-game.camera.x,y*20+20-game.camera.y,40,40,270,360);
                            line(x*20-game.camera.x,y*20-game.camera.y,x*20-game.camera.x,y*20+20-game.camera.y);
                            line(x*20-game.camera.x,y*20+20-game.camera.y,x*20+20-game.camera.x,y*20+20-game.camera.y);
                            
                            break;
                        
                        case 9:
                            
                            ellipse(x*20+10-game.camera.x,y*20+10-game.camera.y,20,20);
                            
                            break;
                        
                        case 10:
                            
                            line(x*20+10-game.camera.x,y*20-game.camera.y,x*20+10-game.camera.x,y*20+20-game.camera.y);
                            
                            break;
                        
                        case 11:
                            
                            line(x*20-game.camera.x,y*20+10-game.camera.y,x*20+20-game.camera.x,y*20+10-game.camera.y);
                            
                            break;
                        
                        case 12:
                            
                            line(x*20+10-game.camera.x,y*20-game.camera.y,x*20+10-game.camera.x,y*20+10-game.camera.y);
                            line(x*20-game.camera.x,y*20+10-game.camera.y,x*20+10-game.camera.x,y*20+10-game.camera.y);
                            
                            break;
                        
                        case 13:
                            
                            line(x*20+10-game.camera.x,y*20-game.camera.y,x*20+10-game.camera.x,y*20+10-game.camera.y);
                            line(x*20+10-game.camera.x,y*20+10-game.camera.y,x*20+20-game.camera.x,y*20+10-game.camera.y);
                            
                            break;
                            
                        case 14:
                            
                            line(x*20+10-game.camera.x,y*20+10-game.camera.y,x*20+10-game.camera.x,y*20+20-game.camera.y);
                            line(x*20+10-game.camera.x,y*20+10-game.camera.y,x*20+20-game.camera.x,y*20+10-game.camera.y);
                            
                            break;
                        
                        case 15:
                            
                            line(x*20+10-game.camera.x,y*20+10-game.camera.y,x*20+10-game.camera.x,y*20+20-game.camera.y);
                            line(x*20-game.camera.x,y*20+10-game.camera.y,x*20+10-game.camera.x,y*20+10-game.camera.y);
                            
                            break;
                        
                        case 16:
                            
                            line(x*20+20-game.camera.x,y*20-game.camera.y,x*20+20-game.camera.x,y*20+20-game.camera.y);
                            
                            break;
                        
                        case 17:
                            
                            line(x*20-game.camera.x,y*20+20-game.camera.y,x*20+20-game.camera.x,y*20+20-game.camera.y);
                            
                            break;
                        
                        case 18:
                            
                            line(x*20-game.camera.x,y*20-game.camera.y,x*20-game.camera.x,y*20+20-game.camera.y);
                            
                            break;
                        
                        case 19:
                            
                            line(x*20-game.camera.x,y*20-game.camera.y,x*20+20-game.camera.x,y*20-game.camera.y);
                            
                            break;
                        
                        case 20:
                            
                            rect(x*20+10-game.camera.x,y*20-game.camera.y,10,20);
                            
                            break;
                        
                        case 21:
                            
                            rect(x*20-game.camera.x,y*20-game.camera.y,20,10);
                            
                            break;
                        
                        case 22:
                            
                            rect(x*20-game.camera.x,y*20-game.camera.y,10,20);
                            
                            break;
                        
                        case 23:
                            
                            rect(x*20-game.camera.x,y*20+10-game.camera.y,20,10);
                            
                            break;
                        
                        case 24:
                            
                            beginShape();
                            vertex(x*20-game.camera.x,y*20+10-game.camera.y);
                            vertex(x*20+10-game.camera.x,y*20+10-game.camera.y);
                            vertex(x*20+10-game.camera.x,y*20-game.camera.y);
                            vertex(x*20+20-game.camera.x,y*20-game.camera.y);
                            vertex(x*20+20-game.camera.x,y*20+20-game.camera.y);
                            vertex(x*20-game.camera.x,y*20+20-game.camera.y);
                            endShape(CLOSE);
                            
                            break;
                        
                        case 25:
                            
                            beginShape();
                            vertex(x*20+20-game.camera.x,y*20+10-game.camera.y);
                            vertex(x*20+10-game.camera.x,y*20+10-game.camera.y);
                            vertex(x*20+10-game.camera.x,y*20-game.camera.y);
                            vertex(x*20-game.camera.x,y*20-game.camera.y);
                            vertex(x*20-game.camera.x,y*20+20-game.camera.y);
                            vertex(x*20+20-game.camera.x,y*20+20-game.camera.y);
                            endShape(CLOSE);

                        line(boundaries.x1[i]-game.camera.x,boundaries.y1[i]-game.camera.y,boundaries.x2[i]-game.camera.x,boundaries.y2[i]-game.camera.y);
                        
                        stroke(255, 5, 5);
                        
                        var cx = boundaries.x1[i]+((boundaries.x2[i]-boundaries.x1[i])/2)-game.camera.x;
                        var cy = boundaries.y1[i]+((boundaries.y2[i]-boundaries.y1[i])/2)-game.camera.y;
                        
                        line(cx,cy,cx+boundaries.normal[i][0]*20,cy+boundaries.normal[i][1]*20);
                        
                        fill(5,5,5);
                        
                        textAlign(CENTER,CENTER);
                        textSize(10);
                        text(boundaries.tile[i],cx+boundaries.normal[i][0]*20,cy+boundaries.normal[i][1]*20);
                        
                    }
                    
                    if(boundaries.type[i] === 'circle'){
                        
                        noFill();
                        
                        arc(boundaries.x1[i]-game.camera.x,boundaries.y1[i]-game.camera.y,boundaries.radius[i]*2,boundaries.radius[i]*2,boundaries.ang1[i]-90,boundaries.ang2[i]-90);
                        
                    }
                }
                
            }
            
            if(controls.devTools.type === 21){
                
                for(var i = 0; i <= loadedMap.teleporters.length-1; i++){
                    
                    stroke(26, 26, 26,150);
                    strokeWeight(2);
                    fill(13, 214, 13,100);
                    
                    rect(loadedMap.teleporters[i].x1*20-game.camera.x,loadedMap.teleporters[i].y1*20-game.camera.y,loadedMap.teleporters[i].w1*20+20,loadedMap.teleporters[i].h1*20+20);
                    
                    fill(5,5,5);
                    textAlign(LEFT,TOP);
                    
                    text(i,loadedMap.teleporters[i].x1*20-game.camera.x,loadedMap.teleporters[i].y1*20-game.camera.y);
                    
                    stroke(26, 26, 26,150);
                    strokeWeight(2);
                    fill(214, 13, 13,100);
                    
                    rect(loadedMap.teleporters[i].x2*20-game.camera.x,loadedMap.teleporters[i].y2*20-game.camera.y,loadedMap.teleporters[i].w2*20+20,loadedMap.teleporters[i].h2*20+20);
                    
                    fill(5,5,5);
                    
                    textAlign(LEFT,TOP);
                    
                    text(i,loadedMap.teleporters[i].x2*20-game.camera.x,loadedMap.teleporters[i].y2*20-game.camera.y);
                    
                    textAlign(LEFT,BOTTOM);
                    
                }
                
            }

                    textAlign(LEFT,TOP);

        //ellipse(90-player.angle,20,10,10);

        //ellipse(90+360-player.angle,20,10,10);
        
        fill(146, 140, 250);
        //ellipse(180-player.angle,20,10,10);
        fill(146, 140, 250);
        //ellipse(180+360-player.angle,20,10,10);

        //ellipse(270-player.angle,20,10,10);
        fill(153, 0, 0);
        //ellipse(270+360-player.angle,20,10,10);
        
        
        //FloorBox

        for(var x = 0; x < game.width+1; x++){

            var dY=game.camera.dirY+game.camera.planeY*cameraX;

            objectList.setup = true;
            
            //x,ox,oy,dx,dy,mapX,mapY,minY,maxY,floorHeight,ceilingHeight,depth,hs,dz
            
            drawRayCast(x,game.camera.x,game.camera.y,dX,dY,floor(game.camera.x/20),floor(game.camera.y/20),-10,game.height+10,primaryOrSecondary(game.camera.x,game.camera.y,'floor'),primaryOrSecondary(game.camera.x,game.camera.y,'ceiling'),0,false,0);
            
            if(x === game.width/2){
                
                //println('');
                
            }
            
            
        }
        
        rectMode(CORNER);
        
        stroke(255, 0, 0,50);
        //line(game.width/2,0,game.width/2,game.height);
        //x,game.camera.x,game.camera.y,player.dirX,player.dirY,player.planeX,player.planeY,game.camera.x,game.camera.y,false,1,false,0,primaryOrSecondary(game.camera.x,game.camera.y,'floor'),primaryOrSecondary(game.camera.x,game.camera.y,'ceiling'),-4,game.height+4,floor(game.camera.x/20),floor(game.camera.y/20),false
    }
    
};
