                            button(53,440,27,20,59,false);
                            
                            //Speed
                            text('Speed: ' + doorDef.speed,20,465);
                            button(20,480,27,20,60,false);
                            button(53,480,27,20,61,false);
                            
                            //Direction
                            text('Direction: ' + doorDef.direction,20,505);
                            button(20,520,60,20,62,false);
                            
                            //Trigger
                            text('Trigger: ' + doorDef.trigger,20,545);
                            button(20,560,27,20,63,false);
                            button(53,560,27,20,64,false);
                             
                        }
                        
                        //Add a new door
                        text('Add New:',100,545);
                        button(100,560,60,20,65,false);
                        
                        //Change door open
                        text('Door Open: ' + controls.devTools.doorOpen,100,505);
                        button(100,520,27,20,66,false);
                        button(133,520,27,20,67,false);
                        
                        break;
                    
                    case 21:
                        
                        //Start or End
                        button(20,530,60,20,70,false);
                        
                        //Add Teleporter
                        button(20,560,27,20,71,false);
                        
                        //Remove Teleporter
                        button(53,560,27,20,72,false);
                        
                        break;
                    
                    case 22:
                        
                        
                        //Add Level End
                        text('Add New: ',20,545);
                        
                        button(20,560,93,20,73,false);
                        
                        if(loadedMap.levelExits.length>0 && controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type] <= loadedMap.levelExits.length-1){
                            
                            //Level
                            text('Level: ',20,425);
                            
                            //Left
                            button(20,440,27,20,74,false);
                            
                            //Count
                            button(53,440,27,20,75,false);
                            
                            //Right
                            button(86,440,27,20,76,false);
                            
                            //Player Start X
                            text('Start X: ',20,465);
                            
                            //Left
                            button(20,480,27,20,77,false);
                            
                            //Count
                            button(53,480,27,20,78,false);
                            
                            //Right
                            button(86,480,27,20,79,false);
                            
                            //Player Start Y
                            text('Start Y: ',20,505);
                            
                            //Left
                            button(20,520,27,20,80,false);
                            
                            //Count
                            button(53,520,27,20,81,false);
                            
                            //Right
                            button(86,520,27,20,82,false);
                            
                        }
                        break;
                    
                    case 10:
                    case 11:
                        
                        button(20,550,27,20,88,false);
                        
                        break;
                    
                    
                }
                
                if(controls.devTools.type === 8){
                    
                    button(20,285,80,80,87,false);
                    
                    button(20,255,80,20,89,false);
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            //Preview Assets
            {
                
                switch(controls.devTools.type){
                    
                    //Walls
                    case 0:
                    case 15:
                    case 16:
                        
                        var wx = 80;
                        var wy = 80;
                        
                        //Rectangle of the button
                        fill(186, 180, 180, 175);
                        
                        stroke(5,5,5);
                        
                        rect(19,499,wx+2,wy+1);
                        
                        if(controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type] !== 0){
                            
                            //Draw texture
                            var texture = wallConstants.textures[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]];
                            
                            
                            
                            var colors = wallConstants.color;
                            
                            noStroke();
                            
                            for(var p = 0; p <= texture.length-1; p++){
                                
                                var lw = wx/(texture.length);
                                
                                for(var t = 0; t <= texture[p].length-1; t++){
                                    
                                    var s = texture[p][t];
                                    
                                    fill(colors[s[2]][0],colors[s[2]][1],colors[s[2]][2]);
                                    
                                    var start = ((s[0]+200)/400)*wy;
                                    var end = ((s[1]-s[0])/400)*wy;
                                    
                                    rect(20 + p*lw,500 + start,lw+1,end);
                                    
                                }
                                
                            }
                            
                        }
                        
                        //Floor and ceiling textures
                        break;
                    
                    case 2:
                    case 3:
                        
                        var wx = 80;
                        var wy = 80;
                        
                        //Rectangle of the button
                        fill(186, 180, 180, 175);
                        
                        stroke(5,5,5);
                        
                        rect(19,499,wx+8,wy+8);
                        
                        if(controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type] !== 0){
                            
                            var texture;
                            
                            var colors;
                            
                            if(controls.devTools.type === 2){
                                
                                texture = floorConstants.textures[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]];
                                
                                colors = floorConstants.color;
                                
                            }
                            
                            if(controls.devTools.type === 3){
                                
                                texture = ceilingConstants.textures[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]];
                                
                                colors = ceilingConstants.color;
                                
                            }
                            
                            noStroke();
                            
                            var lh = wy/(texture.length-1);
                            
                            for(var y = 0; y <= texture.length-1; y++){
                                
                                var lw = wx/(texture[y].length-1);
                                
                                for(var x = 0; x <= texture[y].length-1; x++){
                                    
                                    var tile = texture[y][x];
                                    
                                    fill(colors[tile][0],colors[tile][1],colors[tile][2]);
                                    
                                    rect(20+(x*lw),500+(y*lh),lw+1,lh+1);
                                    
                                }
                                
                            }
                            
                        }
                        
                        break;
                    
                    case 8:
                    case 9:
                    case 23:
                        
                        var objectId;
                        
                        if(controls.devTools.type === 8){
                            
                            objectId = enemyConstants[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].object;
                            
                        }
                        
                        if(controls.devTools.type === 9){
                            
                            objectId = pickupConstants[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].object;
                            
                        }
                        
                        if(controls.devTools.type === 23){
                            
                            objectId = controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type];
                            
                        }
                        
                        var wx = 80;
                        var wy = 80;
                        
                        var tw = (objectConstants[objectId].widths[0][0][0]*6);
                        var scale = 1;
                        
                        if(tw > wx){
                            
                            scale = tw/wx;
                            tw = wx;
                            
                        }
                        
                        //Rectangle of the button
                        fill(186, 180, 180, 175);
                        
                        stroke(5,5,5);
                        
                        rect(19,499,wx+2,wy+1);
                        
                        if(objectId <= objectConstants.length-1){
                            
                            //Draw texture
                            var texture = objectConstants[objectId].texture[0][0][0];
                            
                            var colors = objectConstants[objectId].colors;
                            
                            noStroke();
                            
                            for(var p = 0; p <= texture.length-1; p++){
                                
                                var lw = tw/(texture.length);
                                
                                for(var t = 0; t <= texture[p].length-1; t++){
                                    
                                    var s = texture[p][t];
                                    
                                    fill(colors[s[0]][0],colors[s[0]][1],colors[s[0]][2]);
                                    
                                    //Why did i make it so sprites are drawn that way
                                    var start = ((-s[1]+200)/(400*scale))*wy;
                                    var end = ((s[2]+s[1])/(400*scale))*wy;
                                    
                                    rect(20 + wx/2 - tw/2 + p*lw,500 + start,lw+1,end);
                                    
                                }
                                
                            }
                            
                        }
                        
                        break;
                    
                }
                
            }
            
        }
        
    }
    
};

//Print the Level in DevTool Mode
var printMap=function(){
    
    var compressed = compressMap(loadedMap);
    
    var printCopy = printCompressedMap(compressed);
    
    println(printCopy);
    
};
 
//Process the player's controls
var interact = function(){
    
    //Set variables
    player.move=false;
    
    //Reset scan lines
    hitScanLines = {
        
        x1:[],
        x2:[],
        y1:[],
        y2:[],
        
        color:[],
        
        weight:[],
        
    };
    
    //Player
    {
    
    //Move the player using WASD
    {
        
        //Forward
        if(keys[87]){
            
            if(game.cam !== 0){
                
                var a  = [-sin(player.angle)*-player.acceleration*game.deltaF,cos(player.angle)*-player.acceleration*game.deltaF];
                
                if(!player.canJump || player.overSpeed){
                    
                    a[0] /= 2;
                    a[1] /= 2;
                    
                }
                
                //When the player is blast jumping, prevent them from moving more in the direction they are flying
                if(player.overSpeed && dist(player.speedX,player.speedY,0,0) > 0){
                    
                    //total speed
                    var vt = dist(player.speedX,player.speedY,0,0);
                    
                    //dot product of the velocity and accelration vectors
                    var dot = a[0] * player.speedX + a[1] * player.speedY;
                    
                    //scaling factor for projecting a onto v
                    var factor = dot/sq(vt);
                    
                    //project a onto v
                    var c = [factor*player.speedX, factor*player.speedY];
                    
                    //Subtract the projection from the acceleration
                    a[0] -= c[0];
                    a[1] -= c[1];
                    
                }
                
                player.speedX+=a[0];
                
                player.speedY+=a[1];
                
                player.move=true;
                
                //Sway to Up and Down
                if(weaponSway.walkY>=-weaponSway.maxWalk && weaponSway.walkY<=weaponSway.maxWalk){
                    
                    weaponSway.walkY+=player.maxSpeed*weaponSway.walkFactorY*game.deltaF;
                    
                }
                
                //Change direction of sway
                if(weaponSway.walkY<-weaponSway.maxWalk || weaponSway.walkY>weaponSway.maxWalk){
                    
                    weaponSway.walkFactorY*=-1;
                    
                    if(weaponSway.walkY<-weaponSway.maxWalk){
                        
                        weaponSway.walkY=-weaponSway.maxWalk;
                        
                    }
                    
                    if(weaponSway.walkY>weaponSway.maxWalk){
                        
                        weaponSway.walkY=weaponSway.maxWalk;
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
                //Sway to Left and Right
                if(weaponSway.walkX>=-weaponSway.maxWalk*2 && weaponSway.walkX<=weaponSway.maxWalk*2){
                    
                    weaponSway.walkX+=player.maxSpeed*weaponSway.walkFactorX*game.deltaF;
                    
                }
                
                //Change direction of sway
                if(weaponSway.walkX<-weaponSway.maxWalk*2 || weaponSway.walkX>weaponSway.maxWalk*2){
                    
                    weaponSway.walkFactorX*=-1;
                    
                    if(weaponSway.walkX<-weaponSway.maxWalk*2){
                        
                        weaponSway.walkX=-weaponSway.maxWalk*2;
                        
                    }
                    
                    if(weaponSway.walkX>weaponSway.maxWalk*2){
                        
                        weaponSway.walkX=weaponSway.maxWalk*2;
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            else{
                
                game.camera.y -= player.maxSpeed*3*game.deltaF;
                
            }
            
        }
        
        //Backward
        if(keys[83]){
            
            if(game.cam !== 0){
                
                var a  = [-sin(player.angle)*player.acceleration*game.deltaF,cos(player.angle)*player.acceleration*game.deltaF];
                
                if(!player.canJump || player.overSpeed){
                    
                    a[0] /= 2;
                    a[1] /= 2;
                    
                }
                
                //When the player is blast jumping, prevent them from moving more in the direction they are flying
                if(player.overSpeed && dist(player.speedX,player.speedY,0,0) > 0){
                    
                    //total speed
                    var vt = dist(player.speedX,player.speedY,0,0);
                    
                    //dot product of the velocity and accelration vectors
                    var dot = a[0] * player.speedX + a[1] * player.speedY;
                    
                    //scaling factor for projecting a onto v
                    var factor = dot/sq(vt);
                    
                    //project a onto v
                    var c = [factor*player.speedX, factor*player.speedY];
                    
                    //Subtract the projection from the acceleration
                    a[0] -= c[0];
                    a[1] -= c[1];
                    
                }
                
                player.speedX+=a[0];
                
                player.speedY+=a[1];
                
                player.move=true;
                
                //Sway to Up and Down
                if(weaponSway.walkY>=-weaponSway.maxWalk && weaponSway.walkY<=weaponSway.maxWalk){
                    
                    weaponSway.walkY-=player.maxSpeed*weaponSway.walkFactorY*game.deltaF;
                    
                }
                
                //Change direction of sway
                if(weaponSway.walkY<-weaponSway.maxWalk || weaponSway.walkY>weaponSway.maxWalk){
                    
                    weaponSway.walkFactorY*=-1;
                    
                    if(weaponSway.walkY<-weaponSway.maxWalk){
                        
                        weaponSway.walkY=-weaponSway.maxWalk;
                        
                    }
                    
                    if(weaponSway.walkY>weaponSway.maxWalk){
                        
                        weaponSway.walkY=weaponSway.maxWalk;
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
                //Sway to Left and Right
                if(weaponSway.walkX>=-weaponSway.maxWalk*2 && weaponSway.walkX<=weaponSway.maxWalk*2){
                    
                    weaponSway.walkX-=player.maxSpeed*weaponSway.walkFactorX*game.deltaF;
                    
                }
                
                //Change direction of sway
                if(weaponSway.walkX<-weaponSway.maxWalk*2 || weaponSway.walkX>weaponSway.maxWalk*2){
                    
                    weaponSway.walkFactorX*=-1;
                    
                    if(weaponSway.walkX<-weaponSway.maxWalk*2){
                        
                        weaponSway.walkX=-weaponSway.maxWalk*2;
                        
                    }
                    
                    if(weaponSway.walkX>weaponSway.maxWalk*2){
                        
                        weaponSway.walkX=weaponSway.maxWalk*2;
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            else{
                
                game.camera.y += player.maxSpeed*3*game.deltaF;
                
            }
            
        }
        
        //Reset Walking Sway
        if(!keys[87] && !keys[83]){
            
            if(weaponSway.walkY<0){
                
                weaponSway.walkY+=player.maxSpeed/2;
                
            }
            
            if(weaponSway.walkY>0){
                
                weaponSway.walkY-=player.maxSpeed/2;
                
            }
            
            if(weaponSway.walkX<0){
                
                weaponSway.walkX+=player.maxSpeed/2;
                
            }
            
            if(weaponSway.walkX>0){
                
                weaponSway.walkX-=player.maxSpeed/2;
                
            }
            
        }
        
        //Left
        if(keys[65]){
            
            if(game.cam !== 0 || player.overSpeed){
                
                var a  = [-sin(player.angle+90)*player.acceleration*game.deltaF,cos(player.angle+90)*player.acceleration*game.deltaF];
                
                if(!player.canJump){
                    
                    a[0] /= 2;
                    a[1] /= 2;
                    
                }
                
                //When the player is blast jumping, prevent them from moving more in the direction they are flying
                if(player.overSpeed && dist(player.speedX,player.speedY,0,0) > 0){
                    
                    //total speed
                    var vt = dist(player.speedX,player.speedY,0,0);
                    
                    //dot product of the velocity and accelration vectors
                    var dot = a[0] * player.speedX + a[1] * player.speedY;
                    
                    //scaling factor for projecting a onto v
                    var factor = dot/sq(vt);
                    
                    //project a onto v
                    var c = [factor*player.speedX, factor*player.speedY];
                    
                    //Subtract the projection from the acceleration
                    a[0] -= c[0];
                    a[1] -= c[1];
                    
                }
                
                player.speedX+=a[0];
                
                player.speedY+=a[1];
                
                player.move=true;
                
                //Sway to left
                if(weaponSway.strafeX>-weaponSway.maxStrafe){
                    
                    weaponSway.strafeX-=player.maxSpeed*game.deltaF;
                    
                }
                
                //Sway Down
                if(weaponSway.strafeY<weaponSway.maxStrafe/2){
                    
                    weaponSway.strafeY+=(player.maxSpeed/2)*game.deltaF;
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            else{
                
                game.camera.x -= player.maxSpeed*3*game.deltaF;
                
            }
            
        }
        
        else if(weaponSway.strafeX<0){
            
            weaponSway.strafeX+=player.maxSpeed;
            
        }
        
        //Right
        if(keys[68]){
            
            if(game.cam !== 0){
                
                var a  = [-sin(player.angle+90)*-player.acceleration*game.deltaF,cos(player.angle+90)*-player.acceleration*game.deltaF];
                
                if(!player.canJump || player.overSpeed){
                    
                    a[0] /= 2;
                    a[1] /= 2;
                    
                }
                
                //When the player is blast jumping, prevent them from moving more in the direction they are flying
                if(player.overSpeed && dist(player.speedX,player.speedY,0,0) > 0){
                    
                    //total speed
                    var vt = dist(player.speedX,player.speedY,0,0);
                    
                    //dot product of the velocity and accelration vectors
                    var dot = a[0] * player.speedX + a[1] * player.speedY;
                    
                    //scaling factor for projecting a onto v
                    var factor = dot/sq(vt);
                    
                    //project a onto v
                    var c = [factor*player.speedX, factor*player.speedY];
                    
                    //Subtract the projection from the acceleration
                    a[0] -= c[0];
                    a[1] -= c[1];
                    
                }
                
                player.speedX+=a[0];
                
                player.speedY+=a[1];
                
                player.move=true;
                
                //Sway to right
                if(weaponSway.strafeX<weaponSway.maxStrafe){
                    
                    weaponSway.strafeX+=player.maxSpeed*game.deltaF;
                    
                }
                
                //Sway Down
                if(weaponSway.strafeY<weaponSway.maxStrafe/2){
                    
                    weaponSway.strafeY+=player.maxSpeed/2*game.deltaF;
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            else{
                
                game.camera.x += player.maxSpeed*3*game.deltaF;
                
            }
            
        }
        
        else if(weaponSway.strafeX>0){
            
            weaponSway.strafeX-=player.maxSpeed;
            
        }
        
        if(!keys[68] && !keys[65] && weaponSway.strafeY>0){
            
            weaponSway.strafeY-=player.maxSpeed/2;
            
        }
        
    }

    //Turn using arrow keys
    {
        
        if(keys[37]){
            
            player.angle-=player.turnSpeed*game.deltaF;
            
            
            //both camera direction and camera plane must be rotated
            var oldDirX = player.dirX;
            player.dirX = player.dirX * cos(-player.turnSpeed*game.deltaF) - player.dirY * sin(-player.turnSpeed*game.deltaF);
            player.dirY = oldDirX * sin(-player.turnSpeed*game.deltaF) + player.dirY * cos(-player.turnSpeed*game.deltaF);
            
            var oldPlaneX = player.planeX;
            player.planeX = player.planeX * cos(-player.turnSpeed*game.deltaF) - player.planeY * sin(-player.turnSpeed*game.deltaF);
            player.planeY = oldPlaneX * sin(-player.turnSpeed*game.deltaF) + player.planeY * cos(-player.turnSpeed*game.deltaF);
            
            //Sway to right
            if(weaponSway.turnX<weaponSway.maxTurn){
                
                weaponSway.turnX+=player.turnSpeed*game.deltaF;
                
            }
            
        }
        
        //Reset Sway
        else if(weaponSway.turnX>0){
            
            weaponSway.turnX-=player.turnSpeed*game.deltaF;
            
        }
        
        if(keys[39]){
            
            player.angle+=player.turnSpeed*game.deltaF;
            
            //both camera direction and camera plane must be rotated
            var oldDirX = player.dirX;
            player.dirX = player.dirX * cos(player.turnSpeed*game.deltaF) - player.dirY * sin(player.turnSpeed*game.deltaF);
            player.dirY = oldDirX * sin(player.turnSpeed*game.deltaF) + player.dirY * cos(player.turnSpeed*game.deltaF);
            
            var oldPlaneX = player.planeX;
            player.planeX = player.planeX * cos(player.turnSpeed*game.deltaF) - player.planeY * sin(player.turnSpeed*game.deltaF);
            player.planeY = oldPlaneX * sin(player.turnSpeed*game.deltaF) + player.planeY * cos(player.turnSpeed*game.deltaF);
            
            //Sway to left
            if(weaponSway.turnX>-weaponSway.maxTurn){
                
                weaponSway.turnX-=player.turnSpeed*game.deltaF;
                
            }
            
        }
        
        //Reset Sway
        else if(weaponSway.turnX<0){
            
            weaponSway.turnX+=player.turnSpeed*game.deltaF;
            
        }
        
    }
    
    //Shoot
    
    if(((!mouseLocked && keys[38]) || (mouseLocked && mouseIsPressed)) && player.cooldown<=0 && (player.clip[[player.projectile]]>0 || projectileConstants[player.projectile].type==="melee") && (projectileConstants[player.projectile].reloadType!=="charging" || player.clip[[player.projectile]]>=projectileConstants[player.projectile].clip) && player.armed){
        
        //Stop Reloading
        player.reloading=false;
        
        player.reloadTime=0;
        
        //Shoot
        if(projectileConstants[player.projectile].type==="projectile"){
            
            for(var s = 0; s <= projectileConstants[player.projectile].shots-1; s++){
                
                var dud=false;
                var dudNum=0;
                
                //Find duds
                {
                    
                    //Variables for search
                    var i=0;
                    var search=true;
                    
                    //Search
                    while(search){
                        
                        if(projectiles.dud[i]){
                            
                            dudNum=i;
                            
                            dud=true;
                            
                            search=false;
                            
                        }
                        
                        i++;
                        
                        if(i>=projectiles.dud.length-1){
                            
                            search=false;
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
                var angleShot=player.angle+random(-projectileConstants[player.projectile].deviation,projectileConstants[player.projectile].deviation);
                var vAngleShot=player.vAngle+random(-projectileConstants[player.projectile].deviation,projectileConstants[player.projectile].deviation);
                
                var realAngle = angleShot - 90;
                
                var vx = (sin(angleShot)*projectileConstants[player.projectile].speed)*cos(vAngleShot);
                var vy = (cos(angleShot)*-projectileConstants[player.projectile].speed)*cos(vAngleShot);
                var vz = sin(vAngleShot)*projectileConstants[player.projectile].speed;
                
                //Create Projectile
                if(!dud){
                    
                    projectiles.x.push(player.x);
                    projectiles.y.push(player.y);
                    
                    projectiles.speedX.push(vx);
                    projectiles.speedY.push(vy);
                    
                    projectiles.vix.push(vx);
                    projectiles.viy.push(vy);
                    projectiles.viz.push(vz);
                    
                    projectiles.animation.push(0);
                    
                    projectiles.animationFrame.push(0);
                    
                    projectiles.verticalPos.push(player.height - ((player.height - player.floorHeight)/6)); 
                    
                    projectiles.verticalVelocity.push(vz);
                    
                    projectiles.fuse.push(0);
                    
                    projectiles.angle.push(angleShot);
                    
                    projectiles.type.push(player.projectile);
                    
                    projectiles.friendly.push(true);
                    
                    projectiles.dud.push(false);
                    
                }
                
                
                else{
                    
                    
                    projectiles.x[dudNum]=player.x;
                    projectiles.y[dudNum]=player.y;
                    
                    projectiles.speedX[dudNum]=vx;
                    projectiles.speedY[dudNum]=vy;
                    
                    projectiles.vix[dudNum]=vx;
                    projectiles.viy[dudNum]=vy;
                    projectiles.viz[dudNum]=vz;
                    
                    projectiles.animation[dudNum]=0;
                    
                    projectiles.animationFrame[dudNum]=0;
                    projectiles.verticalPos[dudNum]=player.height - (-player.floorHeight/6);
                    
                    projectiles.verticalVelocity[dudNum]=vz;
                    
                    projectiles.fuse[dudNum]=0;
                    
                    projectiles.angle[dudNum]=angleShot;
                    
                    projectiles.type[dudNum]=player.projectile;
                    
                    projectiles.friendly[dudNum]=true;
                    
                    projectiles.dud[dudNum]=false;
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            //Move offscreen
            weaponSway.recoilY-=weaponSway.recoilSpeed;
            
            weaponSway.recoilFactor=-1;
            
            if(weaponSway.recoilY<-weaponSway.maxRecoil){
                
                weaponSway.recoilY=-weaponSway.maxRecoil;
                
                weaponSway.recoilFactor=1;
                
            }
            
        }
        
        if(projectileConstants[player.projectile].type==="hitScan" || projectileConstants[player.projectile].type==="melee"){
            
            //Move offscreen
            weaponSway.recoilY-=weaponSway.recoilSpeed;
            
            weaponSway.recoilFactor=-1;
            
            if(weaponSway.recoilY<-weaponSway.maxRecoil){
                
                weaponSway.recoilY=-weaponSway.maxRecoil;
                
                weaponSway.recoilFactor=1;
                
            }
            
            var enemiesHurt=[];
            
            for(var e=0; e<=enemies.x.length-1; e++){
                
                enemiesHurt.push(0);
                
            }
            
            for(var shot=1; shot<=projectileConstants[player.projectile].shots; shot++){
                
                var angleShot=player.angle+random(-projectileConstants[player.projectile].deviation/2,projectileConstants[player.projectile].deviation/2);
                var vAngleShot=player.vAngle+random(-projectileConstants[player.projectile].deviation,projectileConstants[player.projectile].deviation);
                
                var realAngle = angleShot - 90;
                
                var dz = sin(vAngleShot);
                
                var range = Infinity;
                
                if(projectileConstants[player.projectile].type==="melee"){
                    
                    range = projectileConstants[player.projectile].range;
                    
                }
                
                //Find what enemy it hit
                var hitScanValue=hitScan(angleShot,player.x,player.y,dz,'enemies',player.height,range);
                
                var enemy='none';
                
                if(hitScanValue.hits.length > 0){
                    
                    enemy = hitScanValue.hits[0];
                    
                }
                
                else{
                    
                    enemy = 'none';
                    
                }
                
                //Apply damage if enemy is hit
                if(enemy!=='none'){
                    
                    enemiesHurt[enemy]+=projectileConstants[player.projectile].damage;
                    
                }
                
                var lineAngle=angleShot-player.angle;
                
                var halfFOV=60;
                
                var lineX = (lineAngle/halfFOV)*(width/2);
                
                var vLineAngle=vAngleShot-player.vAngle;
                
                var lineY = -(vLineAngle/halfFOV)*(height/2);
                
                var rx = constrain(random(-3,3),-3 + 4*hitScanValue.nx,3 + 4*hitScanValue.nx);
                var ry = constrain(random(-3,3),-3 + 4*hitScanValue.ny,3 + 4*hitScanValue.ny);
                var rz = constrain(random(-60,60),-60 + 80*hitScanValue.nz,60 + 80*hitScanValue.nz);
                
                //Draw hitscan line
                if(range > hitScanValue.t){
                    
                    //Create a particle and draw a line
                    switch(player.projectile){
                        
                        //Gumball Machine
                        case 3:
                            
                            createParticle(hitScanValue.x+hitScanValue.nx,hitScanValue.y+hitScanValue.ny,rx,ry,hitScanValue.z+hitScanValue.nz,rz,floor(random(9,14)));
                            
                            hitScanLines.color.push([249, 246, 238,100]);
                            hitScanLines.weight.push(3);
                            
                            break;
                        
                        //Shotgun
                        case 6:
                            
                            createParticle(hitScanValue.x+hitScanValue.nx,hitScanValue.y+hitScanValue.ny,rx,ry,hitScanValue.z+hitScanValue.nz,rz,6);
                            
                            hitScanLines.color.push([134, 240, 34,255]);
                            hitScanLines.weight.push(3);
                            
                            break;
                        
                        //Gattling Laser
                        case 7:
                            
                            createParticle(hitScanValue.x+hitScanValue.nx,hitScanValue.y+hitScanValue.ny,0,0,hitScanValue.z+hitScanValue.nz,0,7);
                            
                            hitScanLines.color.push([230, 100, 34,255]);
                            hitScanLines.weight.push(5);
                            
                            break;
                        
                        default:
                            
                            createParticle(hitScanValue.x+hitScanValue.nx,hitScanValue.y+hitScanValue.ny,0,0,hitScanValue.z+hitScanValue.nz,0,1);
                            
                            hitScanLines.color.push([228, 208, 10,255]);
                            hitScanLines.weight.push(3);
                            
                    }
                    
                    var gunX=weaponSway.posX + weaponSway.turnX + weaponSway.strafeX + weaponSway.walkX + weaponSway.switchX + weaponSway.reloadX + -weaponSway.recoilY/1.5;
                    
                    var gunY=weaponSway.posY + weaponSway.turnY + weaponSway.strafeY + weaponSway.walkY + weaponSway.switchY + weaponSway.reloadY + weaponSway.recoilY;
                    
                    if((projectileConstants[player.projectile].type !== 'melee')){
                        
                        hitScanLines.x1.push(game.realWidth/2+lineX);
                        hitScanLines.y1.push(game.realHeight/2+lineY);
                        hitScanLines.x2.push(gunX+projectileConstants[player.projectile].shootX);
                        hitScanLines.y2.push(gunY+projectileConstants[player.projectile].shootY);
                        
                        
                    }
                    
                    else if (enemy.length === 0){
                        
                        playSoundEffect(19);
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            for(var e=0; e<=enemies.x.length-1; e++){
                
                if(enemiesHurt[e]>0){
                    
                    hurt(1,e,enemiesHurt[e],projectileConstants[player.projectile].knockback,atan2(enemies.y[e]-player.y,enemies.x[e]-player.x),atan(((enemies.verticalPos[e]-player.height))/dist(enemies.x[e],enemies.y[e],player.x,player.y)));
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            
        }
        
        //Remove ammo
        if(projectileConstants[player.projectile].type!=="melee"){
            
            if(projectileConstants[player.projectile].reloadable){
                
                player.clip[[player.projectile]]-=projectileConstants[player.projectile].consumption;
                
            }
            
            else{
                
                player.ammo[projectileConstants[player.projectile].ammo]-=projectileConstants[player.projectile].consumption;
                
            }
            
        }
        
        //Fix negative ammo
        if(player.clip[[player.projectile]] < 0){
            
            player.clip[[player.projectile]] = 0;
            
        }
        
        if(player.ammo[projectileConstants[player.projectile].ammo]<0){
            
            player.ammo[projectileConstants[player.projectile].ammo] = 0;
            
        }
        
        //Play Sound Effect
        switch(player.projectile){
            
            case 0:
                
                playSoundEffect(0);
                
                break;
            
            case 5:
                
                playSoundEffect(1);
                
                break;
            
            case 3:
                
                playSoundEffect(2);
                
                break;
                
            case 6:
                
                playSoundEffect(3);
                
                break;
                
            case 7:
                
                playSoundEffect(4);
                
                break;
                
            case 8:
                
                playSoundEffect(5);
                
                break;
                
            case 2:
                
                playSoundEffect(20);
                
                break;
            
            
        }
        
        if(!game.semiPause){
            
            //Add to temp lighting
            tempMap.lighting[floor(player.y/20)][floor(player.x/20)] += projectileConstants[player.projectile].lighting/2;
            
            for(var y = constrain(floor(player.y/20)-1,0,tempMap.lighting.length-1); y <= constrain(floor(player.y/20)+1,0,tempMap.lighting.length-1);y++){
                
                for(var x = constrain(floor(player.x/20)-1,0,tempMap.lighting[y].length-1); x <= constrain(floor(player.x/20)+1,0,tempMap.lighting[y].length-1);x++){
                    
                    tempMap.lighting[y][x] += projectileConstants[player.projectile].lighting/2;
                    
                }
                
            }
            
        }
        
        //Alert enemies
        for(var e = 0; e <= enemies.state.length-1; e++){
            
            if((enemies.state[e] === 'hunting' || enemies.state[e] === 'alert') && enemies.distance[e] <= projectileConstants[player.projectile].audibleRange){
                
                enemies.state[e] = 'hunting';
                
                enemies.target[e] = [player.x,player.y];
                
            }
            
        }
        
        //Set cooldown
        player.cooldown=projectileConstants[player.projectile].cooldown;
        
    }
     
    //Reload
    if(keys[82] && !player.reloading && player.ammo[projectileConstants[player.projectile].ammo]>0 && player.clip[player.projectile]<projectileConstants[player.projectile].clip && player.armed){
        
        player.reloading=true;
        
        //Move offscreen
        weaponSway.reloadY+=weaponSway.reloadSpeed;
        
        weaponSway.reloadFactor=1;
        
        if(weaponSway.reloadY>weaponSway.maxReload){
            
            weaponSway.reloadY=weaponSway.maxReload;
            
            weaponSway.reloadFactor=-1;
            
        }
        
    }
    
    //Switch weapons
    if(keys[16]){
        
        if(!controls.toggles.change && player.armed && player.cooldown <= 0){
            
            //Stop Reload
            {
                
                player.reloading=false;
                
                player.reloadTime=0;
                
            }
            
            //Switch Weapon
            {
                
                var start=player.projectile;
                
                var num=player.projectile;
                
                var found=false;
                
                //Change the number
                
                num++;
                
                //Constrain
                if(num>projectileConstants.length-1){
                    
                    num=0;
                    
                }
                
                if(num<0){
                    
                    num = projectileConstants.length-1;
                    
                }
                
                while(num!==start && !found){
                    
                    if(player.weapons[num]){
                        
                        player.projectile=num;
                        
                        found=true;
                        
                        //Move offscreen
                        weaponSway.switchY+=weaponSway.switchSpeed;
                        
                        weaponSway.switchFactor=1;
                        
                        if(weaponSway.switchY>weaponSway.maxSwitch){
                            
                            weaponSway.switchY=weaponSway.maxSwitch;
                            
                            weaponSway.switchFactor=-1;
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    else{
                        
                        num++;
                        
                        //Constrain
                        if(num>projectileConstants.length-1){
                            
                            num=0;
                            
                        }
                        
                        if(num<0){
                            
                            num = projectileConstants.length-1;
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            //Toggle Control
            controls.toggles.change=true;
            
        }
        
    }
    
    else if(keys[17]){
        
        if(!controls.toggles.change && player.armed && player.cooldown <= 0){
            
            //Stop Reload
            {
                
                player.reloading=false;
                
                player.reloadTime=0;
                
            }
            
            //Switch Weapon
            {
                
                var start=player.projectile;
                
                var num=player.projectile;
                
                var found=false;
                
                //Change the number
                
                
                num--;
                
                
                
                //Constrain
                if(num>projectileConstants.length-1){
                    
                    num=0;
                    
                }
                
                if(num<0){
                    
                    num = projectileConstants.length-1;
                    
                }
                
                while(num!==start && !found){
                    
                    if(player.weapons[num]){
                        
                        player.projectile=num;
                        
                        found=true;
                        
                        //Move offscreen
                        weaponSway.switchY+=weaponSway.switchSpeed;
                        
                        weaponSway.switchFactor=1;
                        
                        if(weaponSway.switchY>weaponSway.maxSwitch){
                            
                            weaponSway.switchY=weaponSway.maxSwitch;
                            
                            weaponSway.switchFactor=-1;
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    else{
                        
                        //Change the number
                        num--;
                        
                        //Constrain
                        if(num>projectileConstants.length-1){
                            
                            num=0;
                            
                        }
                        
                        if(num<0){
                            
                            num = projectileConstants.length-1;
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            //Toggle Control
            controls.toggles.change=true;
            
        }
        
    }
    
    else{
        
        controls.toggles.change=false;
        
    }
    
    //Swap to Sword
    if(keys[49] && player.projectile !== 0){
        
        player.cooldown = 0;
        
        player.projectile=0;
        
        //Move offscreen
        weaponSway.switchY+=weaponSway.switchSpeed;
        
        weaponSway.switchFactor=1;
        
        if(weaponSway.switchY>weaponSway.maxSwitch){
            
            weaponSway.switchY=weaponSway.maxSwitch;
            
            weaponSway.switchFactor=-1;
            
        }
        
        
    }
    
    //Swap to flare/pistol, shotgun/laser shotgun, gumball/laser, firework/launcher
    for(var n = 0; n <= 3; n++){
        
        if(keys[50+n] && player.projectile !== n+1 && (player.weapons[n+1]||player.weapons[n+5])){
            
            player.cooldown = 0;
            
            if(player.weapons[n+1]){
                
                player.projectile=n+1;
                
            }
            
            else{
                
                player.projectile=n+5;
                
            }
            //Move offscreen
            weaponSway.switchY+=weaponSway.switchSpeed;
            
            weaponSway.switchFactor=1;
            
            if(weaponSway.switchY>weaponSway.maxSwitch){
                
                weaponSway.switchY=weaponSway.maxSwitch;
                
                weaponSway.switchFactor=-1;
                
            }
            
            
        }
        
    }
    
    //Interact
    if(keys[69]){
        
        var angleShot=player.angle;
        
        var vAngleShot=player.vAngle;
        
        var dz = sin(vAngleShot);
        
        var range = 30;
        
        //Find what enemy it hit
        var hitScanValue=hitScan(angleShot,player.x,player.y,dz,'enemies',player.height,range);
        
        if(range > hitScanValue.t && hitScanValue.nz === 0){
            
            var x = hitScanValue.mapX;
            var y = hitScanValue.mapY;
            
            tempMap.doorActivated[y][x] = true;
            
        }
        
    }
    
    //Break the cursor
    if(keys[85] || game.cam < 2){
        
        mouseLocked = false;
        
    }
    
    //Jump
    if(keys[32] && player.canJump){
        
        player.vertSpeed=player.jumpSpeed;
        
        player.canJump = false;
        
    }
    
    //Crouch
    if(keys[67]){
        
        player.floorHeight=player.defaultFloorHeight/2;
        
    }
    
    else{
        
        player.floorHeight=player.defaultFloorHeight;
        
    }
    
    }
    
    //DevTools
    if(game.devTools){
        
        //NoClip
        if(keys[73]){
            
            if(!controls.toggles.noClip){
                
                game.noClip=!game.noClip;
                
                controls.toggles.noClip=true;
                
            }
            
        }
        
        else{
            
            controls.toggles.noClip=false;
            
        }
        
        //SemiPause
        if(keys[79]){
            
            if(!controls.toggles.semiPause){
                
                game.semiPause=!game.semiPause;
                
                controls.toggles.semiPause=true;
                
            }
            
        }
        
        else{
            
            controls.toggles.semiPause=false;
            
        }
        
        //Grid
        if(keys[80]){
            
            if(!controls.toggles.grid){
                
                game.grid=!game.grid;
                
                controls.toggles.grid=true;
                
            }
            
        }
        
        else{
            
            controls.toggles.grid=false;
            
        }
        
        //Shift Camera Angles
        if(keys[219]){
            
            if(!controls.toggles.cam){
                
                if(game.cam<controls.maximums.cam){
                    
                    game.cam++;
                    
                }
                
                else{
                    
                    game.cam=0;
                    
                }
                
                controls.toggles.cam=true;
                
            }
            
        }
        
        else{
            
            controls.toggles.cam=false;
            
        }
        
        //Restart Level
        if(keys[221]){
            
            if(!controls.toggles.restart){
                
                var savedMap = compressMap(loadedMap);
                
                maps[game.map]=savedMap;
                
                loadMap(false,false);
                
                controls.toggles.restart=true;
                
            }
            
        }
        
        else{
            
            controls.toggles.restart=false;
            
        }
        
        //Print Level
        if(keys[191]){
            
            if(!controls.toggles.print){
                
                printMap();
                
                controls.toggles.print=true;
                
            }
            
        }
        
        else{
            
            controls.toggles.print=false;
            
        }
        
        //Select ID 
        {
            
            //Down
            if(keys[188] || controls.toggles.downPressed){
                
                if(!controls.toggles.idDown){
                    
                    if(controls.devTools.type!==4){
                        
                        if(controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]>0|| controls.devTools.type === 13 || controls.devTools.type === 14 || controls.devTools.type === 19 || controls.devTools.type === 20){
                            
                            controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]-=controls.devTools.stepSize[controls.devTools.type];
                            
                        }
                        
                        else{
                            
                            controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]=controls.maximums.num;
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    else{
                        
                        if(controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]>0){
                            controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]*=10;
                            controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]-=1;
                            controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]/=10;
                            
                            
                        }
                        
                        else{
                            
                            controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]=1;
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    controls.toggles.idDown=true;
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            else{
                
                controls.toggles.idDown=false;
                
            }
            
            //Up
            if(keys[190] || controls.toggles.upPressed){
                
                if(!controls.toggles.idUp){
                    
                    if(controls.devTools.type!==4){
                        
                        if(controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]<controls.maximums.num || controls.devTools.type === 13 || controls.devTools.type === 14){
                            
                            controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]+=controls.devTools.stepSize[controls.devTools.type];
                            
                        }
                        
                        else{
                            
                            controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]=0;
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    else{
                        
                        if(controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]<1){
                            
                            controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]*=10;
                            controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]+=1;
                            controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]/=10;
                            
                        }
                        
                        else{
                            
                            controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]=0;
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    controls.toggles.idUp=true;
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            else{
                
                controls.toggles.idUp=false;
                
            }
            
        }
        
        //Select Type 
        {
            
            //Down
            if(keys[75]){
                
                if(!controls.toggles.typeDown){
                    
                    if(controls.devTools.type>0){
                        
                        controls.devTools.type--;
                        
                    }
                    
                    else{
                        
                        controls.devTools.type=controls.maximums.type;
                        
                    }
                    
                    controls.toggles.typeDown=true;
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            else{
                
                controls.toggles.typeDown=false;
                
            }
            
            //Up
            if(keys[76]){
                
                if(!controls.toggles.typeUp){
                    
                    if(controls.devTools.type<controls.maximums.type){
                        
                        controls.devTools.type++;
                        
                    }
                    
                    else{
                        
                        controls.devTools.type=0;
                        
                    }
                    
                    controls.toggles.typeUp=true;
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            else{
                
                controls.toggles.typeUp=false;
                
            }
            
        }
        
        //Expand Level
        {
            
            //Expand X
            if(keys[72]){
                
                if(!controls.toggles.expandX){
                    
                    //Add to grid X
                    devAdd('x');
                    
                    controls.toggles.expandX=true;
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            else{
                
                controls.toggles.expandX=false;
                
            }
            
            //Expand Y
            if(keys[74]){
                
                if(!controls.toggles.expandY){
                    
                    devAdd('y');
                    
                    controls.toggles.expandY=true;
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            else{
                
                controls.toggles.expandY=false;
                
            }
            
        }
        
        //Change tile/Create objects
        if(mouseIsPressed && game.cam===0 && floor((mouseY-(game.realHeight/2)+game.camera.y)/20) >= 0 && floor((mouseY-(game.realHeight/2)+game.camera.y)/20) <= loadedMap.layout.length-1 && floor((mouseX-(game.realWidth/2)+game.camera.x)/20) >= 0 && floor((mouseX-(game.realWidth/2)+game.camera.x)/20) <= loadedMap.layout[0].length-1 && !controls.toggles.button){
            
            if((controls.devTools.type === 8 || controls.devTools.type === 9 || controls.devTools.type === 23) && !controls.devTools.deleting){
                
                switch(controls.devTools.type){
                    
                    //Add Enemies    
                    case 8:
                        
                        if(!controls.toggles.enemy){
                            
                            //Add to map
                            loadedMap.enemies.x.push(floor(mouseX-(game.realHeight/2)+game.camera.x));
                            loadedMap.enemies.y.push(floor(mouseY-(game.realHeight/2)+game.camera.y));
                            
                            switch(controls.devTools.spawnLevel){
                                
                                case 'floor':
                                    
                                    loadedMap.enemies.z.push(primaryOrSecondary(floor(mouseX-(game.realHeight/2)+game.camera.x),floor(mouseY-(game.realHeight/2)+game.camera.y),'floor'));
                                    
                                    break;
                                    
                                case 'ceiling':
                                    
                                    loadedMap.enemies.z.push(primaryOrSecondary(floor(mouseX-(game.realHeight/2)+game.camera.x),floor(mouseY-(game.realHeight/2)+game.camera.y),'ceiling'));
                                    
                                    break;
                                
                                case 'none':
                                    
                                    loadedMap.enemies.z.push(controls.devTools.z);
                                    
                                    break;
                                
                            }
                            
                            //loadedMap.enemies.z.push(controls.devTools.z);
                            
                            loadedMap.enemies.angle.push(controls.devTools.angle);
                            
                            loadedMap.enemies.start.push(controls.devTools.start);
                            loadedMap.enemies.spawnTrigger.push(controls.devTools.spawnTrigger);
                            loadedMap.enemies.condition.push(controls.devTools.condition);
                            
                            loadedMap.enemies.type.push(controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]);
                            loadedMap.enemies.state.push(controls.devTools.state);
                            
                            
                            
                            controls.toggles.enemy=true;
                            
                            var states = ['alert','ambush','idle','hunting','attacking'];
                            
                            if(controls.devTools.start){
                                
                                //Add to current variable
                                enemies.x.push(floor(mouseX-(game.realHeight/2)+game.camera.x));
                                enemies.y.push(floor(mouseY-(game.realHeight/2)+game.camera.y));
                                enemies.health.push(enemyConstants[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].health);
                                enemies.speedX.push(0);
                                enemies.speedY.push(0);
                                enemies.vertSpeed.push(0);
                                enemies.animation.push(0);
                                enemies.animationFrame.push(0);
                                enemies.moving.push(false);
                                enemies.faceAngle.push(0);
                                enemies.angle.push(controls.devTools.angle);
                                enemies.moveTime.push(0);
                                enemies.state.push(states[controls.devTools.state]);
                                enemies.cooldown.push(0);
                                //enemies.verticalPos.push(objectConstants[enemyConstants[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].object].verticalPos + primaryOrSecondary(floor(mouseX-(game.realHeight/2)+game.camera.x),floor(mouseY-(game.realHeight/2)+game.camera.y),'floor'));
                                enemies.verticalPos.push(loadedMap.enemies.z.length-1);
                                enemies.animationTime.push(0);
                                
                                enemies.type.push(controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]);
                                
                                enemies.distance.push(dist(player.x,player.y,floor(mouseX-(game.realHeight/2)+player.x),floor(mouseY-(game.realHeight/2)+player.y)));
                                enemies.trigger.push(controls.devTools.condition);
                                enemies.dud.push(false);
                                enemies.levelID.push(loadedMap.enemies.x.length-1);
                                
                                enemies.lastSeen.push([]);
                                enemies.target.push([]);
                                enemies.path.push([]);
                                enemies.next.push([]);
                                
                                game.enemiesSpawned.push(true);
                                
                            }
                            
                            else{
                                
                                game.enemiesSpawned.push(false);
                                
                            }
                            
                        }
                        
                        break;
                        
                    //Add Pickups
                    case 9:
                        
                        if(!controls.toggles.pickup){
                            
                            //Add to map
                            loadedMap.pickups.x.push(floor(mouseX-(game.realHeight/2)+game.camera.x));
                            loadedMap.pickups.y.push(floor(mouseY-(game.realHeight/2)+game.camera.y));
                            
                            loadedMap.pickups.start.push(controls.devTools.start);
                            loadedMap.pickups.spawnTrigger.push(controls.devTools.spawnTrigger);
                            loadedMap.pickups.condition.push(controls.devTools.condition);
                            
                            loadedMap.pickups.type.push(controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]);
                            
                            controls.toggles.pickup=true;
                            
                            
                            if(controls.devTools.start){
                                
                                //Add to current variable
                                pickups.x.push(floor(mouseX-(game.realHeight/2)+game.camera.x));
                                pickups.y.push(floor(mouseY-(game.realHeight/2)+game.camera.y));
                                pickups.type.push(controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]);
                                pickups.trigger.push(controls.devTools.condition);
                                pickups.dud.push(false);
                                pickups.levelID.push(loadedMap.pickups.x.length-1);
                                
                                game.pickupsSpawned.push(true);
                                
                            }
                            
                            else{
                                
                                game.pickupsSpawned.push(false);
                                
                            }
                            
                            
                        }
                        
                        break;
                    
                    //Add decor
                    case 23:
                        
                        if(!controls.toggles.decor){
                            
                            //Add to map
                            loadedMap.decor.x.push(floor(mouseX-(game.realHeight/2)+game.camera.x));
                            loadedMap.decor.y.push(floor(mouseY-(game.realHeight/2)+game.camera.y));
                            
                            var z = 0;
                            
                            switch(controls.devTools.spawnLevel){
                                
                                case 'floor':
                                    
                                    z = primaryOrSecondary(floor(mouseX-(game.realHeight/2)+game.camera.x),floor(mouseY-(game.realHeight/2)+game.camera.y),'floor') + objectConstants[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].height/2-300;
                                    
                                    break;
                                
                                case 'ceiling':

                                    break;

                            loadedMap.decor.z.push(z);
                            
                            loadedMap.decor.object.push(controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]);
                            
                            controls.toggles.decor=true;
                            
                            
                        }
                        
                        break;
                }
                
            }
            
            else if(!controls.devTools.selecting){
                
                controls.devTools.selecting = true;
                
                controls.devTools.startPoint = [floor((mouseX-(game.realWidth/2)+game.camera.x)/20),floor((mouseY-(game.realHeight/2)+game.camera.y)/20)];
                
            }
            
        }
        
        else if(!mouseIsPressed){
            
            //Change tiles that have been selected
            if(controls.devTools.selecting){
                
                for(var x = controls.devTools.selection[0]; x <= controls.devTools.selection[2]; x++){
                    
                    for(var y = controls.devTools.selection[1]; y <= controls.devTools.selection[3]; y++){
                        
                        switch(controls.devTools.type){
                            
                            //Layout
                            case 0:
                                
                                loadedMap.layout[y][x]=controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type];
                                
                                break;
                                
                            //Boundaries
                            case 1:
                                
                                loadedMap.boundaries[y][x]=controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type];
                                
                                break;
                            
                            //Floor   
                            case 2:
                                
                                loadedMap.floorLayout[y][x]=controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type];
                                
                                break;
                            
                            //Ceiling    
                            case 3:
                                
                                loadedMap.ceilingLayout[y][x]=controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type];
                                
                                break;
                            
                            //Lighting    
                            case 4:
                                
                                loadedMap.lighting[y][x]=controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type];
                                tempMap.lighting[y][x]=controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type];
                                
                                loadedMap.defaultLighting[y][x]=controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type];
                                
                                break;
                            
                            //Dynamic Lighting    
                            case 5:
                                
                                loadedMap.dynamicLighting[y][x]=controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type];
                                
                                break;
                                
                            //Doors    
                            case 6:
                                
                                loadedMap.doors[y][x]=controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type];
                                
                                loadedMap.doorOpen[y][x]=controls.devTools.doorOpen;
                                
                                loadedMap.defaultDoorOpen[y][x]=controls.devTools.doorOpen;
                                
                                tempMap.doorOpen[y][x]=controls.devTools.doorOpen;
                                
                                break;
                                
                            //Triggers    
                            case 7:
                                
                                loadedMap.triggers[y][x]=controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type];
                                
                                break;
                            
                            //Load Zone    
                            case 10:
                                
                                loadedMap.loadZone[y][x]=controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type];
                                
                                break;
                                
                            //Overlap   
                            case 11:
                                
                                loadedMap.loadOverlap[y][x]=controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type];
                                
                                break;
                            
                            //Shape 
                            case 12:
                                
                                loadedMap.shape[y][x]=controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type];
                                
                                break;
                                
                            
                            //Floor Height
                            case 13:
                                
                                loadedMap.floorHeight[y][x]=controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type];
                                
                                tempMap.floorHeight[y][x]=controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type];
                                
                                break;
                            //Ceiling Height 
                            case 14:
                                
                                loadedMap.ceilingHeight[y][x]=controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type];
                                tempMap.ceilingHeight[y][x]=controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type];
                                
                                break;
                            //Floor Wall
                            case 15:
                                
                                loadedMap.floorWallLayout[y][x]=controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type];
                                
                                break;
                            //Ceiling Wall
                            case 16:
                                
                                loadedMap.ceilingWallLayout[y][x]=controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type];
                                
                                break;
                            //Floor Shape
                            case 17:
                                
                                loadedMap.floorShape[y][x]=controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type];
                                
                                break;
                            //Ceiling Shape 
                            case 18:
                                
                                loadedMap.ceilingShape[y][x]=controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type];
                                
                                break;
                            //Secondary Floor Height
                            case 19:
                                
                                loadedMap.floorSecondaryHeight[y][x]=controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type];
                                
                                tempMap.floorSecondaryHeight[y][x]=controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type];
                                
                                break;
                            //Secondary Ceiling Height 
                            case 20:
                                
                                loadedMap.ceilingSecondaryHeight[y][x]=controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type];
                                
                                tempMap.ceilingSecondaryHeight[y][x]=controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type];
