                                break;
                            
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
                //Delete enemies or pickups on tiles
                switch(controls.devTools.type){
                    
                    case 8:
                        
                        for(var i = loadedMap.enemies.x.length-1; i >= 0; i--){
                            
                            if(loadedMap.enemies.x[i] >= controls.devTools.selection[0]*20 && loadedMap.enemies.x[i] <= controls.devTools.selection[2]*20+20 && loadedMap.enemies.y[i] >= controls.devTools.selection[1]*20 && loadedMap.enemies.y[i] <= controls.devTools.selection[3]*20+20){
                                
                                loadedMap.enemies.x.splice(i,1);
                                loadedMap.enemies.y.splice(i,1);
                                loadedMap.enemies.z.splice(i,1);
                                loadedMap.enemies.angle.splice(i,1);
                                loadedMap.enemies.start.splice(i,1);
                                loadedMap.enemies.spawnTrigger.splice(i,1);
                                loadedMap.enemies.condition.splice(i,1);
                                loadedMap.enemies.type.splice(i,1);
                                loadedMap.enemies.state.splice(i,1);
                                
                                enemies.x.splice(i,1);
                                enemies.y.splice(i,1);
                                enemies.health.splice(i,1);
                                enemies.speedX.splice(i,1);
                                enemies.speedY.splice(i,1);
                                enemies.animation.splice(i,1);
                                enemies.animationFrame.splice(i,1);
                                enemies.moving.splice(i,1);
                                enemies.faceAngle.splice(i,1);
                                enemies.angle.splice(i,1);
                                enemies.state.splice(i,1);
                                enemies.moveTime.splice(i,1);
                                enemies.cooldown.splice(i,1);
                                enemies.verticalPos.splice(i,1);
                                enemies.vertSpeed.splice(i,1);
                                enemies.animationTime.splice(i,1);
                                enemies.type.splice(i,1);
                                enemies.distance.splice(i,1);
                                enemies.trigger.splice(i,1);
                                enemies.dud.splice(i,1);
                                enemies.levelID.splice(i,1);
                                
                                enemies.lastSeen.splice(i,1);
                                enemies.target.splice(i,1);
                                enemies.path.splice(i,1);
                                enemies.next.splice(i,1);
                                
                                game.enemiesSpawned.splice(i,1);
                                
                            }
                            
                        }
                        
                        break;
                    
                    case 9:
                        
                        for(var i = loadedMap.pickups.x.length-1; i >= 0; i--){
                            
                            if(loadedMap.pickups.x[i] >= controls.devTools.selection[0]*20 && loadedMap.pickups.x[i] <= controls.devTools.selection[2]*20+20 && loadedMap.pickups.y[i] >= controls.devTools.selection[1]*20 && loadedMap.pickups.y[i] <= controls.devTools.selection[3]*20+20){
                                
                                loadedMap.pickups.x.splice(i,1);
                                loadedMap.pickups.y.splice(i,1);
                                loadedMap.pickups.start.splice(i,1);
                                loadedMap.pickups.spawnTrigger.splice(i,1);
                                loadedMap.pickups.condition.splice(i,1);
                                loadedMap.pickups.type.splice(i,1);
                                
                                pickups.x.splice(i,1);
                                pickups.y.splice(i,1);
                                pickups.type.splice(i,1);
                                pickups.trigger.splice(i,1);
                                pickups.dud.splice(i,1);
                                pickups.levelID.splice(i,1);
                                
                                game.pickupsSpawned.splice(i,1);
                                
                            }
                            
                        }
                        
                        break;
                    
                    //Add decor
                    case 23:
                        
                        for(var i = loadedMap.decor.x.length-1; i >= 0; i--){
                            
                            if(loadedMap.decor.x[i] >= controls.devTools.selection[0]*20 && loadedMap.decor.x[i] <= controls.devTools.selection[2]*20+20 && loadedMap.decor.y[i] >= controls.devTools.selection[1]*20 && loadedMap.decor.y[i] <= controls.devTools.selection[3]*20+20){
                                
                                //Add to map
                                loadedMap.decor.x.splice(i,1);
                                loadedMap.decor.y.splice(i,1);
                                
                                loadedMap.decor.z.splice(i,1);
                                
                                loadedMap.decor.object.splice(i,1);
                                
                            }
                            
                        }
                        
                        break;
                    
                    case 21:
                        
                        if(controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type] <= loadedMap.teleporters.length-1){
                            
                            if(controls.devTools.startOrEnd){
                                
                                loadedMap.teleporters[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].x1 = controls.devTools.selection[0];
                                loadedMap.teleporters[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].y1 = controls.devTools.selection[1];
                                loadedMap.teleporters[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].w1 = controls.devTools.selection[2]-controls.devTools.selection[0];
                                loadedMap.teleporters[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].h1 = controls.devTools.selection[3]-controls.devTools.selection[1];
                                
                            }
                            
                            else{
                                
                                loadedMap.teleporters[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].x2 = controls.devTools.selection[0];
                                loadedMap.teleporters[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].y2 = controls.devTools.selection[1];
                                loadedMap.teleporters[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].w2 = controls.devTools.selection[2]-controls.devTools.selection[0];
                                loadedMap.teleporters[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].h2 = controls.devTools.selection[3]-controls.devTools.selection[1];
                                
                            }
                            
                        }
                        
                        break;
                    
                    case 22:
                        
                        if(controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type] <= loadedMap.levelExits.length-1){
                            
                            loadedMap.levelExits[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].x = controls.devTools.selection[0];
                            loadedMap.levelExits[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].y = controls.devTools.selection[1];
                            loadedMap.levelExits[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].w = controls.devTools.selection[2]-controls.devTools.selection[0];
                            loadedMap.levelExits[controls.devTools.num[controls.devTools.type]].h = controls.devTools.selection[3]-controls.devTools.selection[1];
                            
                        }
                        
                        break;
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            //Reset toggles
            controls.toggles.enemy=false;
            
            controls.toggles.pickup=false;
            
            controls.toggles.decor=false;
            
            controls.devTools.selecting = false;
            
        }
        
        //Set the selection range and draw it
        if(controls.devTools.selecting){
            
            //Set it
            controls.devTools.selection = [controls.devTools.startPoint[0],controls.devTools.startPoint[1],constrain(floor((mouseX-(game.realWidth/2)+game.camera.x)/20),0,loadedMap.layout[0].length-1),constrain(floor((mouseY-(game.realHeight/2)+game.camera.y)/20),0,loadedMap.layout.length-1)];
            
            //Swap x or y if they are in the wrong order
            if(controls.devTools.selection[0]>controls.devTools.selection[2]){
                
                var temp = controls.devTools.selection[0];
                
                controls.devTools.selection[0] = controls.devTools.selection[2];
                controls.devTools.selection[2] = temp;
                
            }
            
            if(controls.devTools.selection[1]>controls.devTools.selection[3]){
                
                var temp = controls.devTools.selection[1];
                
                controls.devTools.selection[1] = controls.devTools.selection[3];
                controls.devTools.selection[3] = temp;
                
            }
            
            //Draw it
            fill(250, 167, 25,100);
            
            stroke(5,5,5,200);
            
            rect(controls.devTools.selection[0]*20+(game.realWidth/2)-game.camera.x,controls.devTools.selection[1]*20+(game.realHeight/2)-game.camera.y,(controls.devTools.selection[2]-controls.devTools.selection[0]+1)*20,(controls.devTools.selection[3]-controls.devTools.selection[1]+1)*20);
            
        }
        
    }
    
    //Mobile Controls
    if(mouseIsPressed && game.mobile){
        
        if(mouseY<=200){
            
            player.move=true;
            
            keys[87]=true;
            
            keys[37]=false;
            
            keys[39]=false;
            
        }
        
        else{
            
            player.move=false;
            
            keys[87]=false;
            
        }
        
        
        if(mouseY>200){
            
            if(mouseX<=200){
                
                keys[37]=true;
                
            }
            
            if(mouseX>200){
                
                keys[39]=true;
                
            }
            
        }
        
        else{
            
            keys[37]=false;
            
            keys[39]=false;
            
        }
        
        
    }
    
    if(!mouseIsPressed && game.mobile){
        
        keys[87]=false;
        
        keys[37]=false;
        
        keys[39]=false;
        
        player.move=false;
        
    }
    
    player.cooldown-=game.deltaF;
    
};

//Create explosion
var explosion=function(impactX,impactY,impactZ,normalX,normalY,range,damage,knockback,type,friendly){
    
    //Set explosion type vars
    var limitType = [[1,1],[1.5,1.5],[4,4],[6,6],[5,5]];
    
    var xLimit = limitType[type][0];
    
    var yLimit = limitType[type][1];
    
    var boundX = [-xLimit,xLimit];
    var boundY = [-yLimit,yLimit];
    
    if(normalX === 1){
        
        boundX = [0,xLimit];
        
        
    }
    
    else if(normalX === -1){
        
        
        boundX = [-xLimit,0];
        
    }
    
    if(normalY === 1){
        
        boundY = [0,yLimit];
        
        
    }
    
    else if(normalY === -1){
        
        
        boundY = [-yLimit,0];
        
    }
    
    var partType = [[10,15],[4,7],[7,8],[10,11],[6,8]];
    
    var minPart = partType[type][0];
    
    var maxPart = partType[type][1];
    
    var colorNum = 0;
    
    //Play Sound
    switch(type){
        
        case 1:
            
            
            break;
        
        
        case 2:
            
            
            break;
            
        default:
            
            if(range>0){
                
                playSoundEffect(10);
                
            }
    }
    
    //Make particles
    
    switch(type){
        
        case 2:
            
            createParticle(impactX+normalX*5,impactY+normalY*5,random(boundX[0],boundX[1]),random(boundY[0],boundY[1]),impactZ,random(0,80),18);
            
            break;
            
        case 3:
            
            colorNum = floor(random(0,4))*2;
            
            break;
            
        default:
            
            if(range>0){
                
                createParticle(impactX+normalX*5,impactY+normalY*5,0,0,impactZ,0,41);
                
            }
            
        
    }
    
    for(var p = 0; p <= random(minPart,maxPart); p++){
        
        switch(type){
            
            case 1:
                
                createParticle(impactX+random(-range/2,range/2),impactY+random(-range/2,range/2),random(boundX[0],boundX[1]),random(boundY[0],boundY[1]),impactZ,random(-30,30),1);
                
                createParticle(impactX+random(-range/2,range/2),impactY+random(-range/2,range/2),random(boundX[0],boundX[1]),random(boundY[0],boundY[1]),impactZ,random(-30,30),5);
                
            break;
            
            case 2:
                
                createParticle(impactX+random(-range/2,range/2),impactY+random(-range/2,range/2),random(boundX[0],boundX[1]),random(boundY[0],boundY[1]),impactZ,random(-80,80),16);
                
                createParticle(impactX+random(-range/2,range/2),impactY+random(-range/2,range/2),random(boundX[0]/4,boundX[1]/4),random(boundY[0]/4,boundY[1]/4),impactZ,random(-10,10),17);
                
                break;
            
            case 3:
                
                createParticle(impactX+random(-range/20,range/20),impactY+random(-range/20,range/20),0,0,impactZ,0,22);
                
                createParticle(impactX,impactY,random(boundX[0],boundX[1]),random(boundY[0],boundY[1]),impactZ,random(-80,80),23 + colorNum);
                
                createParticle(impactX+random(-range/2,range/2),impactY+random(-range/2,range/2),random(boundX[0]/4,boundX[1]/4),random(boundY[0]/4,boundY[1]/4),impactZ+random(-range/2,range/2)*20,random(-10,10),17);
                
                createParticle(impactX+random(-range/2,range/2),impactY+random(-range/2,range/2),random(boundX[0]/4,boundX[1]/4),random(boundY[0]/4,boundY[1]/4),impactZ+random(-range/2,range/2)*20,random(-10,10),20);
                
                createParticle(impactX+random(-range/2,range/2),impactY+random(-range/2,range/2),random(boundX[0]/4,boundX[1]/4),random(boundY[0]/4,boundY[1]/4),impactZ+random(-range/2,range/2)*20,random(-10,10),19);
                
            break;
            
            case 4:
                
                for(var n = 0; n <= 3; n++){
                    createParticle(impactX+random(-range/2,range/2),impactY+random(-range/2,range/2),random(boundX[0],boundX[1]),random(boundY[0],boundY[1]),impactZ,random(-30,30),1);
                }
                
                createParticle(impactX+random(-range/2,range/2),impactY+random(-range/2,range/2),random(boundX[0],boundX[1]),random(boundY[0],boundY[1]),impactZ,random(-30,30),8);
                
            break;
            
            default:
                
                if(range>0){
                    
                    createParticle(impactX+random(-range/2,range/2),impactY+random(-range/2,range/2),random(boundX[0],boundX[1]),random(boundY[0],boundY[1]),impactZ,random(-30,30),40);
                    
                    createParticle(impactX+random(-range/2,range/2),impactY+random(-range/2,range/2),random(boundX[0],boundX[1]),random(boundY[0],boundY[1]),impactZ,random(-30,30),42);
                    
                }
                
            break;
        
        }
        
    }
    
    //Check enemies
    for(var e = 0; e <= enemies.x.length-1; e++){
        
        if(dist(impactX,impactY,enemies.x[e],enemies.y[e])<=range && !enemies.dud[e]){
            
            var eHeight = enemies.verticalPos[e] + enemyConstants[enemies.type[e]].height/2;
            
            var dt = constrain(damage * ((range - dist(impactX,impactY,enemies.x[e],enemies.y[e])+enemyConstants[enemies.type[e]].width)/range),damage*0.2,damage);
            
            hurt(1,e,dt,knockback,atan2(enemies.y[e]-impactY,enemies.x[e]-impactX),atan(((eHeight-impactZ))/(dist(impactX,impactY,player.x,player.y))));
            
            
        }
        
    }
    
    //Check player
    if(dist(impactX,impactY,player.x,player.y)<=range){
        
        var pHeight = player.height+player.floorHeight/2;
        
        var dt = constrain(damage * ((range - dist(impactX,impactY,player.x,player.y)+player.width)/range),damage*0.2,damage);
        
        if(!friendly){
            
            hurt(0,0,dt,knockback,atan2(player.y-impactY,player.x-impactX),atan(((player.height-impactZ))/dist(impactX,impactY,player.x,player.y)));
            
        }
        
        else{
            
            hurt(0,0,dt/3,knockback,atan2(player.y-impactY,player.x-impactX),atan(((player.height-impactZ))/dist(impactX,impactY,player.x,player.y)));
            
        }
        
    }
    
};


//Map specific scripts
var mapScripts = function(){
    
    //Map specific actions
    switch(loadedMap.name){
        
        case 'mines_1':
            
            if(player.height<-4000){
                
                player.health = 0;
                
            }
            
            if(player.height>=2000 && !game.triggers[8].includes(false)){
                
                game.map++;
                
                loadMap();
                
                return;
                
            }
            
            break;
        
        case 'mines_2':
            
            if(player.height<=-3000){
                
                player.health = 0;
                
            }
            
            for(var i = 0; i <= enemies.health.length; i++){
                
                if(enemies.verticalPos[i]<=-3000 && !enemies.dud[i]){
                    
                    hurt(1,i,enemies.health[i],0,0,0);
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            if(player.height<=-2000 && !game.triggers[10].includes(false)){
                
                game.map++;
                
                loadMap();
                
                return;
                
            }
            
            //Trigger explosions when you encounter dynamite guy
            if(!game.triggers[8].includes(false)){
                
                //impactX,impactY,impactZ,normalX,normalY,range,damage,knockback,type,friendly
                
                if(mapVars[0][1]<7){
                    
                    if(mapVars[0][0] <= 0){
                        
                        switch(mapVars[0][1]){
                            
                            case 0:
                                
                                //m
                                explosion(1520,1034,-200,0,1,20,0,0,0,false);
                                explosion(1480,1034,-500,0,1,20,0,0,0,false);
                                
                                //l
                                explosion(1569,1027,-600,0,1,15,0,0,0,false);
                                
                                //r
                                explosion(1410,1027,-600,0,1,15,0,0,0,false);
                                
                                break;
                            
                            case 1:
                                
                                
                                //m
                                explosion(1420,1034,-100,0,1,20,0,0,0,false);
                                explosion(1500,1034,-700,0,1,20,0,0,0,false);
                                
                                //l
                                explosion(1549,1027,-500,0,1,15,0,0,0,false);
                                
                                //r
                                explosion(1430,1027,-300,0,1,15,0,0,0,false);
                                
                                
                                break;
                            
                            case 2:
                                
                                
                                //m
                                explosion(1460,1034,-300,0,1,20,0,0,0,false);
                                explosion(1535,1034,-600,0,1,20,0,0,0,false);
                                
                                //l
                                explosion(1550,1027,-100,0,1,15,0,0,0,false);
                                
                                //r
                                explosion(1420,1027,-700,0,1,15,0,0,0,false);
                                
                                
                                break;
                            
                            case 3:
                                
                                
                                //m
                                explosion(1520,1034,-200,0,1,20,0,0,0,false);
                                explosion(1480,1034,-500,0,1,20,0,0,0,false);
                                
                                //l
                                explosion(1569,1027,-600,0,1,15,0,0,0,false);
                                
                                //r
                                explosion(1410,1027,-600,0,1,15,0,0,0,false);
                                
                                
                                break;
                            
                            case 4:
                                
                                
                                //m
                                explosion(1420,1034,-100,0,1,20,0,0,0,false);
                                explosion(1500,1034,-700,0,1,20,0,0,0,false);
                                
                                //l
                                explosion(1549,1027,-500,0,1,15,0,0,0,false);
                                
                                //r
                                explosion(1430,1027,-300,0,1,15,0,0,0,false);
                                
                                
                                break;
                            
                            case 5:
                                
                                
                                //m
                                explosion(1520,1034,-200,0,1,20,0,0,0,false);
                                explosion(1480,1034,-500,0,1,20,0,0,0,false);
                                
                                //l
                                explosion(1569,1027,-600,0,1,15,0,0,0,false);
                                
                                //r
                                explosion(1410,1027,-600,0,1,15,0,0,0,false);
                                
                                
                                
                                break;
                            
                            case 6:
                                
                                
                                //m
                                explosion(1420,1034,-100,0,1,20,0,0,0,false);
                                explosion(1500,1034,-700,0,1,20,0,0,0,false);
                                
                                //l
                                explosion(1549,1027,-500,0,1,15,0,0,0,false);
                                
                                //r
                                explosion(1430,1027,-300,0,1,15,0,0,0,false);
                                
                                
                                break;
                            
                        }
                        
                        mapVars[0][0] = 7;
                        
                        mapVars[0][1]++;
                        
                    }
                    
                    else{
                        
                        mapVars[0][0] -= game.deltaF;
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
            }
            
        break;
        
        case 'mines_3':
            
            
            if(player.height<=-4000){
                
                player.health = 0;
                
            }
            
            for(var i = 0; i <= enemies.health.length; i++){
                
                if(enemies.verticalPos[i]<=-3000 && !enemies.dud[i]){
                    
                    hurt(1,i,enemies.health[i],0,0,0);
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            if(player.height<=-2000 && !game.triggers[9].includes(false)){
                
                game.map++;
                
                loadMap();
                
                return;
                
            }
            
            
            break;
            
        case 'mines_4':
            
            //Non boss stuff
            
            if(player.height<=-4000){
                
                player.health = 0;
                
            }
            
            if(player.height>=2000 && !game.triggers[2].includes(false)){
                
                game.map++;
                
                loadMap();
                
                return;
                
            }
            
            //Set vars based on target
            if(mapVars[1][0] === 'init'){
                
                for(var i = 0; i <= enemies.type.length-1; i++){
                    
                    switch(enemies.type[i]){
                        
                        case 9:
                            
                            mapVars[1][3] = i;
                            
                            break;
                        
                        case 10:
                            
                            mapVars[1][7] = i;
                            
                            break;
                        
                        case 11:
                            
                            mapVars[1][11] = i;
                            
                            break;
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
                player.height=10000;
                
                mapVars[1][0] = 'intro';
                
            }
            
            //Create plaintext vars (only useful for constants)
            var hi = mapVars[1][3];
            var li = mapVars[1][7];
            var ri = mapVars[1][11];
            
            var leftHandDead = enemies.dud[li];
            var rightHandDead = enemies.dud[ri];
            
            var heightOffset = 100;
            var idleTime = 150;
            var reelTime = 60;
            var attackTime = [40,6,60,120];
            var projCooldown = 3;
            
            //attacking index
            var ai = -1;
            
            //println(mapVars[1][0]);
            
            //Do one last check for if the king is dead
            if(enemies.dud[hi]){
                
                mapVars[1][0] = 'dead';
                
            }
            
            //Mode based behavior
            switch(mapVars[1][0]){
                
                case 'intro':
                    
                    {
                        
                        //Mode timer
                        mapVars[1][1] -= game.deltaF;
                        
                        //Intro Start timer
                        mapVars[1][2] -= game.deltaF;
                        
                        //Stay down at first
                        if(mapVars[1][2] > 0){
                            
                            mapVars[1][6]=-3000+heightOffset;
                            mapVars[1][10]=-3000+heightOffset;
                            mapVars[1][14]=-3000+heightOffset;
                            
                        }
                        
                        //Pop up
                        else{
                            
                            mapVars[1][6] = 40*sin((millis()/1000)*180)+heightOffset;
                            mapVars[1][10] = 20*sin((millis()/1000)*180)+heightOffset;
                            mapVars[1][14] = 20*sin((millis()/1000)*180)+heightOffset;
                            
                        }
                        
                        if(mapVars[1][1]<=0){
                            
                            mapVars[1][0] = 'idle';
                            
                            mapVars[1][1] = idleTime;
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    break;
                
                case 'idle':
                    
                    {
                        
                        //First see if we needed to swap hands
                        if((player.x<330 || rightHandDead) && !leftHandDead){
                            
                            mapVars[1][15] = 'left';
                            
                        }
                        
                        if((player.x>390 || leftHandDead) && !rightHandDead){
                            
                            mapVars[1][15] = 'right';
                            
                        }
                        
                        //Bobbing motion
                        mapVars[1][6] = 40*sin((millis()/1000)*180)+heightOffset;
                        mapVars[1][10] = 20*sin((millis()/1000)*180)+heightOffset;
                        mapVars[1][14] = 20*sin((millis()/1000)*180)+heightOffset;
                        
                        //Based on active hand we set target positions
                        var activeDisp = 0;
                        var idleDisp = 0;
                        var perpInv = 1;
                        
                        if(mapVars[1][15] === 'right'){
                            
                            activeDisp = 4;
                            
                        }
                        
                        else{
                            
                            idleDisp = 4;
                            
                            perpInv = -1;
                            
                        }
                        
                        //Start vector math
                        
                        //Unit vector from skull to player
                        var pvd = dist(player.x,player.y,enemies.x[hi],enemies.y[hi]);
                        
                        var pvx = (player.x - enemies.x[hi])/pvd;
                        var pvy = (player.y - enemies.y[hi])/pvd;
                        
                        //Perpendicular vector
                        var opvx = pvy*perpInv;
                        var opvy = -pvx*perpInv;
                        
                        //Set the targets
                        var al = pvd/2;
                        var il = 20;
                        var iw = 35;
                        
                        //Active
                        mapVars[1][8+activeDisp]=enemies.x[hi] + pvx*al;
                        mapVars[1][9+activeDisp]=enemies.y[hi] + pvy*al;
                        
                        //Passive
                        mapVars[1][8+idleDisp]=enemies.x[hi] + pvx*il + opvx*iw;
                        mapVars[1][9+idleDisp]=enemies.y[hi] + pvy*il + opvy*iw;
                        
                        //Swap to attack
                        
                        //Mode timer
                        mapVars[1][1] -= game.deltaF;
                        
                        if(mapVars[1][1]<=0){
                            
                            mapVars[1][0] = 'reel';
                            
                            mapVars[1][1] = reelTime;
                            
                            //reel uses the left right variable to tell which one is going to be attacking, we swap these if there's both hands still, but we keep the single useful hand the same so it can swap to the attack position
                            if(!leftHandDead && !rightHandDead){
                                
                                if(mapVars[1][15] === 'right'){
                                    
                                    mapVars[1][15] = 'left';
                                    
                                }
                                
                                else{
                                    
                                    mapVars[1][15] = 'right';
                                    
                                }
                                
                            }
                            
                            //Pick attack
                            mapVars[1][16] = floor(random(0,3));
                            
                            //Skull Attack
                            if(leftHandDead && rightHandDead){
                                
                                mapVars[1][16] = 3;
                                
                            }
                            //mapVars[1][16] = 2;
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    break;
                
                case 'reel':
                    
                    {
                        
                        //Bobbing motion
                        mapVars[1][6] = 40*sin((millis()/1000)*180)+heightOffset;
                        mapVars[1][10] = 20*sin((millis()/1000)*180)+heightOffset;
                        mapVars[1][14] = 20*sin((millis()/1000)*180)+heightOffset;
                        
                        //Based on active hand we set target positions
                        var blockDisp = 0;
                        var attackDisp = 0;
                        var perpInv = 1;
                        
                        if(mapVars[1][15] === 'left'){
                            
                            blockDisp = 4;
                            
                        }
                        
                        else{
                            
                            attackDisp = 4;
                            
                            perpInv = -1;
                            
                        }
                        
                        //Start vector math
                        
                        //Unit vector from skull to player
                        var pvd = dist(player.x,player.y,enemies.x[hi],enemies.y[hi]);
                        
                        var pvx = (player.x - enemies.x[hi])/pvd;
                        var pvy = (player.y - enemies.y[hi])/pvd;
                        
                        //Perpendicular vector
                        var opvx = pvy*perpInv;
                        var opvy = -pvx*perpInv;
                        
                        //Set the targets
                        var al = pvd/2;
                        var il = 20;
                        var iw = 35;
                        
                        //Block
                        mapVars[1][8+blockDisp]=enemies.x[hi] + pvx*al;
                        mapVars[1][9+blockDisp]=enemies.y[hi] + pvy*al;
                        
                        ai = mapVars[1][7+attackDisp];
                        
                        switch(mapVars[1][16]){
                            
                            //Swipe
                            case 0:
                                
                                //Save distance
                                mapVars[1][17] = pvd;
                                
                                //Change to slap hand
                                enemies.animation[ai] = 1;
                                
                                //Hold hand back
                                mapVars[1][8+attackDisp]=enemies.x[hi] + pvd*(-perpInv);
                                mapVars[1][9+attackDisp]=enemies.y[hi];
                                
                                mapVars[1][10+attackDisp] -= 100;
                                
                                break;
                            
                            //Punch
                            case 1:
                                
                                //Save distance
                                mapVars[1][18] = player.x;
                                mapVars[1][19] = player.y;
                                
                                mapVars[1][20] = enemies.x[ai];
                                mapVars[1][21] = enemies.y[ai];
                                
                                //Change to fist hand
                                enemies.animation[ai] = 2;
                                
                                var il = -10;
                                var iw = 55;
                                
                                //Hold hand back
                                mapVars[1][8+attackDisp]=enemies.x[hi] + pvx*il + opvx*iw;
                                mapVars[1][9+attackDisp]=enemies.y[hi] + pvy*il + opvy*iw;
                                
                                mapVars[1][10+attackDisp] -= 100;
                                
                                break;
                            
                            //Projectile
                            case 2:
                                
                                //Change to open hand
                                enemies.animation[ai] = 0;
                                
                                var il = 30;
                                var iw = 50;
                                
                                //Hold hand back
                                mapVars[1][8+attackDisp]=enemies.x[hi] + pvx*il + opvx*iw;
                                mapVars[1][9+attackDisp]=enemies.y[hi] + pvy*il + opvy*iw;
                                
                                break;
                            
                            //Head only
                            case 3:
                                
                                //Track player
                                mapVars[1][4] = player.x;
                                
                                //Save distance
                                mapVars[1][17] = pvd;
                                
                                //Hijack unused var for whcih way it should move
                                mapVars[1][18] = enemies.speedX[hi]/abs(enemies.speedX[hi]);
                                
                                
                                break;
                            
                        }
                        
                        //Swap to attack
                        
                        //Mode timer
                        mapVars[1][1] -= game.deltaF;
                        
                        if(mapVars[1][1]<=0){
                            
                            mapVars[1][0] = 'attack';
                            
                            mapVars[1][1] = attackTime[mapVars[1][16]];
                            
                            enemies.animation[hi] = 1;
                            enemies.vertSpeed[ai] = 0;
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    break;
                    
                
                case 'attack':
                    
                    {
                        
                        //Bobbing motion
                        mapVars[1][6] = 40*sin((millis()/1000)*180)+heightOffset;
                        mapVars[1][10] = 20*sin((millis()/1000)*180)+heightOffset;
                        mapVars[1][14] = 20*sin((millis()/1000)*180)+heightOffset;
                        
                        //Based on active hand we set target positions
                        var blockDisp = 0;
                        var attackDisp = 0;
                        var perpInv = 1;
                        
                        if(mapVars[1][15] === 'left'){
                            
                            blockDisp = 4;
                            
                        }
                        
                        else{
                            
                            attackDisp = 4;
                            
                            perpInv = -1;
                            
                        }
                        
                        //Start vector math
                        
                        //Unit vector from skull to player
                        var pvd = dist(player.x,player.y,enemies.x[hi],enemies.y[hi]);
                        
                        var pvx = (player.x - enemies.x[hi])/pvd;
                        var pvy = (player.y - enemies.y[hi])/pvd;
                        
                        //Perpendicular vector
                        var opvx = pvy*perpInv;
                        var opvy = -pvx*perpInv;
                        
                        //Set the targets
                        var al = pvd/2;
                        
                        //Block
                        mapVars[1][8+blockDisp]=enemies.x[hi] + pvx*al;
                        mapVars[1][9+blockDisp]=enemies.y[hi] + pvy*al;
                        
                        ai = mapVars[1][7+attackDisp];
                        
                        if(enemies.dud[ai] && mapVars[1][16] !== 3){
                            
                            mapVars[1][1] = 0;
                            
                        }
                        
                        var attackProg = attackTime[mapVars[1][16]]-mapVars[1][1];
                        
                        switch(mapVars[1][16]){
                            
                            //Swipe
                            case 0:
                                
                                //Change to slap hand
                                enemies.animation[ai] = 1;
                                
                                var currentAngle = 180 * (attackProg/attackTime[mapVars[1][16]]) -180;
                                
                                var tf = 1;
                                
                                if(mapVars[1][15] === 'right'){
                                    
                                    //currentAngle += 180;
                                    tf = -1;
                                    
                                }
                                
                                enemies.x[ai] = enemies.x[hi] + mapVars[1][17] * cos(currentAngle) * tf;
                                enemies.y[ai] = enemies.y[hi] + mapVars[1][17] * sin(currentAngle);
                                
                                enemies.angle[ai] = tf*currentAngle + 180;
                                
                                //Check if the player gets hit 
                                if(dist(player.x,player.y,enemies.x[ai],enemies.y[ai]) < player.width/2 + enemyConstants[enemies.type[ai]].width/2){
                                    
                                    //Stop attacking
                                    mapVars[1][1] = 0;
                                    
                                    //var hurt=function(type,num,damage,knockback,angle,vAngle){
                                    hurt(0,0,enemyConstants[enemies.type[ai]].damage,5,tf*currentAngle + 90,45);
                                    
                                }
                                
                                break;
                            
                            //Punch
                            case 1:
                                
                                //Change to fist hand
                                enemies.animation[ai] = 2;
                                
                                enemies.x[ai] = mapVars[1][20] + (mapVars[1][18]-mapVars[1][20])*(attackProg/attackTime[mapVars[1][16]]);
                                enemies.y[ai] = mapVars[1][21] + (mapVars[1][19]-mapVars[1][21])*(attackProg/attackTime[mapVars[1][16]]);
                                
                                var currentAngle = atan2(mapVars[1][18]-mapVars[1][20],mapVars[1][21]-mapVars[1][19])-90;
                                
                                //Check if the player gets hit 
                                if(dist(player.x,player.y,enemies.x[ai],enemies.y[ai]) < player.width/2 + enemyConstants[enemies.type[ai]].width/2){
                                    
                                    //Stop attacking
                                    mapVars[1][1] = 0;
                                    
                                    //var hurt=function(type,num,damage,knockback,angle,vAngle){
                                    hurt(0,0,enemyConstants[enemies.type[ai]].damage*1.5,8,currentAngle,0);
                                    
                                }
                                
                                break;
                            
                            //Projectile
                            case 2:
                            case 3:
                                
                                //Change to open hand
                                enemies.animation[ai] = 3;
                                
                                if(mapVars[1][16]===3){
                                    
                                    ai = hi;
                                    
                                    enemies.speedX[ai] = 0;
                                    
                                    enemies.speedY[ai] = 0;
                                    
                                    enemies.vertSpeed[ai] = 0;
                                    
                                    enemies.angle[ai]=-atan2(player.x-enemies.x[ai],player.y-enemies.y[ai])+180;
                                    
                                    var currentAngle = -mapVars[1][18]*360 * (attackProg/attackTime[mapVars[1][16]]) +90;
                                    
                                    enemies.x[ai] = constrain(player.x + mapVars[1][17] * cos(currentAngle),110,610);
                                    enemies.y[ai] = constrain(player.y + mapVars[1][17] * sin(currentAngle),125,470);
                                    
                                }
                                
                                if(mapVars[1][22] <= 0){
                                    
                                    var proj =15;
                                    var dz = random(-0.1,0.1);
                                    
                                    var dud=false;
                                    var dudNum=0;
                                    
                                    //Find duds
                                    {
                                        
                                        //Variables for search
                                        var d=0;
                                        var search=true;
                                        //Search
                                        while(search){
                                            
                                            if(projectiles.dud[d]){
                                                
                                                dudNum=d;
                                                
                                                dud=true;
                                                
                                                search=false;
                                                
                                            }
                                            
                                            d++;
                                            
                                            if(d>=projectiles.dud.length-1){
                                                
                                                search=false;
                                                
                                            }
                                            
                                        }
                                        
                                    }
                                    
                                    var angleShot=enemies.angle[ai]+random(-projectileConstants[proj].deviation,projectileConstants[proj].deviation);
                                    var vAngleShot=0+random(-projectileConstants[proj].deviation,projectileConstants[proj].deviation);
                                    
                                    var realAngle = angleShot - 90;
                                    
                                    var x = enemies.x[ai];
                                    var y = enemies.y[ai];
                                    var z = enemies.verticalPos[ai] + enemyConstants[enemies.type[ai]].height/2 - 450;
                                    
                                    var vx = (sin(angleShot)*projectileConstants[proj].speed)*cos(vAngleShot);
                                    var vy = (cos(angleShot)*-projectileConstants[proj].speed)*cos(vAngleShot);
                                    var vz = dz*projectileConstants[proj].speed;
                                    
                                    //Create Projectile
                                    if(!dud){
                                        
                                        projectiles.x.push(x);
                                        projectiles.y.push(y);
                                        
                                        projectiles.speedX.push(vx);
                                        projectiles.speedY.push(vy);
                                        
                                        projectiles.vix.push(vx);
                                        projectiles.viy.push(vy);
                                        projectiles.viz.push(vz);
                                        
                                        projectiles.animation.push(0);
                                        
                                        projectiles.animationFrame.push(0);
                                        
                                        projectiles.verticalPos.push(z);
                                        //projectiles.verticalPos.push(0); 
                                        
                                        projectiles.verticalVelocity.push(vz);
                                        
                                        projectiles.fuse.push(0);
                                        
                                        projectiles.angle.push(angleShot);
                                        
                                        projectiles.type.push(proj);
                                        
                                        projectiles.friendly.push(false);
                                        
                                        projectiles.dud.push(false);
                                        
                                    }
                                    
                                    else{
                                        
                                        projectiles.x[dudNum]=x;
                                        projectiles.y[dudNum]=y;
                                        
                                        projectiles.speedX[dudNum]=vx;
                                        projectiles.speedY[dudNum]=vy;
                                        
                                        projectiles.vix[dudNum]=vx;
                                        projectiles.viy[dudNum]=vy;
                                        projectiles.viz[dudNum]=vz;
                                        
                                        projectiles.animation[dudNum]=0;
                                        
                                        projectiles.animationFrame[dudNum]=0;
                                        projectiles.verticalPos[dudNum]=z;
                                        
                                        projectiles.verticalVelocity[dudNum]=vz;
                                        
                                        projectiles.fuse[dudNum]=0;
                                        
                                        projectiles.angle[dudNum]=angleShot;
                                        
                                        projectiles.type[dudNum]=proj;
                                        
                                        projectiles.friendly[dudNum]=false;
                                        
                                        projectiles.dud[dudNum]=false;
                                        
                                    }
                                    
                                    mapVars[1][22] = projCooldown;
                                    
                                    //Make particles
                                    for(var p = 0; p <= random(1,2); p++){
                                        
                                        var xSpeed = random(-2,2);
                                        var ySpeed = random(-2,2);
                                        
                                        createParticle(x+random(-7,7),y+random(-7,7),xSpeed,ySpeed,z,random(-10,10),19);
                                        
                                    }
                                    
                                }
                                
                                else{
                                    
                                    mapVars[1][22] -= game.deltaF;
                                    
                                }
                                
                                break;
                            
                        } 
                        
                        //Swap to idle
                        
                        //Mode timer
                        mapVars[1][1] -= game.deltaF;
                        
                        if(mapVars[1][1]<=0){
                            
                            mapVars[1][0] = 'idle';
                            
                            mapVars[1][1] = idleTime;
                            
                            if(!leftHandDead || !rightHandDead){
                                
                                if(mapVars[1][15] === 'right'){
                                    
                                    mapVars[1][15] = 'left';
                                    
                                }
                                
                                else{
                                    
                                    mapVars[1][15] = 'right';
                                    
                                }
                                
                            }
                            
                            enemies.animation[mapVars[1][7]]=0;
                            enemies.animation[mapVars[1][11]]=0;
                            
                            enemies.animation[hi] = 0;
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    break;
                
                case 'dead':
                    
                    mapVars[1][8]=317;
                    mapVars[1][9]=466;
                    mapVars[1][10]=-5000;
                    enemies.animation[li] = 2;
                    
                    mapVars[1][12]=400;
                    mapVars[1][13]=466;
                    mapVars[1][14]=-5000;
                    enemies.animation[ri] = 2;
                    
                    break;
                
            }
            
            //Move toward target positions
            if(mapVars[1][0] !== 'init'){
                
                //Plaintext target vars
                var hx = mapVars[1][4];
                var hy = mapVars[1][5];
                var hz = mapVars[1][6];
                //var hd = dist(hx,hy,hz/20,enemies.x[hi],enemies.y[hi],enemies.verticalPos[hi]/20);
                
                var lx = mapVars[1][8];
                var ly = mapVars[1][9];
                var lz = mapVars[1][10];
                //var ld = dist(lx,ly,lz/20,enemies.x[li],enemies.y[li],enemies.verticalPos[li]/20);
                
                var rx = mapVars[1][12];
                var ry = mapVars[1][13];
                var rz = mapVars[1][14];
                //var rd = dist(rx,ry,rz/20,enemies.x[ri],enemies.y[ri],enemies.verticalPos[ri]/20);
                
                var ia = [hi,li,ri];
                var xa = [hx,lx,rx];
                var ya = [hy,ly,ry];
                var za = [hz,lz,rz];
                
                //Loop through the head and hands
                for(var i = 0; i <= 2; i++){
                    
                    var ti = ia[i];
                    var tx = xa[i];
                    var ty = ya[i];
                    var tz = za[i];
                    
                    if((mapVars[1][0] !== 'attack' || ti !== ai) || mapVars[1][16] === 2){
                        
                        var acc = 0.01;
                        
                        //Move toward target 
                        enemies.speedX[ti] += acc*(tx-enemies.x[ti]);
                        enemies.speedY[ti] += acc*(ty-enemies.y[ti]);
                        enemies.vertSpeed[ti] += acc*((tz-enemies.verticalPos[ti]));
                        
                        //Slow down
                        enemies.speedX[ti] *= 0.9;
                        enemies.speedY[ti] *= 0.9;
                        enemies.vertSpeed[ti] *= 0.9;
                        
                        //Cap the ends of the speed
                        var minSpeed = 0.1;
                        var maxSpeed = 20;
                        
                        var tSpeed = dist(0,0,0,enemies.speedX[ti],enemies.speedY[ti],enemies.vertSpeed[ti]);
                        
                        if(tSpeed > maxSpeed){
                            
                            enemies.speedX[ti] = (enemies.speedX[ti]/tSpeed)*maxSpeed;
                            enemies.speedY[ti] = (enemies.speedY[ti]/tSpeed)*maxSpeed;
                            enemies.vertSpeed[ti] = (enemies.vertSpeed[ti]/tSpeed)*maxSpeed;
                            
                        }
                        
                        /*
                        if(tSpeed < minSpeed){
                            
                            enemies.speedX[ti] = (enemies.speedX[ti]/tSpeed)*minSpeed;
                            enemies.speedY[ti] = (enemies.speedY[ti]/tSpeed)*minSpeed;
                            enemies.vertSpeed[ti] = (enemies.vertSpeed[ti]/tSpeed)*minSpeed*20;
                            
                        }
                        */
                        
                        //Stop once youre about to cross over the limit
                        var hMinX = min(enemies.x[ti],enemies.x[ti]+enemies.speedX[ti]);
                        var hMaxX = max(enemies.x[ti],enemies.x[ti]+enemies.speedX[ti]);
                        
                        if(constrain(tx,hMinX,hMaxX) === tx && tSpeed < 1){
                            
                            enemies.x[ti] = tx;
                            enemies.speedX[ti] = 0;
                            
                        }
                        
                        var hMinY = min(enemies.y[ti],enemies.y[ti]+enemies.speedY[ti]);
                        var hMaxY = max(enemies.y[ti],enemies.y[ti]+enemies.speedY[ti]);
                        
                        if(constrain(ty,hMinY,hMaxY) === ty && tSpeed < 1){
                            
                            enemies.y[ti] = ty;
                            enemies.speedY[ti] = 0;
                            
                        }
                        
                        var hMinZ = min(enemies.verticalPos[ti],enemies.verticalPos[ti]+enemies.vertSpeed[ti]);
                        var hMaxZ = max(enemies.verticalPos[ti],enemies.verticalPos[ti]+enemies.vertSpeed[ti]);
                        
                        if(constrain(tz,hMinZ,hMaxZ) === tz && tSpeed < 1){
                            
                            enemies.verticalPos[ti] = tz;
                            enemies.vertSpeed[ti] = 0;
                            
                        }
                        
                        //Rotate to face player
                        if(mapVars[1][0] !== 'attack' || (mapVars[1][16] === 2 && ti ===ai)){
                            
                            var angle = enemies.angle[ti];
                            
                            var dAngle = -1*(atan2(player.x-enemies.x[i],player.y-enemies.y[i]));
                            
                            var dif = angle-dAngle;
                            
                            var shortDistance = (dif + 180) % 360;
                            
                            shortDistance -= 180; 
                            
                            if(shortDistance < 0){
                                
                                enemies.angle[ti]-=0.5;
                                
                            }
                            
                            else{
                                
                                enemies.angle[ti]+=0.5;
                                
                            }
                            
                            if(enemies.angle[ti] < 0){
                                
                                enemies.angle[ti] = 360+enemies.angle[ti];
                                
                            }
                            
                            if(enemies.angle[ti] >360){
                                
                                enemies.angle[ti] = enemies.angle[ti]-360;
                                
                            }
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            if(enemies.animation[hi] === 2){
                
                enemies.animationTime[hi] -= game.deltaF;
                
                if(enemies.animationTime[hi] < 0){
                    
                    enemies.animation[hi] = 0;
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            break;
        
    }
    
    //Map specific lighting
    for(var y = 0; y <= loadedMap.dynamicLighting.length-1; y++){
        
        for(var x = 0; x <= loadedMap.dynamicLighting[y].length-1;x++){
            
            //Which tile value
            switch(loadedMap.dynamicLighting[y][x]){
                
                //1
                case 1:
                    
                    //Which map 
                    switch(loadedMap.name){
                        
                        case 'mines_1':
                        case 'mines_2':
                        case 'mines_3':
                        case 'mines_4':
                            
                            if(game.globalTimer%10 <5){
                                
                                tempMap.lighting[y][x]/=1.015;
                                
                            }
                            
                            break;
                        
                    }
                    
                    break;
                    
                //2
                case 2:
                    
                    //Which map 
                    switch(loadedMap.name){
                        
                        case 'mines_1':
                        case 'mines_3':
                            
                            if(tempMap.floorHeight[y][x]>600){
                                
                                tempMap.lighting[y][x]=0.1;
                                
                            }
                            
                            else if(tempMap.floorHeight[y][x]>300){
                                
                                tempMap.lighting[y][x]*=(1-(tempMap.floorHeight[y][x]-300)/300);
                                
                                tempMap.lighting[y][x]=constrain(tempMap.lighting[y][x],0.2,1);
                                
                            }
                            
                            break;
                        
                        case 'mines_4':
                            
                            if(tempMap.floorHeight[y][x]>300){
                                
                                tempMap.lighting[y][x]*=(600-tempMap.floorHeight[y][x])/300;
                                
                                //tempMap.lighting[y][x]=constrain(tempMap.lighting[y][x],0.2,1);
                                
                            }
                            
                            if(tempMap.floorHeight[y][x]>600){
                                
                                tempMap.lighting[y][x]=0;
                                
                            }
                            
                            break;
                        
                    }
                    
                break;
                
                case 3:
                    
                    //Which map 
                    switch(loadedMap.name){
                        
                        
                        case 'mines_4':
                            
                            if(mapVars[1][0]==='intro' && player.height>1600){
                                
                                tempMap.lighting[y][x]*=1-((player.height-1600)/(8400));
                                
                            }
                            
                        break;
                        
                    }
                    
                    break;
            }
            
        }
        
    }
    
};


//How things move and interact
var physics=function(){
    
    //Reset number of pathfinding calls
    n = 0;
    
    if(!game.semiPause){
        
        //Enemy AI
        
        for(var i = 0; i <= enemies.x.length-1; i++){
            
            if(enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].moveType !== 0){
                
                var inZone = false;
                
                var y = floor(enemies.y[i]/20);
                var x = floor(enemies.x[i]/20);
                
                var zone = loadedMap.loadZone[y][x];
                var overlap = loadedMap.loadOverlap[y][x];
                
                inZone = (player.zones[0] === zone || player.zones[0] === overlap) || (player.zones[1] === zone || player.zones[1] === overlap);
                
                if(!enemies.dud[i] && inZone){
                    
                    //What type of enemy
                    switch(enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].moveType){
                        
                        //Inanimate Prop
                        case 0:
                            
                            
                            
                            break;
                            
                        //Basic movement
                        case 1:
                            
                            //Moving enemy
                            if(enemies.moving[i]){
                                
                                //Wait 
                                enemies.moveTime[i]--;
                                
                                //Stop moving
                                if(enemies.moveTime[i]<=0 || enemies.distance[i]<enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].range){
                                    
                                    //Stop the enemy
                                    enemies.speedX[i]=0;
                                    enemies.speedY[i]=0;
                                    
                                    //Set new angle
                                    if(enemies.distance[i]>enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].detectRange){
                                        
                                        enemies.angle[i]=random(0,360);
                                        
                                    }
                                    
                                    //When in range
                                    else{
                                        
                                        enemies.angle[i]=-1*(atan2(player.x-enemies.x[i],player.y-enemies.y[i])-180);
                                        
                                    } 
                                    
                                    //Reset move time
                                    enemies.moveTime[i]=enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].moveWaitAverage+random(-enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].moveWaitAverage*enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].waitWeight,enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].moveWaitAverage*enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].waitWeight);
                                    
                                    //Set enemies to not move
                                    enemies.moving[i]=false;
                                    
                                    //Reduce cooldown
                                    enemies.cooldown[i]-=game.deltaF;
                                    
                                }
                                
                                else{
                                    
                                    enemies.speedX[i]=sin(enemies.angle[i])*enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].speed;
                                    enemies.speedY[i]=-cos(enemies.angle[i])*enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].speed;
                                    
                                }
                                
                            }
                            
                            //Not moving enemy
                            else{
                                
                                //Wait 
                                enemies.moveTime[i]-=game.deltaF;
                                
                                //Stop moving
                                if(enemies.moveTime[i]<=0){
                                    
                                    //Move the enemy
                                    //When out of player's range
                                    enemies.speedX[i]=sin(enemies.angle[i])*enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].speed;
                                    enemies.speedY[i]=-cos(enemies.angle[i])*enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].speed;
                                    
                                    //Reset move time
                                    enemies.moveTime[i]=enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].moveWaitAverage+random(-enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].moveWaitAverage*enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].waitWeight,enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].moveWaitAverage*enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].waitWeight);
                                    
                                    //Make enemy moving
                                    enemies.moving[i]=true;
                                    
                                    enemies.animation[i] = 1;
                                    
                                }
                                
                            }
                            
                            //Attack Player
                            if(enemies.distance[i]<=enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].range){
                                
                                
                                //Attack and reset cooldown
                                if(enemies.cooldown[i]<=0){
                                    
                                    hurt(0,0,enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].damage,0,0);
                                    
                                    enemies.cooldown[i]=enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].attackWait;
                                    
                                }
                                
                                else{
                                    
                                    enemies.cooldown[i]-=game.deltaF;
                                    
                                }
                                
                                
                                
                            }
                            
                            break;
                            
                        //Search for player
                        case 2:
                            
                            //Difference in heights for hitscan
                            var difZ = ((player.height+player.floorHeight/2+300)-(enemies.verticalPos[i]+enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].height/2))/20;
                            
                            //dz value for hitscan
                            var dz = difZ/dist(enemies.x[i],enemies.y[i],player.x,player.y);
                            
                            //Angle between player and enemy
                            var da = -1*(atan2(player.x-enemies.x[i],player.y-enemies.y[i])-180);
                            
                            //Check if enemy can see player
                            var r = hitScan(da,enemies.x[i],enemies.y[i],dz,'none',(enemies.verticalPos[i]+enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].height/2)-300,Infinity);
                            
                            //Bool for if the enemy can see the player
                            var playerInLine = dist(enemies.x[i],enemies.y[i],r.x,r.y) >= enemies.distance[i];
                            
                            //createParticle(r.x,r.y,0,0,r.z,0,1);
                            
                            //Check from the top of the enemy again
                            if(!playerInLine){
                                
                                //Difference in heights for hitscan
                                difZ = ((player.height+300)-(enemies.verticalPos[i]+enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].height))/20;
                                
                                //dz value for hitscan
                                dz = difZ/dist(enemies.x[i],enemies.y[i],player.x,player.y);
                                
                                //Check if enemy can see player
                                r = hitScan(da,enemies.x[i],enemies.y[i],dz,'none',(enemies.verticalPos[i]+enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].height)-300,Infinity);
                                
                                //Bool for if the enemy can see the player
                                playerInLine = dist(enemies.x[i],enemies.y[i],r.x,r.y) >= enemies.distance[i];
                                
                                //createParticle(r.x,r.y,0,0,r.z,0,1);
                                
                            }
                            
                            
                            
                            //calculate difference in angle between enemy and player and where it is looking
                            var a = da - enemies.angle[i];
                            
                            a = abs((a+180)%360 -180);
                            
                            //println(enemies.state[i]);
                            //var states = ['alert','ambush','idle','hunting','attacking'];
                            switch(enemies.state[i]){
                                
                                //Start only able to see player if they are in front of you
                                case 'alert':
                                    
                                    if(playerInLine && a <= enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].fov){
                                        
                                        enemies.state[i] = 'attacking';
                                        
                                        enemies.angle[i] = da;
                                        
                                        enemies.moving[i] = false;
                                        
                                        enemies.moveTime[i] = 20;
                                        
                                        enemies.cooldown[i] = enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].attackWait;
                                        
                                        enemies.lastSeen[i] = [player.x,player.y,-1*(atan2(player.speedX,player.speedY)-180)];
                                        
                                        enemies.animation[i] = 0;
                                        
                                    }
                                    
                                    //Idle Animation
