                                    enemies.animationTime[i]-=game.deltaF;
                                    
                                    if(enemies.animationTime[i]<= 0){
                                        
                                        if(enemies.animationFrame[i] < objectConstants[enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].object].texture[enemies.animation[i]].length-1){
                                            
                                            enemies.animationFrame[i]++;
                                            
                                        }
                                        
                                        else{
                                            
                                            enemies.animationFrame[i]=0;
                                            
                                        }
                                        
                                        enemies.animationTime[i] = enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].animationTimes[0];
                                        
                                    }
                                    
                                    break;
                                
                                //Always track the player until they break line of sight if you're attacking
                                case 'attacking':
                                    
                                    //println(dzt);
                                    
                                    if(playerInLine){
                                        
                                        enemies.moveTime[i]--;
                                        
                                        enemies.lastSeen[i] = [player.x,player.y,-1*(atan2(player.speedX,player.speedY)-180)];
                                        
                                        //Move toward player
                                        if(enemies.moving[i]){
                                            
                                            //Stop to attack if possible
                                            if(enemies.moveTime[i] <= 0 || enemies.distance[i] <= enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].range){
                                                
                                                enemies.moveTime[i]=enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].moveWaitAverage+random(-enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].moveWaitAverage*enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].waitWeight,enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].moveWaitAverage*enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].waitWeight);
                                                
                                                enemies.cooldown[i] = enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].attackWait;
                                                
                                                enemies.moving[i] = false;
                                                
                                                //Stop the enemy
                                                enemies.speedX[i]=0;
                                                enemies.speedY[i]=0;
                                                
                                                if(enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].flying){
                                                    
                                                    enemies.vertSpeed[i] = 0;
                                                    
                                                }
                                                
                                                enemies.animation[i] = 0;
                                                
                                                enemies.animationFrame[i] = 0;
                                                
                                                enemies.animationTime[i] = enemies.cooldown[i] - enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].animationTimes[2];
                                                
                                            }
                                            
                                            else{
                                                
                                                //Move in direction
                                                enemies.speedX[i]=sin(enemies.angle[i])*enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].speed;
                                                enemies.speedY[i]=-cos(enemies.angle[i])*enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].speed;
                                                
                                                if(enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].flying){
                                                    
                                                    //enemies.vertSpeed[i] = dzt *enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].speed*20; 
                                                    
                                                }
                                                
                                                //Walk Animation
                                                enemies.animation[i] = 1;
                                                
                                                enemies.animationTime[i]-=game.deltaF;
                                                
                                                if(enemies.animationTime[i]<= 0){
                                                    
                                                    if(enemies.animationFrame[i] < objectConstants[enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].object].texture[enemies.animation[i]].length-1){
                                                        
                                                        enemies.animationFrame[i]++;
                                                        
                                                    }
                                                    
                                                    else{
                                                        
                                                        enemies.animationFrame[i]=0;
                                                        
                                                    }
                                                    
                                                    enemies.animationTime[i] = enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].animationTimes[1];
                                                    
                                                }
                                                
                                            }
                                            
                                        }
                                        
                                        //Attack if possible
                                        else{
                                            
                                            enemies.angle[i] = da;
                                            
                                            //Start moving again
                                            if(enemies.moveTime[i] <= 0 && enemies.distance[i] >= enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].range){
                                                
                                                enemies.moveTime[i]=enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].moveWaitAverage+random(-enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].moveWaitAverage*enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].waitWeight,enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].moveWaitAverage*enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].waitWeight);
                                                
                                                enemies.moving[i] = true;
                                                
                                                enemies.angle[i] = da + random(-enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].directness,enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].directness);
                                                
                                                if(enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].flying){
                                                    
                                                    var dzt = (dz + sin(random(-enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].directness/2,enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].directness)));
                                                    
                                                    enemies.vertSpeed[i] = dzt *enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].speed*10; 
                                                    
                                                }
                                                
                                                enemies.animation[i] = 1;
                                                
                                                enemies.animationFrame[i] = 0;
                                                
                                                enemies.animationTime[i] = enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].animationTimes[1];
                                                
                                            }
                                            
                                            //Attack
                                            else{
                                                
                                                switch(enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].attackType){
                                                    
                                                    case 'range':
                                                        
                                                        //Attack and reset cooldown
                                                        if(enemies.cooldown[i]<=0){
                                                            
                                                            var proj = enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].projectile;
                                                            
                                                            for(var s = 0; s <= projectileConstants[proj].shots-1; s++){
                                                                
                                                                var dud=false;
                                                                var dudNum=0;
                                                                
                                                                //Find duds
                                                                {
                                                                    
                                                                    //Variables for search
                                                                    var d=0;
                                                                    var search=true;
                                                                    //Search
                                                                    while(search){
                                                                        
                                                                        if(projectiles.dud[d]){
                                                                            
                                                                            dudNum=d;
                                                                            
                                                                            dud=true;
                                                                            
                                                                            search=false;
                                                                            
                                                                        }
                                                                        
                                                                        d++;
                                                                        
                                                                        if(d>=projectiles.dud.length-1){
                                                                            
                                                                            search=false;
                                                                            
                                                                        }
                                                                        
                                                                    }
                                                                    
                                                                }
                                                                
                                                                var angleShot=enemies.angle[i]+random(-projectileConstants[proj].deviation,projectileConstants[proj].deviation);
                                                                var vAngleShot=0+random(-projectileConstants[proj].deviation,projectileConstants[proj].deviation);
                                                                
                                                                var realAngle = angleShot - 90;
                                                                
                                                                var x = enemies.x[i];
                                                                var y = enemies.y[i];
                                                                var z = enemies.verticalPos[i] + enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].height/2 - 300;
                                                                
                                                                switch(enemies.type[i]){
                                                                    
                                                                    case 3:
                                                                        
                                                                        if(s === 0){
                                                                            
                                                                            x+= 5 * cos(angleShot);
                                                                            y+= 5 * sin(angleShot);
                                                                            
                                                                        }
                                                                        
                                                                        else{
                                                                            
                                                                            x-= 5 * cos(angleShot);
                                                                            y-= 5 * sin(angleShot);
                                                                            
                                                                        }
                                                                        
                                                                        break;
                                                                    
                                                                    case 5:
                                                                        
                                                                        z -= enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].height/4;
                                                                        
                                                                        angleShot += (s-1)*15;
                                                                        
                                                                        break;
                                                                    
                                                                    case 6:
                                                                        
                                                                        x+= 5 * cos(angleShot);
                                                                        y+= 5 * sin(angleShot);
                                                                        
                                                                        z += enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].height/3;
                                                                        
                                                                        break;
                                                                    
                                                                }
                                                                
                                                                var vx = (sin(angleShot)*projectileConstants[proj].speed)*cos(vAngleShot);
                                                                var vy = (cos(angleShot)*-projectileConstants[proj].speed)*cos(vAngleShot);
                                                                var vz = dz*projectileConstants[proj].speed;
                                                                
                                                                //Create Projectile
                                                                if(!dud){
                                                                    
                                                                    projectiles.x.push(x);
                                                                    projectiles.y.push(y);
                                                                    
                                                                    projectiles.speedX.push(vx);
                                                                    projectiles.speedY.push(vy);
                                                                    
                                                                    projectiles.vix.push(vx);
                                                                    projectiles.viy.push(vy);
                                                                    projectiles.viz.push(vz);
                                                                    
                                                                    projectiles.animation.push(0);
                                                                    
                                                                    projectiles.animationFrame.push(0);
                                                                    
                                                                    projectiles.verticalPos.push(z);
                                                                    //projectiles.verticalPos.push(0); 
                                                                    
                                                                    projectiles.verticalVelocity.push(vz);
                                                                    
                                                                    projectiles.fuse.push(0);
                                                                    
                                                                    projectiles.angle.push(angleShot);
                                                                    
                                                                    projectiles.type.push(enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].projectile);
                                                                    
                                                                    projectiles.friendly.push(false);
                                                                    
                                                                    projectiles.dud.push(false);
                                                                    
                                                                }
                                                                
                                                                else{
                                                                    
                                                                    projectiles.x[dudNum]=x;
                                                                    projectiles.y[dudNum]=y;
                                                                    
                                                                    projectiles.speedX[dudNum]=vx;
                                                                    projectiles.speedY[dudNum]=vy;
                                                                    
                                                                    projectiles.vix[dudNum]=vx;
                                                                    projectiles.viy[dudNum]=vy;
                                                                    projectiles.viz[dudNum]=vz;
                                                                    
                                                                    projectiles.animation[dudNum]=0;
                                                                    
                                                                    projectiles.animationFrame[dudNum]=0;
                                                                    projectiles.verticalPos[dudNum]=z;
                                                                    
                                                                    projectiles.verticalVelocity[dudNum]=vz;
                                                                    
                                                                    projectiles.fuse[dudNum]=0;
                                                                    
                                                                    projectiles.angle[dudNum]=angleShot;
                                                                    
                                                                    projectiles.type[dudNum]=enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].projectile;
                                                                    
                                                                    projectiles.friendly[dudNum]=false;
                                                                    
                                                                    projectiles.dud[dudNum]=false;
                                                                    
                                                                }
                                                                
                                                                
                                                            }
                                                            
                                                            enemies.cooldown[i]=enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].attackWait; 
                                                            
                                                            //Reset attack animation
                                                            enemies.animationTime[i] = enemies.cooldown[i] - enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].animationTimes[2];
                                                            
                                                            enemies.animationFrame[i] = 0;
                                                            
                                                            enemies.animation[i] = 0;
                                                            
                                                        }
                                                        
                                                        else{
                                                            
                                                            enemies.cooldown[i]-=game.deltaF;
                                                            
                                                            if(enemies.cooldown[i] <= enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].attackWait/2 && enemies.cooldown[i]<=enemies.moveTime[i]){
                                                                
                                                                enemies.animation[i] = 2;
                                                                
                                                            }
                                                            
                                                            else{
                                                                
                                                                enemies.animation[i] = 0; 
                                                                
                                                            }
                                                            
                                                            //Animate attack
                                                            if(enemies.animationTime[i]<=0){
                                                                
                                                                enemies.animationFrame[i] = 1;
                                                                
                                                            }
                                                            
                                                            enemies.animationTime[i]-=game.deltaF;
                                                            
                                                        }
                                                        
                                                        break;
                                                    
                                                    case 'melee':
                                                        
                                                        //Melee enemies don't pause to shoot
                                                        if(enemies.distance[i] > enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].range){
                                                            
                                                            enemies.moveTime[i]=0;
                                                            
                                                        }
                                                        
                                                        else{
                                                            
                                                            //Attack and reset cooldown
                                                            if(enemies.cooldown[i]<=0){
                                                                
                                                                enemies.cooldown[i]=enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].attackWait;
                                                                
                                                                hurt(0,0,enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].damage,0,0,0);
                                                                
                                                                //Reset attack animation
                                                                enemies.animationTime[i] = enemies.cooldown[i] - enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].animationTimes[2];
                                                                
                                                                enemies.animationFrame[i] = 0;
                                                                
                                                                enemies.animation[i] = 0;
                                                                
                                                            }
                                                            
                                                            else{
                                                                
                                                                enemies.cooldown[i]-=game.deltaF;
                                                                
                                                                if(enemies.cooldown[i] <= enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].attackWait/2){
                                                                    
                                                                    enemies.animation[i] = 2;
                                                                    
                                                                }
                                                                
                                                                else{
                                                                    
                                                                    enemies.animation[i] = 0; 
                                                                    
                                                                }
                                                                
                                                                //Animate attack
                                                                if(enemies.animationTime[i]<=0){
                                                                    
                                                                    enemies.animationFrame[i] = 1;
                                                                    
                                                                }
                                                                
                                                                enemies.animationTime[i]-=game.deltaF;
                                                                
                                                            }
                                                            
                                                        }
                                                        
                                                        break;
                                                    
                                                }
                                                
                                            }
                                            
                                        } 
                                        
                                    }
                                    
                                    else{
                                        
                                        enemies.state[i] = 'hunting';
                                        
                                        enemies.target[i] = enemies.lastSeen[i].slice();
                                        
                                        enemies.animation[i] = 1;
                                        
                                        enemies.cooldown[i] = enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].attackWait;
                                    }
                                    
                                    break;
                                
                                //Find player if they've left line of sight (extra fov is granted)
                                case 'hunting':
                                    
                                    //They can see a bit better when they're searching
                                    if(playerInLine && a <= enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].fov *1.5){
                                        
                                        enemies.state[i] = 'attacking';
                                        
                                        enemies.angle[i] = da;
                                        
                                        enemies.cooldown[i] = enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].attackWait/2;
                                        
                                        enemies.path[i] = [];
                                        
                                        enemies.next[i] = [];
                                        
                                        enemies.target[i] = [];
                                        
                                        enemies.animation[i] = 0;
                                        
                                    }
                                    
                                    else{
                                        
                                        //Move to where we last saw the player
                                        if(enemies.target[i].length>0){
                                            
                                            enemies.target[i][0] = floor(enemies.target[i][0]/20)*20+10;
                                            enemies.target[i][1] = floor(enemies.target[i][1]/20)*20+10;
                                            
                                            //enemies.angle[i] = -1*(atan2(enemies.target[i][0]-enemies.x[i],enemies.target[i][1]-enemies.y[i])-180);
                                            
                                            //Distance from target
                                            var td = dist(enemies.x[i],enemies.y[i],enemies.target[i][0],enemies.target[i][1]);
                                            
                                            //Stop searching once you're there
                                            if(td<3){
                                                
                                                enemies.speedX[i]=0;
                                                enemies.speedY[i]=0;
                                                
                                                enemies.angle[i] = enemies.target[i][2];
                                                
                                                enemies.target[i] = [];
                                                
                                                enemies.animation[i] = 0;
                                                
                                            }
                                            
                                            //How we walk to the target
                                            else{
                                                
                                                //Make sure you're in walking animation
                                                enemies.animation[i] = 1;
                                                
                                                //Check if we can see the target
                                                var th = hitScan(-1*(atan2(enemies.target[i][0]-enemies.x[i],enemies.target[i][1]-enemies.y[i])-180),enemies.x[i],enemies.y[i],0,'none',enemies.verticalPos[i]+(enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].height/3)-300,Infinity);
                                                
                                                //enemies.next[i]=[];
                                                
                                                var nextStepInPath = [];
                                                
                                                //If we can't see the target, pathfind to it
                                                if(dist(enemies.x[i],enemies.y[i],th.x,th.y)<td){
                                                    
                                                    var finalStep = enemies.path[i][0];
                                                    
                                                    if((enemies.path[i].length <= 1 || (floor(enemies.target[i][0]/20) !== finalStep[0] || floor(enemies.target[i][1]/20) !== finalStep[1])) && n<feeler.maxLoops){
                                                        
                                                        enemies.path[i] = pathFinding(floor(enemies.x[i]/20),floor(enemies.y[i]/20),floor(enemies.target[i][0]/20),floor(enemies.target[i][1]/20));
                                                        
                                                        //Remove target if we can't pathfind to it 
                                                        if(removeTarget){
                                                            
                                                            enemies.target[i] = [];
                                                            
                                                        }
                                                        
                                                        if(enemies.path[i].length > 0){
                                                            
                                                            enemies.next[i]=[enemies.path[i].length-1,enemies.path[i].length-2];
                                                            
                                                        }
                                                        
                                                    }
                                                    
                                                    if(enemies.path[i].length > 0){
                                                        
                                                        for(var s = enemies.path[i].length-1; s>0; s--){
                                                            
                                                            if(floor(enemies.x[i]/20) === enemies.path[i][s][0] && floor(enemies.y[i]/20) === enemies.path[i][s][1]){
                                                                
                                                                if(enemies.next[i][0] === enemies.path[i].length-1){
                                                                    
                                                                    enemies.next[i][0] = enemies.path[i].length-2;
                                                                    
                                                                }
                                                                
                                                                enemies.path[i].splice(enemies.path[i].length-1,s);
                                                                
                                                                break;
                                                                
                                                            }
                                                            
                                                        }
                                                        
                                                    }
                                                    
                                                    if(enemies.path[i].length-1 > 1){
                                                        
                                                        enemies.next[i][0]=constrain(enemies.next[i][0],0,enemies.path[i].length-1);
                                                        enemies.next[i][1]=constrain(enemies.next[i][1],0,enemies.path[i].length-2);
                                                        
                                                        var start = enemies.next[i][0];
                                                        var end = enemies.next[i][1];
                                                        
                                                        //+(enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].height/2)
                                                        var sh = hitScan(-1*(atan2((enemies.path[i][end][0]*20+10)-(enemies.path[i][start][0]*20+10),(enemies.path[i][end][1]*20+10)-(enemies.path[i][start][1]*20+10))-180),enemies.path[i][start][0]*20+10,enemies.path[i][start][1]*20+10,0,'none',primaryOrSecondary(enemies.path[i][start][0]*20+10,enemies.path[i][start][1]*20+10,'floor')+(enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].height/3)-300,Infinity);
                                                        
                                                        var ds = dist(enemies.path[i][start][0]*20+10,enemies.path[i][start][1]*20+10,enemies.path[i][end][0]*20+10,enemies.path[i][end][1]*20+10);
                                                        
                                                        if((dist(enemies.path[i][start][0]*20+10,enemies.path[i][start][1]*20+10,sh.x,sh.y)<ds || end === 0) && start !== end){
                                                            
                                                            if(end < enemies.path[i].length-1){
                                                                
                                                                if(end===0){
                                                                    
                                                                    enemies.path[i].splice(end+1,(start-end-1));
                                                                    
                                                                }
                                                                
                                                                else{
                                                                    
                                                                    enemies.path[i].splice(end+2,(start-end-2));
                                                                    
                                                                }
                                                                
                                                                enemies.next[i][0] = end;
                                                                
                                                                enemies.next[i][1]--;
                                                                
                                                                //enemies.next[i] = [enemies.path[i][s+1][0]*20+10,enemies.path[i][s+1][1]*20+10];
                                                                
                                                                //nextStepInPath = [enemies.path[i][s+1][0]*20+10,enemies.path[i][s+1][1]*20+10];
                                                                
                                                            }
                                                            
                                                            else{
                                                                
                                                                enemies.path[i]=[];
                                                                
                                                            }
                                                            
                                                        }
                                                        
                                                        else if(start !== end){
                                                            
                                                            enemies.next[i][1]--;
                                                            
                                                        }
                                                        
                                                    }
                                                    
                                                    if(enemies.path[i].length > 0){
                                                        
                                                        var last = enemies.path[i].length-1;
                                                        
                                                        nextStepInPath = [enemies.path[i][last][0]*20+10,enemies.path[i][last][1]*20+10];
                                                        
                                                    }
                                                    
                                                }
                                                
                                                //If we can, walk towards it
                                                else{
                                                    
                                                    enemies.path[i] = [];
                                                    
                                                    //enemies.next[i] = [enemies.target[i][0],enemies.target[i][1]];
                                                    nextStepInPath = [enemies.target[i][0],enemies.target[i][1]];
                                                    
                                                }
                                                
                                                if(nextStepInPath.length > 0){
                                                    
                                                    //enemies.next[i][0] = floor(enemies.next[i][0]/20)*20+10;
                                                    //enemies.next[i][1] = floor(enemies.next[i][1]/20)*20+10;
                                                    
                                                    nextStepInPath[0] = floor(nextStepInPath[0]/20)*20+10;
                                                    nextStepInPath[1] = floor(nextStepInPath[1]/20)*20+10;
                                                    
                                                    if(dist(nextStepInPath[0],nextStepInPath[1],enemies.x[i],enemies.y[i])>5){
                                                        
                                                        enemies.angle[i] = -1*(atan2(nextStepInPath[0]-enemies.x[i],nextStepInPath[1]-enemies.y[i])-180);
                                                        
                                                        enemies.speedX[i]=sin(enemies.angle[i])*enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].speed;
                                                        enemies.speedY[i]=-cos(enemies.angle[i])*enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].speed;
                                                        
                                                    }
                                                    
                                                    else{
                                                        
                                                        nextStepInPath = [];
                                                        
                                                    }
                                                    
                                                }
                                                
                                            }
                                            
                                        }
                                        
                                        else{
                                            
                                            enemies.animation[i] = 0;
                                            
                                            //Idle Animation
                                            enemies.animationTime[i]-=game.deltaF;
                                            
                                            if(enemies.animationTime[i]<= 0){
                                                
                                                if(enemies.animationFrame[i] < objectConstants[enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].object].texture[enemies.animation[i]].length-1){
                                                    
                                                    enemies.animationFrame[i]++;
                                                    
                                                }
                                                
                                                else{
                                                    
                                                    enemies.animationFrame[i]=0;
                                                    
                                                }
                                                
                                                enemies.animationTime[i] = enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].animationTimes[0];
                                                
                                            }
                                            
                                        }
                                        
                                    }
                                    
                                    break;
                                
                                case 'pain':
                                    
                                    if(dist(0,0,enemies.speedX[i],enemies.speedY[i]) <= enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].speed * 1.1){
                                        
                                        enemies.speedX[i] = 0;
                                        enemies.speedY[i] = 0;
                                        
                                    }
                                    
                                    if(enemies.moveTime[i] <= 0 && dist(0,0,enemies.speedX[i],enemies.speedY[i]) <= enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].speed * 1.1){
                                        
                                        enemies.state[i] = 'attacking';
                                        
                                        enemies.cooldown[i] = enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].attackWait;
                                        
                                        enemies.animation[i] = 0;
                                        
                                        enemies.animationFrame[i] = 0;
                                        
                                    }
                                    
                                    enemies.moveTime[i]-=game.deltaF;
                                    break;
                                
                                case 'ambush':
                                    
                                    if(playerInLine){
                                        
                                        enemies.state[i] = 'attacking';
                                        
                                        enemies.angle[i] = da;
                                        
                                        enemies.moving[i] = false;
                                        
                                        enemies.moveTime[i] = 20;
                                        
                                        enemies.cooldown[i] = enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].attackWait;
                                        
                                        enemies.lastSeen[i] = [player.x,player.y,-1*(atan2(player.speedX,player.speedY)-180)];
                                        
                                        enemies.animation[i] = 0;
                                        
                                    }
                                    
                                    //Idle Animation
                                    enemies.animationTime[i]-=game.deltaF;
                                    
                                    if(enemies.animationTime[i]<= 0){
                                        
                                        if(enemies.animationFrame[i] < objectConstants[enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].object].texture[enemies.animation[i]].length-1){
                                            
                                            enemies.animationFrame[i]++;
                                            
                                        }
                                        
                                        else{
                                            
                                            enemies.animationFrame[i]=0;
                                            
                                        }
                                        
                                        enemies.animationTime[i] = enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].animationTimes[0];
                                        
                                    }
                                    
                                    
                                    break;
                                
                            }
                            
                            break;
                        
                            
                        default:
                        
                        //Dont move if weird type
                        //enemies.speedX[i]=0;
                        //enemies.speedY[i]=0;
                        
                    }
                    
                    if(enemies.state[i] !== 'pain'){
                        
                        //Stop them from walking off ledges
                        var width = enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].width;
                        
                        var tilesIn = [];
                        
                        tilesIn.push([floor((enemies.x[i])/20),floor((enemies.y[i])/20)]);
                        
                        tilesIn.push([floor((enemies.x[i]-width/2)/20),floor((enemies.y[i]-width/2)/20)]);
                        tilesIn.push([floor((enemies.x[i]-width/2)/20),floor((enemies.y[i]+width/2)/20)]);
                        tilesIn.push([floor((enemies.x[i]+width/2)/20),floor((enemies.y[i]-width/2)/20)]);
                        tilesIn.push([floor((enemies.x[i]+width/2)/20),floor((enemies.y[i]+width/2)/20)]);
                        
                        for(var t = 0; t<=tilesIn.length-1;t++){
                            
                            if((enemies.speedX[i]<0 && ((loadedMap.boundaries[tilesIn[t][1]][tilesIn[t][0]-1] > 0 && loadedMap.doors[tilesIn[t][1]][tilesIn[t][0]-1] === 0) || abs(tempMap.floorHeight[floor((enemies.y[i])/20)][floor((enemies.x[i])/20)]-tempMap.floorHeight[tilesIn[t][1]][tilesIn[t][0]-1]) > 100) && enemies.x[i]/20-tilesIn[t][0] < 0.5 && enemies.x[i]/20-tilesIn[t][0] > 0 && !enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].flying) || (enemies.speedX[i]>0 && ((loadedMap.boundaries[tilesIn[t][1]][tilesIn[t][0]+1] > 0 && loadedMap.doors[tilesIn[t][1]][tilesIn[t][0]+1] === 0) || abs(tempMap.floorHeight[floor((enemies.y[i])/20)][floor((enemies.x[i])/20)]-tempMap.floorHeight[tilesIn[t][1]][tilesIn[t][0]+1]) > 100) && enemies.x[i]/20-tilesIn[t][0] > 0.5 && enemies.x[i]/20-tilesIn[t][0] < 1 && !enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].flying)){
                                
                                enemies.speedX[i]=0;
                                if(enemies.speedY[i]!==0){
                                    
                                    enemies.speedY[i]=enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].speed * (enemies.speedY[i]/abs(enemies.speedY[i]));
                                    
                                }
                                
                            }
                            
                            if((enemies.speedY[i]<0 && ((loadedMap.boundaries[tilesIn[t][1]-1][tilesIn[t][0]] > 0 && loadedMap.doors[tilesIn[t][1]-1][tilesIn[t][0]] === 0)|| abs(tempMap.floorHeight[floor((enemies.y[i])/20)][floor((enemies.x[i])/20)]-tempMap.floorHeight[tilesIn[t][1]-1][tilesIn[t][0]]) > 100) && enemies.y[i]/20-tilesIn[t][1] < 0.5 && enemies.y[i]/20-tilesIn[t][1] > 0 && !enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].flying) || (enemies.speedY[i]>0 && ((loadedMap.boundaries[tilesIn[t][1]+1][tilesIn[t][0]] > 0 && loadedMap.doors[tilesIn[t][1]+1][tilesIn[t][0]] === 0) || abs(tempMap.floorHeight[floor((enemies.y[i])/20)][floor((enemies.x[i])/20)]-tempMap.floorHeight[tilesIn[t][1]+1][tilesIn[t][0]]) > 100) && enemies.y[i]/20-tilesIn[t][1] > 0.5 && enemies.y[i]/20-tilesIn[t][1] <1 && !enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].flying)){
                                
                                if(enemies.speedX[i]!==0){
                                    
                                    enemies.speedX[i]=enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].speed * (enemies.speedX[i]/abs(enemies.speedX[i]));
                                    
                                }
                                enemies.speedY[i]=0;
                                
                            }
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    //Slow
                    var slowRate=0.5;
                    
                    //Slow enemy
                    if(sqrt(sq(enemies.speedX[i])+sq(enemies.speedY[i]))>0){
                        
                        if(sqrt(sq(enemies.speedX[i]) + sq(enemies.speedY[i]))<slowRate){
                            
                            enemies.speedX[i]=0;
                            
                            enemies.speedY[i]=0;
                            
                        }
                        
                        else{
                            
                            var tempSpeedX=enemies.speedX[i];
                            
                            var tempSpeedY=enemies.speedY[i];
                            
                            enemies.speedX[i]-=(tempSpeedX/sqrt(sq(tempSpeedX)+sq(tempSpeedY)))*slowRate*game.deltaF;
                            
                            enemies.speedY[i]-=(tempSpeedY/sqrt(sq(tempSpeedX)+sq(tempSpeedY)))*slowRate*game.deltaF;
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
                else{
                    
                    enemies.speedX[i] = 0;
                    enemies.speedY[i] = 0;
                    
                }
                
            }
            
        }
        
        //Check all enemies
        for(var i = 0; i <= enemies.x.length-1; i++){
            
            var enHeight = enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].height;
            
            if((enemies.speedX[i] !== 0 || enemies.speedY[i] !== 0) && !enemies.dud[i]){
                
                //Set variables for enemies next position
                var nextX=enemies.x[i]+enemies.speedX[i]*game.deltaF;
                var nextY=enemies.y[i]+enemies.speedY[i]*game.deltaF;
                
                var x = floor(nextX/20);
                var y = floor(nextY/20);
                
                //var enHeight = 20;
                
                var bottom = enemies.verticalPos[i];
                
                var top = enemies.verticalPos[i] + enHeight;
                
                var col = checkBoundaries(enemies.x[i],enemies.y[i],enemies.speedX[i],enemies.speedY[i],top,bottom,enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].width,true,game.enemyEnemyCollision,game.enemyPlayerCollision);
                
                if(col[4]){
                    
                    enemies.x[i] = col[0];
                    enemies.y[i] = col[1];
                    enemies.speedX[i] = col[2];
                    enemies.speedY[i] = col[3];
                    
                }
                
            }
            
            var mapFloorHeight = primaryOrSecondary(enemies.x[i],enemies.y[i],'floor');
            var mapCeilingHeight = primaryOrSecondary(enemies.x[i],enemies.y[i],'ceiling');
            
            //if(enemies.vertSpeed[i]>0){println(enemies.vertSpeed[i]);}
            
            enemies.verticalPos[i] += enemies.vertSpeed[i];
            
            if(!enemyConstants[enemies.type[i]].flying){
                
                enemies.vertSpeed[i] -= game.gravity*game.deltaF;
                
            }
            
            //player.floorHeight+floorH
            if(enemies.verticalPos[i]<=mapFloorHeight){
                
                enemies.verticalPos[i]=mapFloorHeight;
                
                enemies.vertSpeed[i] = 0;
                
            }
            
            if(enemies.verticalPos[i]+enHeight>mapCeilingHeight){
                
                enemies.verticalPos[i]=mapCeilingHeight-enHeight;
                
                enemies.vertSpeed[i] = 0;
                
            }
            
        }
        
        //Move and destroy particles
        for(var i = 0; i <= particles.x.length-1; i++){
            
            if(!particles.dud[i] && !game.semiPause){
                
                //Move the particle
                particles.x[i]+=particles.speedX[i]*game.deltaF;
                particles.y[i]+=particles.speedY[i]*game.deltaF;
                
                particles.verticalPos[i]+=particles.verticalSpeed[i]*game.deltaF;
                
                //Kill particles
                particles.life[i]-=game.deltaF;
                
                if(particles.life[i]<=0){
                    
                    particles.dud[i]=true;
                    
                }
                
                //Change Transparency
                particles.transparency[i]+=particleConstants[particles.type[i]].difference*game.deltaF;
                
                //Physics
                if(particleConstants[particles.type[i]].physics){
                    
                    var particleHeight = particleConstants[particles.type[i]].height;
                    
                    var floorH = primaryOrSecondary(particles.x[i],particles.y[i],'floor');
                    
                    var ceilH = primaryOrSecondary(particles.x[i],particles.y[i],'ceiling');
                    
                    if(particles.verticalPos[i] - particleHeight/2>floorH-game.realHeight/2){
                        
                        particles.verticalSpeed[i]-=game.gravity*game.deltaF;
                        
                    }
                    
                    if(particles.verticalPos[i]+particles.verticalSpeed[i] - particleHeight/2<=floorH-game.realHeight/2){
                        
                        if(particles.verticalSpeed[i]<-15/game.deltaF){
                            
                            particles.verticalSpeed[i]*=-0.5;
                            
                            particles.verticalPos[i] = floorH-game.realHeight/2 + particleHeight/2; 
                            
                        }
                        
                        else{
                            
                            particles.verticalSpeed[i]=0;
                            
                            particles.verticalPos[i] = floorH-game.realHeight/2 + particleHeight/2; 
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    if(particles.verticalPos[i]+particles.verticalSpeed[i] - particleHeight/2>=ceilH-game.realHeight/2){
                        
                        if(particles.verticalSpeed[i]>15*game.deltaF){
                            
                            particles.verticalSpeed[i]*=-0.5;
                            
                        }
                        
                        else{
                            
                            particles.verticalSpeed[i]=0;
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    if(particles.speedX[i] !== 0 || particles.speedY[i] !== 0){
                        
                        //Particle Collison
                        var partHeight = 20;
                        
                        var partWidth = 3;
                        
                        var bottom = particles.verticalPos[i] + game.realHeight/2;
                        
                        var top = particles.verticalPos[i] + partHeight + game.realHeight/2;
                        
                        var col = checkBoundaries(particles.x[i],particles.y[i],particles.speedX[i],particles.speedY[i],top,bottom,partWidth,true,false,true);
                        
                        if(col[4]){
                            
                            particles.x[i] = col[0];
                            particles.y[i] = col[1];
                            particles.speedX[i] = col[2];
                            particles.speedY[i] = col[3];
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
                //Slow Particle
                if(sqrt(sq(particles.speedX[i])+sq(particles.speedY[i]))>0){
                    
                    if(sqrt(sq(particles.speedX[i]) + sq(particles.speedY[i]))<0.1){
                        
                        particles.speedX[i]=0;
                        
                        particles.speedY[i]=0;
                        
                    }
                    
                    else{
                        
                        var tempA=-0.1;
                        
                        var tempSpeedX=particles.speedX[i];
                        
                        var tempSpeedY=particles.speedY[i];
                        
                        particles.speedX[i]+=(tempSpeedX/sqrt(sq(tempSpeedX)+sq(tempSpeedY)))*tempA*game.deltaF;
                        
                        particles.speedY[i]+=(tempSpeedY/sqrt(sq(tempSpeedX)+sq(tempSpeedY)))*tempA*game.deltaF;
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
                //Light projectiles
                //Add to temp lighting
                if(!particles.dud[i] && !game.semiPause){
                    
                    var y = constrain(floor(particles.y[i]/20),0,tempMap.lighting.length-1);
                    
                    tempMap.lighting[y][constrain(floor(particles.x[i]/20),0,tempMap.lighting[y])] += particleConstants[particles.type[i]].lighting/2;
                    
                    for(var y = constrain(floor(particles.y[i]/20)-1,0,tempMap.lighting.length-1); y <= constrain(floor(particles.y[i]/20)+1,0,tempMap.lighting.length-1);y++){
                        
                        for(var x = constrain(floor(particles.x[i]/20)-1,0,tempMap.lighting[y].length-1); x <= constrain(floor(particles.x[i]/20)+1,0,tempMap.lighting[y].length-1);x++){
                            
                            tempMap.lighting[y][x] += particleConstants[particles.type[i]].lighting/2;
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
                //Extra stuff for specific particles
                switch(particles.type[i]){
                    
                    //Flare Shots
                    case 18:
                        
                        //Create Particles a few times a second
                        if(floor(game.globalTimer) % floor(random(5,6)) === 0 && !game.semiPause && !particles.dud[i]){
                            
                            var lateralSpeed = random(-3,3);
                            
                            var horizontalSpeed = random(-3,3);
                            
                            var v = dist(particles.speedX[i],particles.speedY[i],0,0);
                            
                            var finalX = horizontalSpeed*(particles.speedX[i]/v);
                            
                            var finalY = lateralSpeed*(particles.speedY[i]/v);
                            
                            if(v <= 0.1){
                                
                                finalX=horizontalSpeed;
                                finalY=lateralSpeed;
                                
                            }
                            
                            createParticle(particles.x[i],particles.y[i],finalX,finalY,particles.verticalPos[i],random(0,60),16);
                            
                            
                        }
                        
                        if(floor(game.globalTimer) % 10=== 0 && !game.semiPause && !particles.dud[i]){
                            
                            var v = dist(particles.speedX[i],particles.speedY[i],0,0);
                            
                            var lateralSpeed = random(-0.1,0.1);
                            
                            var horizontalSpeed = random(-0.1,0.1);
                            
                            var finalX = horizontalSpeed*(particles.speedX[i]/v);
                            
                            var finalY = lateralSpeed*(particles.speedY[i]/v);
                            
                            if(v <= 0.1){
                                
                                finalX=horizontalSpeed;
                                finalY=lateralSpeed;
                                
                            }
                            
                            createParticle(particles.x[i],particles.y[i],finalX,finalY,particles.verticalPos[i],random(-2,2),17);
                            
                        }
                        
                        break;
                        
                    //Rocket Sparks
                    case 19:
                        
                        //println(particles.life[i]);
                        
                        particles.animationFrame[i] = floor(particles.life[i]/4)%2;
                        
                        break;
                        
                    //Rocket Falling Sparks
                    case 20:
                        
                        //println(particles.life[i]);
                        
                        particles.animationFrame[i] = floor(particles.life[i]/4)%3;
                        
                        break;
                    
                    case 23:
                    case 25:
                    case 27:
                    case 29:
                        
                        if(floor(game.globalTimer) % 2 === 0){
                            
                            createParticle(particles.x[i],particles.y[i],0,0,particles.verticalPos[i],0,particles.type[i]+1);
                            
                        }
                        
                        break;
                    
                }
                
                
            }
            
        }
        
        //Projectile Collison
        for(var i = 0; i <= projectiles.x.length-1; i++){
            
            if(!projectiles.dud[i]){
                
                //Set variables for projectiles next position
                var nextX=projectiles.x[i]+projectiles.speedX[i]*game.deltaF;
                var nextY=projectiles.y[i]+projectiles.speedY[i]*game.deltaF;
                var radius = projectileConstants[projectiles.type[i]].width/2;
                
                //Variables about impact
                var impact = false;
                var impactX=projectiles.x[i];
                var impactY=projectiles.y[i];
                
                //The normal vector to the wall
                var normalX=0;
                var normalY=0;
                
                var x = floor(nextX/20);
                var y = floor(nextY/20);
                
                //Check all boundaries
                
                //checkBoundaries = function(ix,iy,vx,vy,top,bottom,oWidth,stairs)
                
                var projHeight = projectileConstants[projectiles.type[i]].height;
                
                var bottom = projectiles.verticalPos[i] + game.realHeight/2;
                
                var top = projectiles.verticalPos[i] + projHeight + game.realHeight/2;
                
                var col = checkBoundaries(projectiles.x[i],projectiles.y[i],projectiles.speedX[i],projectiles.speedY[i],top,bottom,projectileConstants[projectiles.type[i]].width,false,false,false);
                
                if(col[4]){
                    
                    projectiles.x[i] = col[0];
                    projectiles.y[i] = col[1];
                    projectiles.speedX[i] = col[2];
                    projectiles.speedY[i] = col[3];
                    
                    impact = true;
                    
                }
                
                var floorH = primaryOrSecondary(nextX,nextY,'floor');
                var ceilingH = primaryOrSecondary(nextX,nextY,'ceiling');
                
                if(projectiles.verticalPos[i]+game.realHeight/2 <= floorH){
                    
                    impact = true;
                    
                }
                
                if(projectiles.verticalPos[i]+game.realHeight/2 >= ceilingH){
                    
                    impact = true;
                    
                }
                
                //Don't explode on contact if you're dynamite
                if(projectiles.type[i] === 14){
                    
                    impact = false;
                    
                    projectiles.fuse[i] +=game.deltaF;
                    
                    if(projectiles.fuse[i] >= 30){
                        
                        projectiles.dud[i]=true;
                        
                        explosion(impactX,impactY,projectiles.verticalPos[i],normalX,normalY,projectileConstants[projectiles.type[i]].range,projectileConstants[projectiles.type[i]].damage,projectileConstants[projectiles.type[i]].knockback,projectileConstants[projectiles.type[i]].expType,projectiles.friendly[i]);
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
                //Physics
                if(projectileConstants[projectiles.type[i]].physics){
                    
                    var projectileHeight = 20;
                    
                    if(projectiles.verticalPos[i] - projectileHeight/2>floorH-game.realHeight/2){
                        
                        projectiles.verticalVelocity[i]-=game.gravity*game.deltaF/20;
                        
                    }
                    
                    if(projectiles.verticalPos[i]+projectiles.verticalVelocity[i] - projectileHeight/2<=floorH-game.realHeight/2){
                        
                        if(projectiles.verticalVelocity[i]<-1){
                            
                            projectiles.verticalVelocity[i]*=-0.5;
                            
                            projectiles.verticalPos[i] = floorH-game.realHeight/2 + projectileHeight/2+10; 
                            
                        }
                        
                        else{
                            
                            projectiles.verticalVelocity[i]=0;
                            
                            projectiles.verticalPos[i] = floorH-game.realHeight/2 + projectileHeight/2; 
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    if(projectiles.verticalPos[i]+projectiles.verticalVelocity[i] - projectileHeight/2>=ceilingH-game.realHeight/2){
                        
                        if(projectiles.verticalVelocity[i]>1){
                            
                            projectiles.verticalVelocity[i]*=-0.5;
                            
                        }
                        
                        else{
                            
                            projectiles.verticalVelocity[i]=0;
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                    //Slow Particle
                    if(sqrt(sq(projectiles.speedX[i])+sq(projectiles.speedY[i]))>0){
                        
                        if(sqrt(sq(projectiles.speedX[i]) + sq(projectiles.speedY[i]))<0.1){
                            
                            projectiles.speedX[i]=0;
                            
                            projectiles.speedY[i]=0;
                            
                        }
                        
                        else{
                            
                            var tempA=-0.1;
                            
                            var tempSpeedX=projectiles.speedX[i];
                            
                            var tempSpeedY=projectiles.speedY[i];
                            
                            projectiles.speedX[i]+=(tempSpeedX/sqrt(sq(tempSpeedX)+sq(tempSpeedY)))*tempA*game.deltaF;
                            
                            projectiles.speedY[i]+=(tempSpeedY/sqrt(sq(tempSpeedX)+sq(tempSpeedY)))*tempA*game.deltaF;
                            
                        }
                        
                    }
                    
                }
                
                //Do stuff with the values based on the projectiles
                if(impact){
                    
                    projectiles.dud[i]=true;
                    
                    //impactX,impactY,impactZ,normalX,normalY,range,xLimit,yLimit,minPart,maxPart,damage,knockback,type
                    explosion(impactX,impactY,projectiles.verticalPos[i],normalX,normalY,projectileConstants[projectiles.type[i]].range,projectileConstants[projectiles.type[i]].damage,projectileConstants[projectiles.type[i]].knockback,projectileConstants[projectiles.type[i]].expType,projectiles.friendly[i]);
                    
                }
                
                
                for(var e = 0; e <= enemies.x.length-1; e++){
                    
                    if(dist(impactX,impactY,enemies.x[e],enemies.y[e])<=enemyConstants[enemies.type[e]].width/2+projectileConstants[projectiles.type[i]].width/2 && !projectiles.dud[i]  && !enemies.dud[e] && projectiles.friendly[i] && top >= enemies.verticalPos[e] && bottom <= enemies.verticalPos[e] + enemyConstants[enemies.type[e]].height){
                        
                        projectiles.dud[i]=true;
                        
                        var impactZ = projectiles.verticalPos[i] + projHeight/2 + game.realHeight/2;
                        
                        var eHeight = enemies.verticalPos[e] + enemyConstants[enemies.type[e]].height/2;
                        
                        hurt(1,e,projectileConstants[projectiles.type[i]].damage,projectileConstants[projectiles.type[i]].knockback,atan2(enemies.y[e]-projectiles.y[i],enemies.x[e]-projectiles.x[i]),atan(((eHeight-impactZ))/(dist(impactX,impactY,enemies.x[e],enemies.y[e]))));
